title: Content Creator:in (m/w/d)
description:
Mit den richtigen Inhalten nachhaltige Wirkung erzielen. Als Content Creator:in (m/w/d) gestaltest du die Kommunikation eines führenden Softwareanbieters für die internationale Logistik. Du übersetzt komplexe Themen in verständliche, inspirierende und vertriebsunterstützende Inhalte und trägst so dazu bei, unsere Marke, unsere Scope Community und unsere Geschäftsentwicklung aktiv voranzubringen.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Content, der gezielt darauf ausgerichtet ist, das Interesse potenzieller Kunden zu wecken und Leads zu generieren (z. B. für Webinare, Produktdemos, Events, Success Stories, Vertriebsmaterialien).
  • Erstellung digitaler Inhalte für die Kommunikationskanäle (Social Media, Website, Landigpages, Newsletter, Kampagnen, Blogposts) und Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Videocontent in Form von Kunden- und Partner-Interviews, Podcast-Aufnahmen und Event-Dokumentationen.
  • Begleitung unserer Community Events und Erstellung von Event-Content.
  • Erstellung von SEO- und GEO-optimierten Texten unter Berücksichtigung aktueller Trends und Keywords.
  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung der Content-Strategie und Redaktionsplanung.
  • Regelmäßige Überarbeitung und Optimierung bestehender Contentformate basierend auf Performance-Daten und Feedback.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern sowie relevanten Bereichen im Unternehmen (Productteams, Service Teams, Riege internationale Branches etc.).

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Kommunikation, Journalismus, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Content Creation, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld und Logistik/Transportsektor.
  • Sprachliche Exzellenz mit feinem Gespür für Tonalität und Zielgruppenansprache.
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte in verständliche und verkaufsstarke Texte zu übersetzen; analytischer Blick zur Ableitung

title: IT & Revenue Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster mit einer KI-gestützten Software für die Entscheidungsgrundlage der Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bauträger, Banken und Investoren nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025.

Wir wachsen weiter – und um dieses Wachstum zu tragen, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als IT & Revenue Operations Manager (m/w/d), wahlweise in Berlin oder in NRW.

Du verantwortest unser IT-Management und unseren Revenue Stack. Auf der IT-Seite baust du die Systemlandschaft, mit der unser Team arbeitet – von Geräten und Zugängen bis zu nachweisbaren Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards gegenüber unseren Enterprise-Kunden und Investoren. Auf der Revenue-Seite verantwortest du unser CRM, automatisierst die Prozesse dahinter und schaffst die verlässliche Datenbasis, auf der Marketing, Sales und Customer Success ihre Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Zeit teilt sich zu gleichen Teilen: 50 % IT-Administration, 50 % Revenue Operations.

IT-Administration:

IT-Infrastruktur & Device Management

  • Du baust unser Apple-Setup von Grund auf neu auf – Enrollment, Blueprints und Konfigurationsprofile über Apple Business, sauber migriert und dauerhaft gepflegt
  • Du setzt einen verbindlichen Security-Baseline-Standard durch – Verschlüsselung, Update-Policies, kontrollierte Endgeräte – und hältst ihn nachweisbar
  • Du verantwortest den Hardware-Lifecycle end to end und planst den Gerätebedarf entlang unseres Hiring-Plans

Identity & Access

  • Du gestaltest, wie Zugriffe bei syte vergeben, geändert und wieder entzogen werden – gruppenbasiert, dokumentiert und ohne Lücken beim Offbo

title: Werkstudent Auftragsbearbeitung / Projektadministration Buchhaltung (m/w/d)
description:
„Unsere Softwarelösungen und IT-Beratungsdienstleistungen machen unsere Kunden fit für die Zukunft“. Hinter dieser Aussage steht ein Team von rund 300 Experten an 6 Standorten in Deutschland, Polen und USA, deren gemeinsame Leidenschaft die Gestaltung der digitalen Zukunft ist. Zu unseren Kunden gehören die ganz Großen des Automobilbaus, der Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie sowie des Maschinen-, Schiff- und Anlagenbaus – und das schon seit über 30 Jahren. Mit eigenen Produkten, herstellerunabhängigen Lösungen und maßgeschneiderten Strategien gehören wir zu den absoluten Spezialisten der Branche und werden oft dann gerufen, wenn andere an ihren Grenzen angelangt sind.

Aufgaben

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) im Bereich Projektadministration / PMO.

Du unterstützt unser Team bei der kaufmännischen Betreuung und Administration unserer Kundenprojekte und erhältst dabei einen umfassenden Einblick in die Abläufe eines international tätigen IT-Unternehmens.

Dabei sind deine Aufgaben wie folgt:

  • Anlage oder Prüfung von Kundenaufträgen

Mit zunehmender Erfahrung kannst du Schritt für Schritt weitere Aufgaben eigenständig übernehmen.

Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d), idealerweise in einem wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, kaufmännischen oder vergleichbaren Studiengang.

title: Customer Success Manager – Umsetzungsbegleitung (m/w/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung   Du betreust Kunden nicht einfach – Du bringst sie voran. Du willst nicht auf das nächste Ticket warten, sondern Menschen aktiv durch die Umsetzung führen und am Ende sehen, dass sich wirklich etwas verändert hat.    Deine Mission    Genau dafür ist diese Rolle da. Du begleitest unsere B2B-Kunden rund um attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen, strukturiert, verbindlich und mit dem Blick dafür, was im Alltag wirklich funktioniert. Deine Ansprechpartner sind dabei vor allem die Menschen, die das Thema im Unternehmen verantworten und umsetzen. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Vorsätzen echte Ergebnisse werden.  Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen im Kundenunternehmen praktikable Lösungen und hältst die Umsetzung nachhaltig am Laufen, von der ersten Struktur bis zum sichtbaren Ergebnis. Dabei gestaltest Du eine herausragende Customer Experience und baust echte, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf, nicht nur einzelne erledigte Vorgänge.  Diese Rolle ist bewusst als Einstieg gedacht. Wer sich bewährt, entwickelt sich bei uns weiter, perspektivisch bis zum strategischen Umsetzungsberater, der Kunden eigenverantwortlich und auf Entscheiderebene begleitet. Wir zeigen Dir diesen Weg von Anfang an transparent auf.    Wie ein typischer Tag bei Dir aussieht    Du startest mit dem Blick in Dein CRM (bei uns HubSpot) und siehst auf einen Blick, bei welchem Kunden welches Thema als Nächstes ansteht. Du führst Gespräche mit den Verantwortlichen im Kundenunternehmen, klärst offene Punkte und vereinbarst konkrete nächste Schritte. Zwischen den Terminen bleibst Du am Ball: Du dokumentierst sauber, stimmst Dich eng mit unseren internen Teams ab und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt. Deine Kommunikation ist dabei genauso empathisch wie professionell, egal ob schriftlich oder im Gespräch.   Stellenanforderungen     Was Du mitbringen musst       Erste Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung oder -begleitung im B2B-Umfeld.    Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift sowie eine saubere, fehlerfreie Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch.    Eine strukturierte, verbindliche Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Kunden entlang klarer Prozesse zu führen.    Starke Empathie, Serviceorientierung und echtes Interesse daran, Menschen weiterzubringen.    Hohe Motivation und Lernfreude, sowie den Wunsch, Dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (idealerweise HubSpot) und Office-Programmen.    Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz und die Offenheit, KI-Tools sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.       Was uns hilft, aber kein Muss ist       Vorkenntnisse in Gesundheitsmanagement, Coaching oder Beratung.    Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag.       Was Du bei uns bekommst       Ein Unternehmen mitten in einem der ambitioniertesten Wachstumssprünge im deutschen Beratungsmarkt, mit entsprechendem Entwicklungsspielraum für Dich. Licensed in multiple states and trusted by leading general contractors,  Hays is built on a foundation of safety, excellence, drive, communication, and client focus.    Our mission is simple:  to make ourselves indispensable to our customers . We achieve this by investing in our people, continuously improving our processes, and delivering results that set the standard in the electrical contracting industry. title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description:
Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA).

DESCRIPTIF

Contexte scientifique :

Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé.

Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique.

Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre.

Verrous scientifiques :

La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effe

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to join our South Majors team. This role is based in Florida, reporting to the Senior Sales Engineering Manager for the Americas Field Sales team. You will be responsible for architecting technical solutions that directly address and resolve critical customer pain points. You will serve as a technical advisor throughout the sales cycle, ensuring that Zscaler solutions are perfectly aligned with customer goals and technical requirements.

You will be responsible for architecting technical solutions that directly address and resolve critical customer pain points.

  • Creating and delivering technical product presentations to prospective customers where you will promote the value proposition of Zscaler products
  • Gathering customer technical requirements to ensure proposed solutions will meet customer goals and needs
  • Leading product evaluations and custom product configurations
  • Running Proof of Value from start to finish, as the technical and industry expert
  • Collaborating and supporting internal Zscaler teams

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Overseeing the technical sales process
  • Running Proof of Value from start to finish, as the technical and industry expert

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners.

The impact you will have:

  • Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments.

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment.

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made.

  • Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base.

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner.

  • Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract.

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap.

  • Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit.

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

title: Enterprise Sales VP, Public Sector
description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Enterprise Sales VP, you'll be embedded in the Enterprise Sales team and report directly to the VP, Public and Labor.

The Enterprise Sales VP, Public Sector will expand our footprint with large public-sector clients through direct sales. This is an individual contributor seat with a defined national territory: a named book of public-sector entities at 10,000 to 100,000 lives, including school districts, cities, counties, universities, and public benefit pools. We are expanding our team in order to continue to hit our ambitious Enterprise Sales goals. We are searching for a candidate who possesses the exceptional ability to establish and cultivate high-level relationships, as this will be instrumental in our pursuit of growth and innovation.

What you will do

  • Own the direct sales cycles and deploy sales objectives through the preparation and measuring of sales quotas, prospecting and pipeline management across a named national book of public-sector entities
  • Run RFP-driven pursuits end to end: procurement compliance, consultant management, finalist presentations, and board and committee approvals, across 9 to 18 month, multi-stakeholder cycles
  • Keep current with market knowledge and competitor products to effectively communicate the value proposition of a relationship with Garner
  • Support the development of new, strategic relationships with public-sector benefits consultants and benefits directors, and influence the buying decision

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of deep sales experience with a focus on health benefits (medical, ancillary, vendor) via brokers, consultants, and insurers<

description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

title: Senior Teamlead Customer Succes
description: Geloof jij dat complexe technologie eenvoudig kan zijn?    En kan je andere mensen meenemen in dat geloof, terwijl jullie tegelijk klanten laten groeien, upsell-kansen pakken, en zorgen dat churn daalt? Dan zoeken we jou!     Over Workspace 365  Bij Workspace 365 bouwen we aan één ding: werk eenvoudiger maken. Voor partners. Voor hun eindgebruikers. Dag in, dag uit. Dat klinkt simpel. Maar het vraagt iets van ons. Het vraagt om mensen die niet tevreden zijn met "zo is het nu eenmaal", maar die zien dat IT-complexiteit weg kan.      Jouw rol   Als Senior Lead Customer Success geef je leiding aan vier Customer Success Managers en drie Technical Success Managers. Je brengt structuur, inspiratie en commerciële scherpte in het team. Je houdt overzicht over de status van je klanten: wie loopt risico op churn, wie heeft aandacht nodig en wie biedt kansen op upsell. Je zorgt dat je team dat overzicht net zo scherp heeft en dat de dagelijkse focus daarop ligt. Je maakt duidelijk waarom dat ertoe doet: het is goed voor de klant, maar het zijn ook onze targets, onze omzet en onze groei. Je neemt zelf deel aan gesprekken met grote klanten, ziet waar kansen op meer omzet liggen en durft te sturen op resultaat. Commercie is voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van customer success.      Dit ben jij:    Je gelooft dat complexiteit kan verdwijnen, in processen, in tools en in de manier waarop teams werken. Je neemt geen genoegen met plannen die niet landen. Wordt een target niet gehaald? Dan zoek je uit waarom en los je het op.  Je motiveert liever dan dat je opdrachten geeft. Je neemt je team mee in het waarom, zodat ze niet volgen omdat het moet, maar omdat ze voelen dat het ertoe doet.  Je ziet commercie als onderdeel van succes. Je begrijpt dat klanten moeten groeien en partners moeten verdienen, en dat wij daarin meegroeien. Je spreekt makkelijk over targets, NRR en upsell-kansen, en je stuurt er ook op.          Wat vragen we van jou?    Minstens vijf jaar saleservaring. Ervaring in customer success is een pré, maar een ervaren salesmanager is ook welkom.  Vijf jaar ervaring in leidinggeven.  Een commerciële mentaliteit. Je begrijpt NRR, upsell, churn en portfoliomanagement, en je stuurt er actief op. Omzet en groei zijn voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een KPI waar je dagelijks naar handelt.  Nederlands en Engels op niveau.  Een hbo- of wo-opleidingsachtergrond.       Wat krijg je van ons?    Autonomie:    Je krijgt eigenaarschap en vertrouwen. Je weet samen met je team waar jullie naartoe werken en bepaalt zelf hoe. Je krijgt vrijheid, en de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort.  Je ziet je impact terug. Partners die groeien, eindgebruikers die productiever worden en churn die daalt. Ook je team voelt dat resultaat.  Je krijgt ruimte om te bouwen. We hebben plannen, maar niet alle antwoorden al klaar. Zie jij een betere aanpak? Dan luisteren we.    Geld:    €5.900 tot €6.800 euro bruto per maand (40 uur per week, afhankelijk van ke

title: Customer Retention Manager, Mid-Market, Renewals (German Speaking)

Lead renewals across different products and platforms for both direct customers as well as customer renewals that vary across any of our Solution Partners in each region we support  Increase customer awareness of Atlassian’s product portfolio to identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities during the renewals cycle  Maintain a deep understanding of product updates and new offerings and articulate those improvements to customers and our solution partners  Maintain a consistently healthy pipeline by logging sales and renewal activities, customer data, and customers’ status within internal systems      About You     Three or more years of proven experience in account management, software renewals, customer success, or other relevant business areas  Ability to establish rapport, form relationships, and build trust on the phone and on video across a wide variety of countries and cultures  Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding performance goals  German language proficiency is required      Compensation   At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensatio

title: EAM IFS Cloud Consultant, Manager

title: Workday Functional HCM Manager, Functional Transformation
description: Workday Functional HCM Manager     Position Summary   Our Human Capital practice helps organizations address the changing nature of work, workforce, and workplace. We bring sector experience and cross-domain insight to help clients solve complex workforce challenges and align talent strategies to business priorities. Join our team and help organizations transform work in ways that make work better for humans and humans better at work.  Recruiting for this role ends on 06/11/2027.   Work you'll do   As a Workday Functional Manager on the HR Strategy & Technology team, you will be responsible for:    Lead a multi-functional implementation team in planning and executing discovery, design, configuration, and deployment activities, ensuring superior quality delivery for client projects  Manage project timeline, communications and, risk identification and mitigation  Act as point person for all functional consultants, providing direction and guidance to team and coordinating with integrations and data consultants as needed  Use your experience and knowledge of Workday implementations to support sales activities  Build relationships internally and externally to strengthen your and the firm's reputation as a leading Workday implementation partner    A successful candidate would possess these skills:    Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  Effective written and verbal communication skills  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  Ability to lead projects or workstreams  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  Ability to meet deadlines  Ability to provide clear guidance to others     The team   Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.   Qualifications   Required:    6+ years of experience implementing Workday HCM Cloud with at least 4 full life cycle implementations  Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant experience required  6+ years' hands on experience in multiple Full Life Cycle implementations of the Workday HCM product, from planning through design, build, testing and go-live  6+ years' experience leading a project team, including managing workstream leads to drive their work towards project deadlines and deliverables that are on target and beyond client expectations  4+ years' managing project financials, including monitoring and managing project risks/issues and taking appropriate action to ensure an exceptional project completion for the client  Ability

Über uns

Die Trigon Unternehmensgruppe ist ein etabliertes Berliner Immobilienunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Entwicklung, Verwaltung und Vermietung von Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien. Der Bestand umfasst rund 4.000 Wohn- und 300 Gewerbeeinheiten sowie Stellplätze.

Aufgaben

  • Technische Betreuung und administrative Unterstützung unserer Technikabteilung
  • Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Instandhaltungs- und technischen Aufträgen
  • Koordination unserer eigenen Handwerkerteams sowie Terminabstimmung mit Mietern
  • Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Aufträgen, Angeboten und technischen Dokumenten

  • Prüfung eingehender Rechnungen externer technischer Dienstleister sowie Pflege auftragsbezogener Daten
  • Technische Dokumentation der Vorgänge sowie Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Mietern, Kollegen und externen Dienstleistern

  • Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Berufsausbildung (z. B. im Bereich Gebäudetechnik, Bau, Immobilien oder vergleichbar) oder ein Studium mit technischem Schwerpunkt

  • Erfahrung in der Leistungsabrechnung, Rechnungsprüfung oder Fakturierung wünschenswert
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (Word, Excel und Outlook)
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Berlin, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
description:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.

description:

We’re looking for a Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation to join our Capital and Payments team. description: Vil du være med til at forme oplevelsen for millioner af passagerer hvert år? Med ’Passenger First, Always’ som ledestjerne arbejder vi for at skabe en rejseoplevelse i verdensklasse. Vores ambition er at levere de oplevelser, der får passagererne til at vælge og huske CPH – vi vil ’delighte’. Din nye rolle   I rollen som Senior Specialist i Customer Experience (CX) får du ansvaret for at udvikle og sikre en sammenhængende passageroplevelse på tværs af hele rejsen, både den fysiske og digitale. Rollen giver stor indflydelse, et bredt netværk på tværs af lufthavnen og mulighed for at omsætte strategi til synlige resultater i passagerrejsen.  Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:    Eje og videreudvikle CPH’s Master Passenger Journey på tværs af organisationen  Identificere, prioritere og konkretisere forbedringsmuligheder baseret på kundeindsigter, data og trends  Drive og prioritere en tværgående udviklings-roadmap på passagerrejsen på tværs af CPH  Definere og forankre CX-krav, standarder og designprincipper for fysiske og digitale touch points  Sikre at passagerernes behov tænkes ind gennem kravsætning og design/ambience i byggeprojekter. Vi bygger til fremtiden, og det stiller krav til indsigt i trends, fremtidige passagerbehov og udviklingen i rejsebehov  Benchmarke og omsætte best practice fra førende lufthavne og servicevirksomheder  Rådgive og udfordre organisationen inden for kundeoplevelser og passagerbehov     Din nye afdeling   I Commercial & Passenger Journey arbejder vi med at udvikle CPH’s kommercielle forretning. Vi har ansvaret for alt fra udvikling af ruter til udlejning af butikker og spisesteder, parkering, kommunikation og den samlede passagerrejse.  Du bliver en del af Passenger Journey Development. Vi er et team på 11 personer med forskellige faglige kompetencer inden for forretningsudvikling, service excellence, monitorering og kvalitetsopfølgning og CX, som deler en fælles passion for at udvikle og forbedre passagerrejsen.  Vi prioriterer et godt sammenhold i teamet og mødes til både faglige arrangementer, frokost eller en god kop kaffe, ligesom vi også mødes socialt med hele den kommercielle afdeling på 90 skønne kollegaer.   Om dig   Du arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, kundeindsigter og drift og får en unik mulighed for at sætte retning for, hvordan Københavns Lufthavn skal opleves i fremtiden. Det gør du med din strukturerede og metodiske evne til at omsætte strategi til konkrete planer – og til at eksekvere dem. Du anvender også din forståelse for sammenhængen af det fysiske og digitale rum.  Vi forestiller os, at du har:    Strategisk kunde- og forretningsforståelse  Arbejdet med Customer Experience fra andre større virksomheder  Erfaring med at arbejde i det fysiske rum og forståelse for, hvordan design og indretning påvirker passageroplevelsen  Erfar

description: Votre mission      L'office cantonal des systèmes d'information et du numérique (OCSIN) élabore et concrétise la stratégie des systèmes d'information et de communication de l'administration cantonale ainsi que la politique de sécurité de l'information. L'OCSIN esquisse les contours de la politique du numérique du Conseil d’État, visant à faire du canton un acteur important de la transformation de notre société, induite par l'essor du numérique. En savoir plus sur "Genève numérique".     Grâce aux technologies, plus de 600 collaborateurs œuvrent au quotidien pour faciliter l'accès à l'information et créer du lien entre les citoyens et les métiers du service public. title: Business Operations Manager
description: Business Operations Manager | Palmerston North      Ready to make a real impact in a growing local business?     Auto Interiors Ltd is a well-established, family-owned Palmerston North business with a strong reputation for quality workmanship and genuine customer service.     We’re looking for a commercially minded, customer-focused person to become a key part of our business and help us improve the way we operate.     This is a hands-on role combining customer service, quoting, workflow management, financial administration and business improvement.     We’re not simply looking for someone to keep the office running. We’re looking for someone who can help make the business run better.      A New Chapter for Auto Interiors   This opportunity comes at an important time for our business.     Our long-standing Office Administrator, Carol, will be retiring at the end of September after providing outstanding service and support to Auto Interiors, our team and our customers.     Carol has been an important part of the day-to-day running of the business, and we’re extremely grateful for the contribution she has made.     Her retirement gives us a natural opportunity to look at what the business needs for its next chapter.  Rather than simply replacing Carol’s existing position, we’ve decided to develop the role to reflect where Auto Interiors is heading.     As the business continues to grow, we want to strengthen our customer experience, commercial management, workflow, financial administration and systems while making better use of technology and business information.     The new Business Operations Manager will take responsibility for many of the important day-to-day functions Carol has looked after so well, while also taking on a broader role in helping us improve and develop the business.     We’re not starting again. We’re building on strong foundations and preparing Auto Interiors for its next stage of growth.      The Role   You’ll work closely with the owner and alongside our workshop foreman, becoming an important link between our customers, office and workshop.     You’ll need to be comfortable dealing with what is happening today while also looking ahead and asking how we can improve tomorrow. Au sein de la direction, le service Relations et solutions clients assure notamment l’interface entre l’Andra et ses clients producteurs électronucléaires de déchets radioactifs.     En tant que Référent clients, vous serez la porte d'entrée et l'interlocuteur généraliste d’un des clients principaux. Vous aurez à cœur de développer avec ce client une relation de confiance et de répondre au mieux à ses besoins, tout en veillant au respect des enjeux propres à l’Agence (sûreté, contraintes d’exploitation des centres, équilibre financier des contrats, …). Votre positionnement sera celui d’un facilitateur/coordonnateur, doté d’une culture technique pour appréhender des sujets parfois complexes avec le client et les experts internes. Votre valeur ajoutée sera de permettre aux équipes de l’Andra d’apporter efficacement des solutions aux besoins du client.     Vos principales missions consisteront notamment à :   Assurer l’interface avec le client et organiser les échanges réguliers avec lui (réunions bilatérales, comités, échanges au fil de l’eau, …),  Comprendre ses besoins, les analyser, les faire remonter et proposer des solutions permettant d’y répondre en considérant le contexte et les enjeux propres à chaque cas,  Conseiller le client, tant sur les aspects techniques de la prise en charge de ses déchets radioactifs que sur les processus de l’Andra et les aspects contractuels,  Suivre le traitement de ses demandes et pour certaines coordonner les actions entre les différents services,  Recueillir et analyser les retours du client, proposer des actions d’amélioration,  Elaborer des propositions techniques et commerciales pour des prestations spécifiques puis en suivre la réalisation,  Assurer l’animation de la relation clients : visites des centres, organisation d’événements, enquête de satisfaction, …  Eventuellement, contribuer aux formations dispensées par l’Andra auprès des producteurs de déchets. title: Growth Manager – Short-Form Content (Instagram & TikTok)
description:
Headquarters:  Schwyz, Switzerland
      URL:   http://xo-angels.com 
 

 We're XO Angels, a creator management agency. As a Growth Manager, you'll own the short-form strategy of 2-4 creators end to end: scripts, shot lists, feedback to creators and editors, and constant testing until the numbers move. Your only real goal: views that turn into real reach. 
  What you'll actually do  
 
 Analyse viral short-form content, understand why it worked, and adapt it for our creators. 
 Write scripts and shot lists that your creators then shoot. Give them precise feedback on what worked, what didn't, and what needs to change. 
 Direct editors and posters. You own the output, they execute it. 
 Analyse every post: why did this hit, why did that flop, what do we double down on this week. 
 Test bold ideas fast, kill what doesn't work, scale what does. 
 
  Who we're looking for 
This is not a 9-to-5. When a Reel goes viral on a Sunday night, you're on it. When an account gets banned at 10pm on a weekday, you handle it. Weekends are normally off, but when there's an emergency you step in, no discussion. If that puts you off, this role isn't for you. 
  We want:  
 
 Obsession with short-form. You watch TikTok and Reels for hours voluntarily and can explain why a video works. You're not learning this, you already live it. 
 Ownership mindset. You treat your creators' accounts like your own business. No excuses, no "the editor didn't deliver", you make it happen. 
 Analytical eye. You can look at 20 videos and tell us what pattern connects the winners. 
 Fluent English. Non-negotiable. 
 Bonus, not required: experience growing IG or TikTok accounts, agency or marketing background. We care more about drive and taste than about your CV. 
 
  What you get  
 
 3,000 USD base + performance bonuses. Realistic total 3,500-7,000 USD/month depending on results. 
 100% remote. Work from wherever. 
 Direct impact. Small team, no bureaucracy. Your ideas ship this week, not next quarter. 
 Clear path up. If you really push, you can become Head of Marketing within 12-18 months and lead your own team. 
 
  How to apply 
Click the link and fill out the short application. It tells you honestly what the role really involves, and screens you in or out, so neither you nor we waste any time. 
   https://forms.gle/fyJijS45f1nT2x8Z7

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally.

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases

title: Communications Lead
description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

As headcount grows, so does the load on these systems, and we need someone to own their architecture and roadmap rather than just keep them running.

You'll be the final escalation point for complex, cross-system problems, and you'll lead company-wide systems projects from scoping through delivery. A significant identity provider and device management migration is on the near-term roadmap, so there's substantial architectural work from day one.

Beyond the core stack, you'll act as OLIX's AI enabler: finding the manual tools and processes worth removing, evaluating tools, and building agents and automations that act as a force multiplier across the business, all while holding a high bar on security and IP protection. title: Werkstudent - Technisches Projektmanagement
description:
In the following you'll find information about us and the specific role:

Ort: Berlin Kreuzberg, vor Ort
Umfang: 20 h/Woche, flexibel einteilbar
Vergütung: 17–20 €/h
Arbeitssprache: Deutsch
Start: ab sofort

Was wir lösen

Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie.

Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf.
Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard.
Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage, in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen.

Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein.
Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa.
Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich.
Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakehold

XRbit is a research insitute developing innovative at the intersection of technology, science and digital learning.

Our interdisciplinary team combines software development, artificial intelligence, Extended Reality (XR), 3D technologies and interactive systems. We work together with universities, research institutions, educational organizations, museums and other partners to develop new ways of making complex topics accessible and tangible.

As our research and development activities increasingly combine software with physical systems, we are looking for someone who enjoys turning ideas into working hardware prototypes.

Aufgaben

You will develop and prototype hardware systems at the intersection of camera technology, embedded computing, sensor technology, mechanics and robotics.

A key part of your work will be the development of camera-based systems for computer vision and AI applications.

These systems may range from laboratory prototypes to robust systems intended for continuous operation in industrial or outdoor environments.

You will work closely with our software, AI and 3D development teams and help bridge the gap between software and the physical world.

Your tasks may include:

  • Designing, building and testing camera-based hardware systems
  • Integrating embedded computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi or comparable systems
  • Programming and connecting sensors, cameras, microcontrollers and other electronic components
  • Developing suitable concepts for thermal management, ventilation and condensation prevention
  • Producing prototype components using 3D printing and rapid prototyping
  • Documenting hardware architectures, components and technical decisions

Qualifikation

Your Profile

You should have a background in one or more of the following areas:

title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers EU
description:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp's internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll take ownership of services that process real money. You'll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we'd love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you'll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team's domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)

title: Customer Service Lead
description: Rathbones Tailor is an online formalwear hire business. Customers book suits, morning wear and Highland wear through our store, wear them for their event, and send them back. We have been trading for five years, the last eighteen months on our current Shopify site, and have completed over ten thousand rentals.       Customer service is where this business lives or dies. A hire order is a promise: the right outfit, on time, a good fit, an easy return. Get that right and customers come back and tell people. Get it wrong and they remember. That is why we treat CS as a function to lead properly, not a queue to clear.       Why this role exists       This role steps in to lead our customer service function and own it outright. You are the person the rest of the team brings a CS question to, and the one accountable for how customers are looked after from first enquiry to final return. We want someone to come in, understand how customers actually move through a hire, and rebuild the CS operation so it is faster, calmer and less dependent on any one person. You will not be handed a finished playbook to follow. You will write it.       We are actively looking to put new tools and AI to work here. A large share of our contact is repetitive and predictable, which is exactly the kind of load that automation and AI-assisted support can take off a person's plate. We want someone who is hungry to build that, not wary of it: someone who will automate the routine so the human time goes to the cases that actually need judgement. Own the customer inbox and the full lifecycle of a hire enquiry: pre-order sizing and fit questions, order status (WISMO), exchanges and size swaps, delivery issues, returns, and late-return chasing. Hit response and resolution targets across the trading calendar, including our summer and pre-Christmas peaks.       2. Build the systems, lean on AI. Diagnose where the current process leaks time or goodwill and fix it. That means macros and templates that actually match our situations, clean escalation paths, and documentation that lets a new joiner pick things up in a day rather than a month. Above all it means using automation and AI to take the repetitive volume off people: an AI-assisted triage and response layer for high-volume queries (order status, size swaps, late returns) so the team spends its time on the cases that need a human. You will have real say over the tooling and be expected to make the case for it and put it live.       3. Lead it, and keep the Director in the loop. You run this function so it is genuinely handled, not watched over. A short weekly update and a fuller monthly one keep the Director across the numbers, the wins, the pain points and anything that needs a decision at his level. title: Fractional RevOps / GTM Engineer (Part-Time, Contract)
description:
Anagram is the ultimate insurance billing platform for eye care providers. Combining instant eligibility and benefit verifications, patient responsibility calculation, claims management, payment posting, and more, Anagram's all-in-one revenue cycle management solution is designed to save providers time and money, and free doctors to deliver the best care for their patients. Our mission is to simplify insurance, and it's working: over 2,000 eye care professionals rely on Anagram to manage their insurance billing.

Founded in 2014, Anagram is the largest and fastest-growing insurance billing platform for eye care providers in America and processes hundreds of millions of dollars each year.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer to own the revenue systems layer across a genuinely messy and interesting go-to-market. You'll design and maintain the pipes connecting CRM, billing, warehouse, and analytics, and wire AI into the workflows in between. You'll work directly with revenue leadership and have wide latitude in how things get built.

Why This Role Is Harder Than It Sounds

  • The account hierarchy is real. Our market spans solo practices, multi-location companies, roll-up brands, and PE platforms. The HubSpot company object has to do quadruple duty — PE firm → brand → company → location — with clean parent-child associations, dedup logic that respects the hierarchy, and reporting that rolls up correctly at every level.

  • Four GTM motions run in parallel. SMB, mid-market, enterprise, and partner led — each needs its own routing, lifecycle logic, handoffs, and funnel reporting, without forking the CRM into four incompatible systems.

  • Three products, three pricing models. Subscription, usage-based, and percentage-of-collections billing all flow through the same revenue stack. Normalizing these into coherent ARR/NRR, cohort, and revenue reporting is a core design problem, not an afterthought.

About You

  • You're a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer with a builder profile.

  • Strong SQL from scratch.

  • You know when a Zap is enough and when it's time to write code.

  • Self-directed; comfortable operating fractionally with async communication and minimal oversight.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales/marketing ops with a builder profile

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience custom objects, associations, workflows, API —ideally with complex parent-child account structures (multi-location, franchise, healthcare, or roll-up environments)

  • Production experience with Stripe data, including usage-based or non-standard billing models

  • Production experience with Zapier<

  • Maintain professionalism and clarity in all written and verbal communication with customers.

Operational Process Execution

title: Sales Development Representative, Outbound
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list. We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand. You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendous’ revenue growth and future success.

What you'll do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.

  • Use Amplemarket, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.

  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

  • 1-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.

  • Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.

  • Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

  • Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

  • Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.<

This is a high-impact role at a pivotal moment: a vertical go-to-market motion is being built, and the company is sharpening its focus on segment-driven growth. Product Marketing sits at the center of it all and owns positioning, enabling Sales, shaping vertical strategy, and driving how our products go to market.

This is a build-and-elevate role. You will bring structure, clarity, and commercial impact to a function that is critical to Veriff’s next stage of growth.

Reporting to the CMO, you will lead a lean PMM team and operate as a true partner to Sales and Product. You will turn Veriff’s technical differentiation into clear, compelling stories that win deals, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen our position in the market.

title: Senior Manager, Solutions & Partnerships, Marketing Services
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Toptal’s Marketing Agency Organization spans eight practices, from brand and advertising to martech and content marketing. We need a hybrid operator across solution architecture, sales enablement, partnerships, and client-facing business development — judged on outcomes: deals won, partner revenue generated, offerings shipped.

You will be part of a distributed team and will be reporting directly to our Practice Director of our Marketing Agency.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Solution Architecture & Enterprise Deal Support

  • Lead proposals and RFP responses for large, complex Enterprise engagements, and partner directly with SMB and Enterprise sales teams earlier in the deal cycle as a solutions counterpart and marketing subject matter expert.

Partnerships & Go-to-Market

  • Own go-to-market execution of strategic partnerships with organizations like Hawke Media and Writer — offer structure, pricing, and co-sell motions — and be accountable for converting them into real, measurable revenue.

Core Offering Development

  • Help evolve the core service catalog across project-based professional services and fully managed / retainer models, packaged so they’re easy for Sales to sell and clients to buy.

Client-Facing Business Development

  • Represent the organization directly with prospective and existing Enterprise clients, owning outcomes and generating new business rather than only supporting from behind the scenes.

AI Enablement

  • Design AI-enabled offerings for clients, and champion practical AI adoption inside the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Meet the team.
  • Familiarize yourself with Toptal’s operations, including OKRs, RACIs, and other operational frameworks.
  • Undergo role-specific training

title: President - Business Unit
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Business Unit (BU) President at Cordance is the strategic and operational leader of their business unit, serving as both its product and market authority and its executive anchor. As the P&L owner, the President is accountable for setting strategy, driving disciplined growth, and ensuring scalable and efficient operations. This role requires a leader with deep industry expertise, sharp understanding of customer needs, and the ability to balance long-term vision with hands-on execution.

The President will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, shape the product roadmap, establish the annual operating plan, and oversee resources and budgets to deliver sustainable business performance. They will champion customer experience, guide product strategy and engineering execution, and embed best practices in sales, pricing, packaging, customer success, and operational excellence.

As the primary external face of the BU to customers, strategic partners, and the broader industry, the President will engage deeply with stakeholders while mentoring internal teams, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation, and building high-performance organizations aligned with Cordance’s long-term objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the BU’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth strategy, aligning with Cordance’s portfolio priorities.
  • Develop and execute the annual operating plan and multi-year investment model, ensuring financial rigor and sustainable results.
  • Own full P&L responsibility, balancing growth initiatives with disciplined cost management.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

Check out the development opportunities in the Sales Team.
This is a remote role with the expectation to be in our Brighton/London office once a quarter.
It's worth saying that we'd also expect you to be onsite for your very first onboarding week with us, but that we're happy to support and organise travel and accommodation to facilitate this.

What You’ll Be Doing
You'll be managing your own portfolio of Customer accounts. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to ramping up card spend and account management. This is a telephone-based role (no face-to-face or field sales involved) and you’ll primarily be contacting SME owner-directors selling our award-winning business credit card.

  • Self-generating leads
  • Building and managing a customer pipeline
  • Making 30-50 outbound cold calls per day
  • Working towards and hitting targets of card spend
  • Managing customer accounts and spend
  • Working to high standards of FCA regulations

We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of telesales experience, Ideally B2B sales
  • Experience in a 360 sales cycle
  • Experience in a high-volume cold calling role
  • Experience in financial sales, Ideally Card sales

Diversity & Inclusion
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

What Can You Earn Here?

Base: £30,000-£40,000 | Uncapped commission structure

Your earning potential here is real — and we can prove it. Most BDMs earn around £50k OTE in their first year. Top performing newbies have cleared £70k OTE in year one, and our top performers overall are consistently at £100k+ OTE. No cap. No ceiling. Just you and your effort. Oh, and the record for commission in a single quarter is £52k. Go beat it.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks
We try not to take ourselves too seriously (all the time)

title: Business Development Representative – DACH (f/m/d)
description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

As we continue to grow in the DACH market, we are looking for a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) (f/m/d) to generate new business opportunities and play a key role in our sales engine.

Your Mission

As a BDR at Apaleo, you are on the front line of our growth. You will be responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities for our Account Executives through a mix of inbound lead qualification and proactive outbound prospecting.

This is a high-impact, target-driven role with a clear path towards an Account Executive position.

What You’ll Be Up To

  • Own and manage inbound leads with speed and strong qualification standards
  • Proactively build pipeline through outbound prospecting (calls, email, LinkedIn)
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly targets (e.g. meetings booked, qualified opportunities)
  • Run structured discovery conversations to understand customer needs and identify pain points
  • Engage decision-makers in the hospitality industry and position Apaleo’s value proposition
  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives to ensure high-quality handover of opportunities
  • Leverage our partner ecosystem to identify and generate additional leads
  • Maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoom, and Modjo to optimise your performance

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS, sales development, or a comparable commercial role
  • Strong interest in outbound prospecting and building pipeline
  • Comfortable working with targets, KPIs, and performance metrics
  • Excellent communication skills in German and English (minimum C1 level required for both, for the DACH market)
  • Confidence in engaging and challenging decision-makers
  • Strong discovery and listening skills, you know how to uncover real customer needs
  • High level of resilience, ownership, and drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn, especially in a tech-driven product environment

Extra consideration for:

  • Experience in hospitality or hospitality tech or SaaS or similar background
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools (e.g. HubSpot, Sales Navigator etc.)
  • Additional language proficiency in Italian or Spanish, or French is a plus

description: Lefebvre Sdu is misschien wel de oudste AI-startup van Nederland. Niet omdat we voorop lopen in technologie, maar omdat we de kennis hebben waar die technologie op draait. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, bouwen we GenIA-L: een AI-platform waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken iemand die zorgt dat ze het ook echt anders gaan doen.      HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT   Een licentie afsluiten is één ding. Een kantoor zijn werkproces laten herzien rond AI is iets anders. Juristen en fiscalisten werken zoals ze werken omdat het al jaren zo gaat, en een nieuw platform verandert daar uit zichzelf niets aan. Iemand moet naast ze gaan zitten, kijken hoe hun dossierwerk er nu uitziet en laten zien waar GenIA-L dat werk overneemt of versnelt. Daarvoor moet je dat werk zelf hebben gedaan. Jij hebt jaren in de praktijk gestaan. Je weet hoe een dossier wordt opgebouwd, waar de uren in gaan zitten en waarom een professional niet zomaar vertrouwt op een antwoord dat hij niet kan narekenen. Die geloofwaardigheid is je belangrijkste instrument: wanneer jij tegenover een partner zit, praat je met iemand uit hetzelfde vak. Je bent daarmee de belangrijkste ambassadeur van het product, naar buiten én naar binnen. Wat jij bij klanten ziet, breng je terug, want de beste roadmap-input komt van mensen die het platform elke dag proberen te gebruiken.      Je begeleidt klanten van livegang tot volwassen gebruik, en je stuurt op adoptie in plaats van op tevredenheid.  Je analyseert de werkprocessen van juridische en fiscale teams en vertaalt die naar een concrete inrichting van GenIA-L.  Je traint gebruikers en interne key users, zodat kennis over het platform bij de klant blijft.  Je meet gebruik, signaleert waar adoptie stokt en grijpt in voordat een verlenging in gevaar komt.  Je bouwt aan een aanpak die herhaalbaar is: playbooks, use cases en voorbeelden die je bij de volgende klant weer inzet.  Je brengt de praktijk van de klant terug naar product en redactie, en je bent de stem van de gebruiker in onze eigen ontwikkeling.  Je werkt nauw samen met sales, zodat uitbreiding en verlenging voortkomen uit gebruik dat aantoonbaar waarde oplevert.       DIT ZOEKEN WIJ   Je bent commercieel sterk en op het punt gekomen waarop je meer wilt dan alleen verkopen. Je hebt gezien wat AI met de manier waarop organisaties werken gaat doen en je wilt aan die kant van de tafel zitten, bij de partij die het bouwt in plaats van bij de partij die het over zich heen krijgt. Je commerciële ervaring neem je mee, maar je wilt dichter op de klant, het product en de impact zitten.   Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol in customer success, business

title: Community & Social Media Manager (all genders) - Teilzeit (max. 32 Std./Woche)
description:
Daran solltest Du Freude haben

Du begeisterst Dich für Social Media, Content Creation und den Austausch mit Menschen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

Als Community & Social Media Manager (all genders) hilfst Du dabei, die Sichtbarkeit unserer Marken in den sozialen Medien zu stärken und eine aktive Community aufzubauen. title: Staff Mobile Engineer - Retail
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As a Staff Mobile Engineer in Global Retail, you'll shape how customers discover, browse, and buy retail products - apparel, beauty, electronics, auto parts and more - across Wolt, DoorDash and Deliveroo. Retail is a large growth opportunity for the business, and our mission is to be the most trusted and magical way to shop the brands and local stores customers love. You'll play a key role in making that real on mobile - from product discovery through to shopping experience in the apps millions of people use every day.

You'll join an evolving area where we are replacing and improving parts of the existing consumer apps, owning specific retail journeys within large-scale B2C applications. This means working in a complex environment where multiple teams own different parts of the same app, and where strong technical judgment is needed to create consistency, quality and speed across teams.

This role is primarily iOS-focused, but combined iOS + Android experience is a strong plus.

 

What you'll be doing

title: Senior VFX Artist - New Mobile Game
description:
We are looking for a Senior VFX Artist to join our in-house art team working on a new mobile game. Bring your passion for gaming, VFX, and Tech Art.
