title: Werkstudent AI Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Prozesse verstehen. Lösungen bauen, die bei KMUs tatsächlich laufen.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Wir sind ein kleines Team in Neumarkt und entwickeln IoT-Cloud-Lösungen für Maschinen- und Fahrzeughersteller. Parallel bauen wir eine Automatisierungsplattform, mit der wir Prozesse automatisieren – für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden. Mit KI-Agenten, LLM-Anbindungen und der Integration bestehender Fachsysteme.

Der Bedarf ist größer als das, was wir nebenbei erledigen können. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der genau daran arbeitet: bestehende Prozesse aufnehmen, verstehen wo es klemmt, und dann eine Lösung bauen, die läuft.

Was wir nicht suchen: jemanden, der Konzepte schreibt, die niemand umsetzt. Und keine Forschungsprojekte. Unsere Lösungen müssen zu einem Mittelständler passen – also einfach genug, dass sie auch ohne dich weiterlaufen.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll.
  • Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste.

title: Manager, Commercial Finance (Strategic Finance)
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About the role:

We're looking for a Finance Manager to join our Commercial FP&A team within Strategic Finance. This team member will own a diverse set of recurring deliverables and analyses that keep the business informed. The Commercial FP&A team acts as the analytical engine of the company, providing insights that support optimal business decision-making.

This role requires strong commercial finance acumen and a genuine interest in understanding the "why" behind the numbers. You'll support the narrative behind revenue performance for the Senior Leadership Team and Board-level materials, partner with Commercial and Sales Operations teams on GTM reporting, and help maintain the reporting infrastructure that leadership relies on for in-quarter decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Own recurring revenue reporting workflows - daily/weekly file maintenance, revenue trackers, attainment dashboards, and variance analysis - ensuring accuracy and timely delivery at a daily cadence
  • Prepare and update executive materials for KPI reviews, Board of Directors presentations, and SLT meetings, including slide updates, and supporting data files
  • Conduct variance analysis on revenue movements and deliver clear, concise commentary that explains the "what" and the "why" behind performance trends
  • Support quarterly sales target-setting - assembling bottoms-up data, reconciling against tops-down forecasts, and surfacing risks and opportunities for leadership discussion
  • Own the commercial commission review process - synthesizing attainment data, identifying trends, and providing analysis that informs leadership's compensation and incentive decisions
  • Execute ad-hoc analysis for Revenue, GTM, and Commercial leadership to support in-quarter decision-making
  • Maintain and improve core financial reporting infrastructure - identifying opportunities to enhance accuracy, reduce manual effort, and improve consistency across deliverables

title: Product Manager, Orchestrator

About Chili Piper

Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

Internally, we think of this role as a Product Market Fitter. This is not a traditional roadmap management role. It is a product leadership role for someone who loves building complex, enterprise-grade products and has the judgment to turn customer and market evidence into focused product bets that drive real adoption and business impact.

Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. That includes catching a form abandonment, a no-show, a missed meeting, or a cold chat, checking ICP fit, account ownership, intent history, and CRM state, then firing the right next step: enrolling a sequence in Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong Engage, notifying a rep, rescheduling a meeting, or sending a booking link.

You will own the full arc of a product bet: target customer, first audience, market and customer evidence, problem definition, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, success metrics, first adoption trigger, usage learning, and business outcome.

You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.

This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

What you’ll do

title: Talent Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

As

Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.

Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)

Contract type: Full-time, permanent

Start: October/November
Location: Berlin

#The role

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.

The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.

You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts.

You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. Noi siamo qui per cambiarlo: uniamo fatturazione, pagamenti, tesoreria e contabilità in un’unica piattaforma moderna, restituendo tempo e creando valore reale.  Siamo ambiziosi, pragmatici ed efficienti. Costruiamo velocemente e puntiamo sempre al massimo.  Siamo una realtà in forte crescita, supportata da alcuni dei migliori investitori internazionali — tra cui Keen Venture Partners (Fiscozen), Founders (Pleo), Exor Ventures (Qonto, Alan), Notion Capital e Creandum (Klarna, Spotify).      Questo è solo l’inizio.      Se vuoi costruire qualcosa che può cambiare il modo in cui lavora il 90% delle aziende in Italia, questo è il posto giusto.      Il ruolo   Sarai la  prima persona dedicata alle Revenue Operations  in Sibill — e la prima del team Data & Tech a costruire questo ponte tra dati, sistemi e crescita commerciale. Riporterai direttamente a Dario, CDTO e Cofounder (che figata, sì).     Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i founder e con i team di Sales, Marketing e Customer Success per allineare le persone, i dati e gli strumenti verso una crescita efficiente e predicibile.     Essere il primo di questo team significa presenza: nei prossimi mesi ti aspettiamo in ufficio più spesso del solito, per immergerti nelle dinamiche, capire come lavoriamo davvero e costruire le fondamenta giuste. Una volta che hai il contesto, il tuo contributo sarà anche aiutarci a capire come e quando far crescere il team RevOps.     Qui il tuo lavoro non resta dietro le quinte:  abilita le decisioni, accelera le vendite e crea ordine dove serve — grazie alla tecnologia e AI.       Cosa farai    Stack & sistemi    Far evolvere lo stack RevOps (CRM, automazioni, integrazioni), guidando Sibill verso il disegno e l’execution di processi AI-native sulla GTM motion  Rendere HubSpot la single source of truth del business  Automatizzare lead routing, deal flow e SLA  Integrare Marketing, Sales e CS senza buchi nel funnel    Dati & metriche    Governare il funnel end-to-end: MQL → SQL → Closed Won → Expansion  Costruire dashboard e KPI su pipeline, conversioni, forecast accuracy e cycle time  Garantire CRM hygiene e qualità del dato in modo continuativo  Supportare il forecasting settimanale con segnali chiari su rischi e deal bloccati    Processi & playbook    Documentare processi Sales e CS scalabili, riducendo la dipendenza dalla conoscenza informale  Definire pipeline governance: stage, campi obbligatori, next steps, close date  Creare playbook operativi e best practice per il team Sales  Formare il team sull'utilizzo corretto degli strumenti    Strategia & crescita    Disegnare e gestire esperimenti A/B su messaggi, sequenze, pricing e onboarding — con rigore metodologico, non per istinto  Portare insight strategici su mercato, competitor e leve di crescita  Supportare decisioni su terr

title: Associate Technical Account Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: About the Role    Do you have a strong dental background, enjoy solving technical challenges, and know how to build trusted customer relationships?      At 3Shape, we are looking for an Associate Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join our Lab Key Accounts team in Copenhagen. As a TAM, you will serve as the primary technical contact for our enterprise lab customers, helping them get the most from 3Shape’s products and services.     This is not a traditional support role. You will work proactively to stabilize and scale customers’ IT environments, manage technical relationships, solve complex issues, guide software integrations, and advocate for customers internally. The role supports recurring revenue growth and helps strengthen 3Shape’s position as a trusted partner in digital dentistry.     You will work closely with Product, Sales, Support and Academy to deliver a strong customer experience.     This role reports to the Director, Head of Lab Key Accounts Region Europe and is based at our Copenhagen headquarters by Kongens Nytorv. The position also requires 30–50% travel for onsite meetings, customer engagements and industry events.      About 3Shape’s Lab Business   3Shape’s Lab business develops digital solutions that help dental laboratories work more efficiently across their workflows. Our portfolio includes Dental System™, lab scanners, LMS integrations, TRIOS® workflows and services such as Design Service.      Key Responsibilities     Enterprise customer relationships:  Act as the main technical contact for enterprise dental labs, building strong relationships and working closely with lab teams and their IT providers.   Upgrades & technical readiness:  Review hardware specifications, server/client setups and scanner compatibility, and coordinate larger upgrades across Lab Organizations, Dental System and Cloud Dongle.   Infrastructure & integrations:  Help customers establish scalable technical setups for 3Shape software and maintain an overview of LMS/ERP integrations, cross-lab workflows and new lab onboarding.   Technical support & troubleshooting:  Use strong knowledge of dental lab workflows and 3Shape Lab solutions to solve complex product, network and installation issues. Guide customers through upgrades, feature adoption and new workflow implementations. Support field engineers and technicians, and feed technical input back to R&D.   Proactive issue resolution:  Identify technical challenges before they impact customers and act as an escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and customer IT teams when needed. Keep technical product documentation updated as issues are identified and fixed, and build tests and diagnostic tools to catch recurring and potential issues.   Customer value & product feedback:  Support LabCare renewals, seat and scanner expansions, and adoption of new workflows, while bringing customer feedback and real-world dental lab use cases back into 3Shape. title: Customer Onboarding & Expansion Lead | Top Venture-Backed Auckland FinTech
description: Company Description  Extraordinary is a centralized employee benefits platform that helps employers distribute, manage, and report on meaningful perks with ease. At the core of the platform is the Extraordinary Card, a digital Mastercard that employers fund through flexible modules for corporate gifting, public transport, rewards and recognition, and controllable allowances. These modules enable organizations to deliver tax-efficient commuting support, real-time performance rewards, and targeted wellbeing or work-from-home benefits. The platform is designed to be simple for employers to implement and seamless for employees to use, creating a straightforward way to enhance workplace engagement. Extraordinary focuses on practical, trackable solutions that align benefits spending with company values and employee needs.      Role Description  As the Customer Onboarding & Expansion Lead, you will guide new customers through implementation, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to successful platform launch. You will design and run onboarding plans, configure account settings, coordinate with product and operations teams, and provide training sessions to ensure customers understand and adopt the Extraordinary Card and its modules. Day-to-day, you will monitor customer health, analyze usage trends, and identify opportunities to expand accounts through additional modules, increased adoption, and strategic upsell. You will act as a primary point of contact for key customer stakeholders, manage ongoing support needs, and collaborate with sales and product teams to improve the customer journey. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Auckland, requiring close collaboration with cross-functional teams and in-person engagement with customers as needed.      Qualifications    Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-centric mindset to build trust-based relationships and drive customer satisfaction.  Experience in customer support and account management, with the ability to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and guide customers through onboarding.  Solid analytical skills to interpret customer data, track adoption metrics, and identify expansion opportunities and risks.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills to deliver clear training, documentation, and stakeholder updates.  Background in SaaS, fintech, HR tech, or employee benefits environments is highly beneficial.  Proven experience in customer success, implementation, or onboarding roles, ideally with B2B clients.  Ability to work on-site in Auckland, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and operate autonomously within a fast-paced, venture-backed company.  Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Customer Success (ES)
description: Sobre el puesto:      En xNova International estamos creciendo y buscamos a un perfil motivado para unirse a nuestro equipo como Customer Success Specialist.     xNova es una startup de datos ubicada en Valencia, España, construyendo la inteligencia de referencia para el comercio internacional.  Ayudamos a empresas líderes a crecer y competir mejor en mercados exteriores, transformando datos complejos e incompletos de más de 150 países en inteligencia accionable.  Tras años construyendo la infraestructuras de datos de comercio internacional más sólida del mercado, hemos lanzado cobertura global y alcanzado un punto de inflexión en nuestro crecimiento. Ahora estamos preparados para escalar por Europa y consolidarnos como la capa de inteligencia del sector.  Desde Valencia, buscamos personas con ambición, energía y mentalidad de construcción para ayudarnos a crear una compañía de categoría internacional.     Si te apasiona construir relaciones con clientes, aportar valor a través de los datos y el entorno SaaS B2B ¡te estamos buscando!      ¿Por qué xNova?      Estamos transformando la manera en que las empresas exportan, proporcionando a los departamentos de exportación los datos y la tecnología que necesitan para identificar oportunidades reales y crecer con éxito en mercados internacionales.      La posición:    Acompañar a los nuevos clientes en su onboarding para garantizar una correcta activación del producto.  Comprender a fondo el contexto, procesos y objetivos de los clientes para ayudarlos a obtener el máximo valor de xNova.  Realizar formaciones y sesiones estratégicas periódicas con export managers, directores comerciales y otros usuarios.  Mantener comunicación constante con los clientes para resolver dudas.  Monitorizar el uso de la plataforma, identificar riesgos de churn y oportunidades de expansión (upselling/cross-selling).  Recoger feedback de clientes y colaborar con Producto para mejorar la plataforma.  Gestionar una cartera de cuentas activas a través de nuestra Customer Success Platform (Velaris), con el foco en la retención y el crecimiento del valor a largo plazo.  Brindar soluciones ad hoc y personalizadas a los clientes gracias a los últimos avances tecnológicos. En el día a día utilizarás herramientas como Claude para ayudar al usuario a sacarle el máximo partido a los datos.       Condiciones y beneficios :   Un equipo comprometido, cercano y con mentalidad de crecimiento.  Impacto real ayudando a las empresas exportadoras a crecer y tener éxito internacionalmente. title: Onboarding & Customer Success Specialist
description: Jet Studio è il prodotto di Jet HR pensato per semplificare la vita ai Consulenti del Lavoro. Tu li aiuterai a sfruttarlo al meglio.   Cosa farai  Il ruolo ha due anime.  Customer Support,  sei il punto di riferimento quotidiano degli studi:   Gestisci ticket e chiamate in arrivo su Zendesk, email e Slack, con l'obiettivo di risolvere problemi o dubbi il prima possibile.  Fai da ponte con prodotto e team tecnico. Raccogli e dai una struttura ai bug segnalati, porti dentro i feedback, segui i ticket perché vengano chiusi.  Costruisci e mantieni l'help center e i materiali di supporto. In modo che le domande ricorrenti si risolvano da sole.    Customer Success,  sei responsabile della vita dello studio con Jet Studio:   Onboarding.  Gestisci il passaggio di consegne dall'Account Executive, il setup della piattaforma e lo scambio documentale. Poi fai formazione allo studio - sessioni 1:1 o in gruppi, in presenza presso lo studio (raramente), oppure su Meet.   Adoption.  Ti assicuri che lo studio usi il prodotto per davvero: calendario presenze, portale azienda cliente, email forwarding, andando oltre le funzionalità base. È il lavoro che più di ogni altro determina se lo studio capisce il potenziale del prodotto.   Retention.  Monitori i segnali di rischio (adozione bassa, ticket ricorrenti, silenzi prolungati) e intervieni prima che diventino un mancato rinnovo.   Upsell.  Individui le opportunità di vendita, incluse quelle verso le aziende clienti dello studio.     Chi cerchiamo   Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di Customer Onboarding, Customer Success o Customer Support, preferibilmente in startup o contesti in rapida crescita.  Capacità di comunicare in modo semplice e strutturato, a voce e per iscritto: davanti a un consulente del lavoro, al collaboratore di studio o all’HR dell’azienda cliente dello studio.  A tuo agio al telefono e in videochiamata: buona parte del lavoro passa da lì, e serve saper ascoltare, cogliere quando qualcosa non è chiaro e riformularlo senza far sentire nessuno in difficoltà.  Attitudine a mettere ordine dove ancora non ce n'è: sei il secondo ingresso nel team, quindi ti troverai spesso a definire tu il processo invece di seguirne uno già scritto. Serve autonomia e la voglia di lasciare le cose meglio di come le hai trovate.     Cosa offriamo    RAL tra €25.000 e €37.000  a seconda dell'esperienza, composta da una parte fissa e una parte variabile legata a obiettivi di adozione, retention e soddisfazione degli studi   Lavoro ibrido.  Abbiamo l’ufficio a Milano. Per 2 giorni a settimana è richiesta la presenza, gli altri 3 flessibile. Senza essere fiscali, operiamo molto a buonsenso e siamo flessibili con gli orari. Due volte l'anno abbiamo un retreat di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet.      Founding member . Sarai il secondo hire del team Customer Support di Jet Studio: il tuo lavoro e le tue idee peseranno da subito, con ampio spazio per crescere di responsabilità.   Impatto concreto . title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: Job Title:  Enterprise Customer Success Manager   Type:  Full-time   Location:  Paris   What about us?   Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.  At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.  By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.  Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀   The Role   We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.  As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.  The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.  If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.   What do we want to achieve together?    First chapter — land it (through the migration)      Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.   Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme owner

description: [EN] Japanese business-level proficiency is required for this role. English is not required.     ■ このポジションについて  お客様の経営層（常務・事業本部長・CDO・事業責任者）と並走し、自社製品でお客様の事業数字を動かすポジションです。  担当は1人あたり10〜20社（エンタープライズ中心）。1社単位の高関与（High Touch）で深く入り込みます。  個社対応にとどまらず、業界別Playbookの構築とCSチームの型づくりに責任を持ち、加えて標準機能では実現できないご要望を、ご自身でカスタムAppとして形にするところまでを担当します。     海外ではAnthropicやOpenAIをはじめとする企業が「Forward Deployed Engineer」という職種を置いていますが、日本で「経営層と事業の話ができる」×「ご要望を自分で動くものに変えられる」の掛け算を持っている方はまだ多くありません。私たちはこの役割を、日本における「FDE型カスタマーサクセス」の第一期と位置づけています。FDEという肩書きをお約束するものではありませんが、ここで積む経験はまさにこの新しい職種のものです。     ■ なぜ今、募集しているのか  私たちのWeb改善プラットフォームは国内外で導入が拡大し、お客様の事業成長をさらに飛躍させるという新しいフェーズに入っています。  あわせて、新しい自社製品の提供を開始しました。お客様の企業の中で育っていくグロースシステムです。データインサイト／集客／サイト内コンバージョン／リピート購入／カスタム——複数のAppがお客様の実務に入り込み、データ・AI・日々の施策が一緒に蓄積されることで、次の判断がより速く、より正確になっていきます。     新しい製品の提供開始にともなって、提案先の層も変わりました。従来の部長・課長クラスに加えて、常務・事業本部長・CDOクラスの経営層と、事業そのものの話をする機会が増えています。  そこで必要になるのが、お客様の経営層と並走し、業界別の勝ち筋を構造化し、さらに技術的にも自分で判断できるリーダーです。ご要望をお聞きしてエンジニアに引き渡すのではなく、その場で「できます」「ここは難しいです」を助言できること。それがお客様との関係を一段変えます。     ■ キャリアの階段（実際の設計）  ・〜6ヶ月：既存の大手顧客を引き継ぎ、経営層との定期戦略対話を確立。並行してカスタムAppのコードを読み、軽微な改修から着手  ・1年目：お客様のご要望をその場で判断し、動くプロトタイプまでご自身で。業界Playbookの言語化を開始  ・1〜2年目：業界Playbookを3パターン言語化し、チームメンバーの育成を担当  ・3年目：領域Lead、5〜10名のCSMをリード、業界レポート発表——短期間でこの経験を積める環境は稀です     ■ 主な業務  ＜お客様と並走する＞  ・ご面談前の事前リサーチ。IR・中期経営計画・組織体制・競合動向をもとに、事実に基づく仮説を持って臨みます  ・担当エンタープライズ顧客の経営層・キーパーソンとの戦略対話（月次／四半期）  ・定期的な事業レビューの実施。事業数字への自社製品の寄与を整理  ・大型顧客のオンボーディング設計、活用深化（A/Bテスト・LPO・CRM連携・データ分析）  ・アップセル提案（ROI設計）、解約リスクの早期検知と再生プロジェクトのリード     ＜技術視点を活かす＞  ・お客様のご要望をその場で判断し、実現方法・必要なデータ・前提条件・お届けできる時期までを言語化する  ・標準Appでカバーできる領域と、カスタムAppで作るべき領域の切り分け  ・自社製品のSDKを用いたプロトタイプの設計・実装（次回ご訪問までにお持ちする、が基本の型です）  ・CRM／MA／BIツール等のデータ環境を踏まえた実現可否の判断と、自社製品のMCPを用いたデータ抽出     ＜組織に残す＞  ・業界別Playbookの構築／拡張  ・チームメンバーの育成・レビュー  ・現場で得た要件のProduct・Engineerチームへの還元     ■ この仕事の具体的な場面  ・商談中、お客様の役員から「外から買うSaaSではなく、社内で作れるようにしたい」というお話が出たとき。ここで話題を流さず、私たちの製品が目指している方向——お客様の社内にノウハウが残る形——につなげて議論を進めます。  ・デモの途中で「これ、CRMの商談ステージも一緒に見られますか？」と聞かれたとき。持ち帰らずに、参照するフィールド、必要な前提、いつお持ちできるかまでをその場でお答えします。  ・「BIツールでは1画面にまとめられなかった」というご相談。これは分析の話ではなくカスタムAppの案件だと見極めて、要件に落とし、次回ご訪問までにプロトタイプをお持ちします。     ■ 技術面について  現場でコードを書くことは求めていません。求めているのは、「できますか？」というご質問に対して、実現の筋道・必要なデータ・依存関係・お届けできる時期をその場で言語化できることです。  そのために、入社後1年以内に自社製品のSDKを用いてご自身でプロトタイプを構築できる水準への到達を期待しています。技術的なご経験がない状態からのキャッチアップも、社内サポートと生成AIツールの活用を前提に設計しています。     ■ 必須要件  ・BtoB事業領域での顧客折衝経験（目安5年以上）  ・経営層・意思決定者との折衝経験（提案／合意形成／条件交渉のいずれか）  ・プロジェクトまたはチームをリードした経験（人数規模は不問）  ・データに基づいて打ち手を設計し、相手を説得した経験（Excel／BI／GA4などツールは不問）  ・顧客の事業課題を構造化して言語化できる思考力  ・日本語：ビジネスレベル  ・AI／新しい働き方への前向きさ（ChatGPT／Claude等の日常活用に抵抗がないこと）  ※SaaS業界の経験は必須ではありません。  ※技術的なご経験も必須ではありません。入社後1年以内の到達水準として、社内サポートと生成AIツールの活用を前提に設計しています。  ※英語力は要件にありません。     ■ 歓迎する実務経験（いずれも必須ではありません。ひとつも当てはまらなくてもご応募いただけます）  ・戦略コンサル／マーケティングコンサル／事業企画の経験  ・お客様先に入り込み、要件定義から実装までを担ったご経験（SE／ソリューションアーキテクト／技術コンサル等）  ・B2B SaaSのHigh Touch CSM経験（担当社数10〜30社）  ・顧客経営層との戦略対話、複数階層との関係構築経験  ・業界別の勝ち筋を構造化した経験（業界レポート、Playbook作成）  ・SQL、REST API、SDKドキュメントを読んでご自身で手を動かせる方 title: HEAD OF CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description: À propos   L'ambition.  Fabriq fait rayonner l'industrie européenne en rendant l'usine plus compétitive et l'ouvrier plus autonome. Au-delà du logiciel, l'entreprise construit le projet de société de la relocalisation industrielle.   L'activité.  Fabriq est l'Operating System des ateliers de production. Sa plateforme SaaS digitalise les rituels de Lean Daily Management (AIC, SQCDP, QRQC, Hoshin Kanri, Gemba) pour résoudre les problèmes terrain 3 fois plus vite que le papier ou Excel. Devenu le leader européen de la digitalisation du Lean, Fabriq construit aujourd'hui la couche agentique de cette discipline.   Les preuves.     26 M€ levés au total, dont 22 M€ en juin 2025 menés par Expedition Capital.  Plus de 1000 sites équipés dans 60 pays, pour des leaders comme Safran, Airbus, Renault et LVMH.  Une équipe de 110 personnes qui joue collectif.    Descriptif du poste   Contexte :  Tu rejoins Thibaud (VP Customer) pour prendre la tête d'une équipe CS d'une dizaine de personnes, sur un portefeuille qui bascule du mid-market vers l'enterprise multi-sites et international.   L'Objectif :  Sécuriser le GRR (Gross Revenue Retention) et maintenir le churn sous 5 % sur le portefeuille enterprise, tout en industrialisant le CS.   Les Enjeux     Industrialiser le CS enterprise : Construire et déployer les playbooks d'adoption et de rétention, les cadences QBR, le health scoring et le capacity planning, en semaines et non en quarters.  Hisser les grands comptes au standard enterprise : Installer une discipline solide sur des clients multi-sites et internationaux, où la relation ne peut plus reposer sur un seul sponsor.  Faire progresser l'équipe : Amener le collectif vers le standard enterprise et faire grandir chaque CS, en coachant par l'exemple sur 1-2 comptes stratégiques.  Créer les conditions d'expansion : Démontrer la valeur au niveau ComEx et détecter les signaux d'upsell, en relais avec l'équipe AM.    Profil recherché   Les OBLIGATOIRES     Expérience : 6 à 10 ans en CS B2B SaaS, dont au moins 3 ans de management d'équipe CS.  Enterprise : 3 à 5 ans d'exposition à des comptes enterprise multi-sites dans un contexte de land & expand.  Track-record : Réduction de churn ou amélioration de GRR démontrée, chiffres à l'appui.  Structuration : A construit des playbooks d'adoption et de rétention from scratch, pas hérités.  Posture : Attrait fort pour la mission et le monde industriel. Envie d’aller se confronter au terrain, pas peur de se déplacer.  Langues : Français et anglais courants.     Les "PLUS" (optionnels) :     Usage avancé de l'IA dans les workflows CS.  Passage en scale-up en forte croissance ayant vécu une phase de structuration.  Appétence pour l'expansion et l'upsell.    Process de recrutement    Un premier échange avec Edouard, Talent Acquisition.  Un entretien avec Thibaud, VP Customer.  Un business case à traiter avec François, Co-founder et Thibaud.  Une étape culturelle et de fit avec François et Victoria (VP People).

title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.  The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.    Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    Position overview  GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management & Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.  This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.  You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.  What you will do  Set the regional customer-success strategy    Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.  Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.  Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.  Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.  Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.    Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: Customer Success Consultant   Word onderdeel van dé disruptor binnen PropTech. Je stapt in aan het einde van hun meest succesvolle jaar tot nu toe: één van de grootste onafhankelijke vastgoedbeheerders van Nederland, met meer dan 35.000 real estate properties in beheer, koos het platform als dé tech hub voor compliance en onderhoud over hun hele residentiële portefeuille.      Waar draait deze rol om?   Dit is je kans om van hospitality naar tech over te stappen zonder je servicegerichtheid in te ruilen voor targets. Geen omzetverantwoordelijkheid, wel alle impact van iemand die ervoor zorgt dat klanten daadwerkelijk waarde uit hun software halen.  Jij bent het gezicht voor vastgoedbeheerders die net zijn aangesloten en hun eerste gebouwdocumenten, certificaten en processen moeten onboarden. Waar zij vroeger tijd verloren aan losse mailtjes en zoekgeraakte documenten, zorg jij dat ze vanaf dag één overzicht en controle hebben.  Deze rol past bij iemand die energie krijgt van een klant die na jouw training zelfstandig verder kan, en die net zo lang doorvraagt tot een probleem écht is opgelost.      Jouw impact   Iedere vastgoedbeheerder die je succesvol onboardt, is een klant die blijft, meer gebruikt en het platform aanbeveelt. Je verzorgt trainingen en supportsessies, helpt mee aan opgenomen webinars als laagdrempelige kennisbron, en signaleert patronen in wat klanten lastig vinden — en pakt dat zelf op. Je bouwt duurzame relaties op met sleutelklanten en -partners in een markt die nog volop aan het digitaliseren is.      Het team waar je deel van uitmaakt   Je maakt onderdeel uit van het internationale customer success team, maar bedient de Nederlandse markt. Je werkt nauw samen met product en sales, zodat wat klanten nodig hebben ook echt landt in het platform.      Hoe je je ontwikkelt    Je leert een compleet nieuwe sector kennen: vastgoedbeheer, compliance en governance, vanuit de voorhoede van de digitalisering ervan.  Je bouwt ervaring op in SaaS customer success, waar jouw klantfeedback direct invloed heeft op het product.  Je werkt in een snelgroeiende, internationale scale-up waar rollen meegroeien met het bedrijf.       Wat je meebrengt    Een achtergrond in hospitality, customer success of een andere servicegerichte rol.  Je bent organisatorisch sterk, proactief en haalt voldoening uit klanten écht verder helpen.  Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.  Je hebt zin om te werken in een snelgroeiende, internationale scale-up.       Wat je ervoor terugkrijgt    Een salaris tussen €3.500 en €4.500 bruto per maand, excl. 8% vakantiegeld.  De kickstart van een SaaS-carrière, zonder dat je meteen commerciële targets aan je broek krijgt.  Pensioenregeling van 3% via Brand New Day.  Werken in een jong, ambitieus en internationaal team.  Groeikansen naar Customer Success Manager en senior posities.  Hybride set-up, laptop van de zaak en een e-sim zodat je je eigen telefoon kunt behouden.

title: Führungskraft (m/w/d) Eingliederungshilfe & Soziale Teilhabe
description:
Der Caritasverband Rheine e. V. sucht eine Leitung (m/w/d) der Abteilung "Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe", unbefristet in Vollzeit.

Die Caritas Rheine setzt sich als einer der größten Arbeitgeber der Region mit rund 50 sozialen Einrichtungen und Diensten für Menschen ein, die Unterstützung benötigen. Das umfangreiche Angebotsportfolio des Komplexträgers erstreckt sich über die Bereiche Familie, Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Gefährdeten- und Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe für suchterkrankte sowie psychisch kranke Menschen, ambulante und stationäre Pflege sowie Migration und Integration. Insgesamt stehen rund 1.800 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende sowie etwa 500 ehrenamtlich Engagierte den Menschen mit ihren individuellen Bedürfnissen zur Seite.

Die Abteilung Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe des Caritasverbandes Rheine e. V. begleitet Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Unterstützungs- oder Beratungsbedarfen. Menschen mit Behinderungen oder psychischen Erkrankungen befähigen wir, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilzuhaben. Mit den Caritas-Emstor-Werkstätten werden vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Teilhabe, Qualifizierung und persönlichen Entwicklung geschaffen. Im Jacob-Meyersohn-Wohnverbund unterstützen wir Menschen mit Behinderungen durch ambulante Angebote sowie in verschiedenen Wohnformen. Die Fachbereiche Ambulante Dienste und Existenzsicherung sowie Sozialpsychiatrische Dienste bieten Menschen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen umfassende Unterstützung. Dazu gehören unter anderem Wohnangebote in Gruppenform, Ambulant Betreutes Wohnen, psychosoziale Beratung, gesetzliche Betreuung sowie das Sozialkaufhaus. Im Haus St. Antonius in Bevergern erhalten Erwachsene mit psychischen Erkrankungen im Rahmen medizinischer Rehabilitationsmaßnahmen die Möglichkeit, neue Perspektiven zu entwickeln.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Berlin
description:
Deine Mission

Du übernimmst die volle strategische und operative Verantwortung für unser Performance Marketing mit Fokus auf Meta und Google. Du entwickelst zusammen mit der Head of Marketing die Kanalstrategie, planst und verantwortest das Budget und sorgst für eine kontinuierliche Skalierung bei stabiler oder wachsender Effizienz.

Du arbeitest eng mit der Head of Marketing sowie Content/Design zusammen.

Diese Stelle entsteht im Zuge unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase, in der wir unser Marketing-Team ausbauen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Performance-Marketing-Strategie für Meta und Google eigenverantwortlich entwickeln, inklusive Budget-Forecasting und Kanal-Mix-Entscheidungen
  • Meta-Ads-Kampagnen eigenständig aufsetzen, skalieren und optimieren (Paid Facebook, Paid Instagram, Advantage+) inkl. strukturiertem Creative Testing auf Basis klarer Hypothesen

  • Ein systematisches Testing- und Measurement-Framework aufbauen, inklusive Incrementality Testing und sauberer Attribution über alle Kanäle hinweg
  • Server-seitiges Tracking und Conversion-Setups (u. a. Meta Conversions API, Google Enhanced Conversions) verantworten und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln
  • Landingpages gemeinsam mit Content/Design kontinuierlich testen und auf Conversion optimieren
  • Unsere Tool-Landschaft (Pipedrive, Make, HeyFlow) mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln (von der Lead-Übergabe bis zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Prozesse)
  • SEA-Maßnahmen eigenständig verantworten und SEO-Grundlagen im Blick behalten
  • Marketing-KPIs und Unit Economics (CTR, ROAS, CPL, MQL, Conversion Rate, Qualifikationsrate, CAC, LTV) laufend auswerten, forecasten und in Budget-Entscheidungen übersetzen

description:
Für einen etablierten mittelständischen Anlagenbauer aus der Umwelt- und Verfahrenstechnik suchen wir aktuell eine:n Business Development Manager (all genders).

Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert anspruchsvolle Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasserbehandlung und begleitet seine Kunden über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette vom Konzept bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf dem Auf- und Ausbau eines gesetzlich getriebenen, europaweit wachsenden Marktsegments.

Aufgaben

  • Sie treiben den Auf- und Ausbau eines wachsenden europäischen Marktsegments für die 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination (EU und Schweiz) voran und verantworten dabei den gesamten Weg von der Priorisierung relevanter Länder und Märkte bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Sie sprechen Anlagenbetreiber, Kommunen sowie Planungs- und Ingenieurbüros gezielt an und begleiten diese entlang der Phasen öffentlicher Vergabeverfahren im Bereich der Wasseraufbereitung.
  • Sie kalkulieren und erstellen technische Angebote, führen Verhandlungen und begleiten Ausschreibungsprozesse.
  • Sie beraten Betreiber und Planungsbüros zu passgenauen Anlagenlösungen und arbeiten dabei partnerschaftlich zusammen.
  • Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb und Projektabwicklung und bringen Impulse zur technischen und organisatorischen Weiterentwicklung des Produktbereichs ein.
  • Sie entwickeln länderspezifische Markterschließungsstrategien vor dem Hintergrund der aktuellen regulatorischen Entwicklungen.

title: Customer Success Manager Legal AI
description: Lefebvre Sdu is misschien wel de oudste AI-startup van Nederland. Niet omdat we voorop lopen in technologie, maar omdat we de kennis hebben waar die technologie op draait. Die bouwen we al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat is niet te kopiëren. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, bouwen we GenIA-L: een AI-platform waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken iemand die zorgt dat ze het ook echt anders gaan doen.      HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT   Een licentie afsluiten is één ding. Een kantoor zijn werkproces laten herzien rond AI is iets anders. Juristen en fiscalisten werken zoals ze werken omdat het al jaren zo gaat, en een nieuw platform verandert daar uit zichzelf niets aan. Iemand moet naast ze gaan zitten, kijken hoe hun dossierwerk er nu uitziet en laten zien waar GenIA-L dat werk overneemt of versnelt. Daarvoor moet je dat werk zelf hebben gedaan. Jij hebt jaren in de praktijk gestaan. Je weet hoe een dossier wordt opgebouwd, waar de uren in gaan zitten en waarom een professional niet zomaar vertrouwt op een antwoord dat hij niet kan narekenen. Die geloofwaardigheid is je belangrijkste instrument: wanneer jij tegenover een partner zit, praat je met iemand uit hetzelfde vak. Je bent daarmee de belangrijkste ambassadeur van het product, naar buiten én naar binnen. Wat jij bij klanten ziet, breng je terug, want de beste roadmap-input komt van mensen die het platform elke dag proberen te gebruiken.      Je begeleidt klanten van livegang tot volwassen gebruik, en je stuurt op adoptie in plaats van op tevredenheid.  Je analyseert de werkprocessen van juridische en fiscale teams en vertaalt die naar een concrete inrichting van GenIA-L.  Je traint gebruikers en interne key users, zodat kennis over het platform bij de klant blijft.  Je meet gebruik, signaleert waar adoptie stokt en grijpt in voordat een verlenging in gevaar komt. title: Senior Lead Customer Success
description: Functieomschrijving     Geloof jij dat complexe technologie eenvoudig kan zijn?    En kan je andere mensen meenemen in dat geloof, terwijl jullie tegelijk klanten laten groeien, upsell-kansen pakken, en zorgen dat churn daalt? Dan zoeken we jou!   Over Workspace 365    Bij Workspace 365 bouwen we aan één ding: werk eenvoudiger maken. Voor partners. Voor hun eindgebruikers. Dag in, dag uit. Dat klinkt simpel. Maar het vraagt iets van ons. Het vraagt om mensen die niet tevreden zijn met "zo is het nu eenmaal", maar die zien dat IT-complexiteit weg kan.    Jouw rol    Als Senior Lead Customer Success geef je leiding aan vier Customer Success Managers en drie Technical Success Managers. Je brengt structuur, inspiratie en commerciële scherpte in het team. Je houdt overzicht over de status van je klanten: wie loopt risico op churn, wie heeft aandacht nodig en wie biedt kansen op upsell. Je zorgt dat je team dat overzicht net zo scherp heeft en dat de dagelijkse focus daarop ligt. Je maakt duidelijk waarom dat ertoe doet: het is goed voor de klant, maar het zijn ook onze targets, onze omzet en onze groei. Je neemt zelf deel aan gesprekken met grote klanten, ziet waar kansen op meer omzet liggen en durft te sturen op resultaat. Commercie is voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van customer success.    Dit ben jij:      Je gelooft dat complexiteit kan verdwijnen, in processen, in tools en in de manier waarop teams werken. Je neemt geen genoegen met plannen die niet landen. Wordt een target niet gehaald? Dan zoek je uit waarom en los je het op.   Je motiveert liever dan dat je opdrachten geeft. Je neemt je team mee in het waarom, zodat ze niet volgen omdat het moet, maar omdat ze voelen dat het ertoe doet.   Je ziet commercie als onderdeel van succes. Je begrijpt dat klanten moeten groeien en partners moeten verdienen, en dat wij daarin meegroeien. Je spreekt makkelijk over targets, NRR en upsell-kansen, en je stuurt er ook op.      Vereisten     Wat vragen we van jou?      Minstens vijf jaar saleservaring. Ervaring in customer success is een pré, maar een ervaren salesmanager is ook welkom.   Vijf jaar ervaring in leidinggeven.   Een commerciële mentaliteit. Je begrijpt NRR, upsell, churn en portfoliomanagement, en je stuurt er actief op. Omzet en groei zijn voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een KPI waar je dagelijks naar handelt.   Nederlands en Engels op niveau.   Een hbo- of wo-opleidingsachtergrond.       Wat krijg je van ons?     Autonomie:     Je krijgt eigenaarschap en vertrouwen. Je weet samen met je team waar jullie naartoe werken en bepaalt zelf hoe. Je krijgt vrijheid, en de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort.   Je ziet je impact terug. Partners die groeien, eindgebruikers die productiever worden en churn die daalt. Ook je team voelt dat resultaat.   Je krijgt ruimte om te bouwen. We hebben plannen, maar niet alle antwoorden al klaar. Zie jij een betere aanpak? Dan luisteren we.      Geld:     €5.900 tot €6.800 euro bruto

title: Partner Success Manager, Data & Content
description: Job description   Vesper is a commodity market intelligence platform for the food and beverage industry. Buyers, sellers and traders use it to see where prices sit today, where they are heading, and what that means for what they pay or charge. Dairy, oils, sugar, grains, cocoa, coffee, eggs, meat, nuts, freight, packaging and more.  None of that works without data. Our benchmarks and forecasts are built on data from partners: traders, exchanges, industry bodies, publishers, processors. Every new partner fills a gap in what we can show customers, or makes an existing benchmark better. That is the part of the business you would own.  Our partner network has grown fast and keeps growing: new commodities, new regions, and a serious push into the US. It now deserves someone who owns it full time.  This is a commercial role. You keep the relationships we have strong, negotiate licensing terms with data owners, lead renewals, and find the next opportunity inside a relationship that already works. Direct access to commercial leadership:  Small team, short lines, quick decisions. Larger agreements you co-sign with the Head of Partnerships, who you report to.   You sit where the product gets made:  Data Research turns partner data into benchmarks and Product set where we grow coverage next, so the effect of a deal you close is visible in the platform.   Your work directly enables our product and commercial teams:  Our partners provide critical data and capabilities that make Vesper more valuable. Partnerships ensure Sales and Customer Success have the right partner offering to sell and deliver value to customers.   Bring structure and make it happen:  We won’t hand you a playbook. You’ll be expected to identify where we need more structure, come up with your own ideas and solutions, and then execute them. We value strategic thinking, but we need someone who turns ideas into action.   Get out of the office:  Roughly four to six trips a year to trade events and partner visits around the world, meeting the people you work with face to face.      What you'll be doing    Own the partner relationships:  You are the person our data partners call. You run a review cadence that matches how important each partner is, visit the key ones face to face, and never let a relationship rest on a single contact.   Lead renewals:  You own the renewal calendar and every conversation on it. A renewal is a commercial moment, not paperwork: wider scope, longer term, better commercials, more rights.   Negotiate with data owners:  Licensing models, pricing, exclusivity, redistribution and attribution rights, how data may be used

The Profiles Platform team owns Klaviyo’s core customer data system, the foundation that powers every product experience across the platform. You’ll work at the intersection of data infrastructure, computed data, and scalability, ensuring that profile data remains trustworthy and performant as Klaviyo grows into more complex enterprise and global use cases. This is a high-impact platform role where your work will directly influence nearly every product team and customer experience. Please note that this is an onsite role that requires 5 days/week in our Boston office. Fully remote candidates will not be considered at this time.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s core profile data system, including profile traits, transformations, and storage layers
  • Serve as the product owner for the source of truth for customer data across the platform
  • Partner closely with engineering to evolve profile data architecture and services at massive scale
  • Collaborate with the Identity, Data, and Consent teams to ensure accurate and unified customer records
  • Drive improvements in profile data quality, usability, and modeling for downstream consumers (segmentation, flows, analytics, AI)
  • Enable enterprise and global expansion by supporting data residency, compliance, and regional infrastructure requirements
  • Define and track key metrics around data quality, performance, and system efficiency

title: Instandhaltungstechniker (m/w/d) Werkstudent:in
description:
Du möchtest nicht irgendeine Anlage warten, sondern eine Technologie betreuen, die es so weltweit kein zweites Mal gibt? ⚡ 

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Die Technologie nutzt bestehende Straßeninfrastruktur, um aus dem darüberfahrenden Verkehr erneuerbare Energie zu gewinnen, ohne dafür zusätzliche Flächen zu benötigen. 

Als Instandhaltungstechniker in Hamburg übernimmst du die technische Betreuung des dort installierten Straßenkraftwerks. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Anlage zuverlässig läuft, führst Wartungen und Reparaturen durch und gehst technischen Störungen systematisch auf den Grund. 

Dabei übernimmst du nicht einfach bestehende Abläufe. Da es sich um eine völlig neue Technologie handelt, gestaltest du aktiv mit, wie Wartung, Service und Instandhaltung zukünftig aufgebaut werden. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem laufenden Betrieb fließen damit direkt in die weitere Entwicklung der Serviceprozesse ein. 

Deine Benefits

  • Einzigartige Technologie: Betreue das weltweit erste Straßenkraftwerk im laufenden Betrieb und arbeite an einer GreenTech Technologie, die es in dieser Form bisher nirgendwo sonst gibt.  

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue gemeinsam mit dem Team Wartungspläne, Serviceprozesse und Instandhaltungsstrukturen auf, anstatt lediglich bestehende Abläufe zu übernehmen.  

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Arbeite 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit einem Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen verbinden lassen.  

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Übernimm die technische Betreuung der Anlage in Hamburg und erhalte viel Freiraum be

description: About Tapi   Tapi is a high-growth SaaS company revolutionising property maintenance with innovative software solutions. With a strong presence in New Zealand and Australia, we help property managers streamline their operations through seamless automation and smart integrations.  Tradies get a rough deal out of property maintenance. They chase the quote. They chase access. Then they chase the money — and do the invoicing at the kitchen table after dinner.  Tapi helps trade businesses run maintenance work without the admin grind. We’re building software that makes it simpler to quote, schedule, communicate, invoice and get paid — and we’re on a mission to improve the property maintenance experience for everyone.  The job  You own Tapi’s trade network in New Zealand — who’s on it, how well they use it, and how fast it grows. You’re their person: the number they call when something’s not right.  Write the playbook, so every market is quicker than the last. What you’ll bring  You’ve sold to tradies, and you were good at it. You’ll run your own pipeline without being asked twice, hold a straight conversation about money without folding when someone pushes, and still be going hard in month nine when the easy yeses are gone. Persistent, never a pest — a tradie who says no today should still take your call next month.  How we work  We have five values. Dans ce contexte, et au sein d’un groupe en croissance à la culture entrepreneuriale, vos principales missions seront :   • Gérer et développer un portefeuille clients diversifié (banques privées, CIF, sociétés de gestion privée, sociétés de Private Assets)   • Assurer le suivi des nouvelles demandes clients concernant l'évolution des outils, la mise en place de nouveaux produits et services   • Piloter des projets pour le compte de nos clients en collaboration avec les autres métiers du Groupe   • Analyser et résoudre les anomalies de second niveau liées à l'activité   • Participer au process de commercialisation et notamment à l’élaboration d’offres commerciales   • Mettre en œuvre les tableaux de bord et le reporting sur la qualité de service   Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles de ODDO BHF Asset Servicing, les équipes IT ainsi qu’avec les autres métiers du Groupe pour être en mesure de proposer et de piloter la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées aux besoins de nos clients.       Votre équipe et votre environnement   Créé en 2003 et fondé sur l'expertise de nos équipes, ODDO BHF Asset Servicing est un prestataire de services IT et back office pour le compte de clients institutionnels (banques privées, CIF, sociétés de gestion privée, d’OPC et de Private Equity ainsi que de compagnies d'assurance).   ODDO BHF Asset Servicing propose des services de tenue de comptes, traitement des opérations, conservation des avoirs ainsi que d’autres services à valeur ajoutée. Grâce au développement de sa propre offre de logiciels front et à l’expertise de ses équipes, ODDO BHF Asset Servicing propose des solutions sur mesure pour des clients exigeants.       Les compétences que vous développerez    En tant que collaborateur au sein de ODDO BHF Asset Servicing dans un Groupe à taille humaine en pleine croissance, vous :  •Développerez vos connaissances sur les activités de dépositaire et teneur de comptes  •Développerez votre compréhension du marché et de la concurrence sur ce secteur d’activité  •Serez associé(e) à des projets Groupe en lien avec l’activité de nos clients  •Développerez vos capacités à travailler dans un environnement exigeant  •Le poste proposé est riche et formateur, au sein d’un Groupe et d’un métier très dynamique et ambitieux, ce qui offre de réelles perspectives d’évolution sur un horizon de 3 à 4 ans.         Votre rémunération   Nous vous proposons une rémunération adaptée à votre profil et à vos compétences. Cette rémunération s’articule autour d’un élément fixe, d’un bonus discrétionnaire faisant l’objet d’un arbitrage individualisé à chaque fin d’année ainsi que de la participation.  Notre ambition est d’attirer et de développer les meilleurs talents en leur proposant notam

title: Key Account Manager sökes till Martin & Servera i Stockholm
description: Kan du sälja med omtanke?  Vi på Martin & Servera levererar mat, dryck och tjänster till restauranger och storkök, över hela Sverige. Som marknadsledare driver vi utvecklingen framåt och jobbar varje dag hårt för att göra varje dag lite godare, alltid på ett sätt som skapar en mer hållbar bransch. Och som Key Account Manager är du en viktig del av helheten. I ditt säljarbete bygger du goda relationer med våra kunder, utifrån deras behov och din passion för mat och dryck. Med omtanke om kunderna och kunskap om deras vardag, stärker och breddar du deras affärer, på kort och lång sikt. Du blir också en del av en stark intern gemenskap där vi jobbar tillsammans, stöttar varandra och har roligt ihop. Vi söker nu en Key Account Manager till vårt team i Stockholm.   Ett hållbarhetsarbete i framkant.    För oss är hållbarhet inte bara ett fint ord utan en självklar del av precis hela vår verksamhet. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av det arbete som vi tillsammans gör varje dag för att bidra till en hållbar framtid.   Stabilt och långsiktigt.    Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.   En varierande vardag.    Du skapar goda relationer, räknar på affärer, driver försäljning och bidrar till lönsam tillväxt. Att stötta och utveckla våra kunders verksamhet, ha koll på trender och koppla ihop våra kunder med våra specialistbolag, är en naturlig del av jobbet. Hos oss får du en händelserik och varierande vardag där din kompetens är viktig.   Vi erbjuder dig.    Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som till exempel ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdande bidrag och lunchsubvention. Vi utmanar oss själva och värdesätter prestationer på samma sätt som vi värnar om en bra balans mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan. För oss är det viktigt med en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö, därför utför vi slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester på våra arbetsplatser.   För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har     Ett stort intresse för människor och är duktig på att skapa goda relationer.  Ett genuint intresse för mat och dryck är ett stort plus.  En eftergymnasial utbildning och erfarenhet av att jobba i CRM är meriterande.  Erfarenhet från tidigare arbete inom försäljning och/eller restaurangbranschen  Ett boende i Stockholm med omnejd.  B-körkort är ett krav för rollen.     Hur går rekryteringen till?    Vi jobbar aktivt för mångfald och ser olikheter mellan människor som en styrka. Med målet att spegla våra kunder och samhället vi verkar i, söker vi människor i alla åldrar och med olika bakgrunder. I alla våra rekryteringar använder vi oss av personlighetstest. Det är för att kunna jämföra kandidater på ett så rättvist sätt som möjligt. Vi gör också bakgrundskontroller. Läs mer om rekryteringsprocessen på vår hemsida.   Sista ansökningsdag : 20 september 2026   Tillträde : Enligt överenskommelse   Anställningsf

title: Key Account Manager
description: Om selskapet   Sensio er et norsk selskap innen velferdsteknologi som løser dagens og morgendagens utfordringer innen eldreomsorg, for beboere, pasienter, helsepersonell og samfunnet. Vi utvikler sensorer, systemer og plattformer som radikalt forbedrer kvaliteten og effektiviteten i helse og omsorg, og leder bransjen mot å omfavne teknologi for å gi #MoreTimeForCare.     Siden starten i 2009 har Sensio vokst til rundt 240 ansatte og en omsetning på mer enn en halv milliard globalt. I 2024 fikk Sensio inn ny hovedeier i Nordic Capital, en av Europas ledende vekstinvestorer med omfattende erfaring fra skalering av helseteknologi.     Sensio har hovedkontor i Oslo, med kontorer også på tvers av Norge, Sverige, Danmark og Tyskland, samt et distribuert team i Storbritannia. Selskapet har ambisjoner om å bli markedsledende innen velferdsteknologi i Europa, og jobber med Nordic Capital i ryggen for å akselerere transformasjonen av eldreomsorgen mot en helt ny måte å jobbe på: Digitalt Først.      Om rollen   Som Key Account Manager får du et tydelig kommersielt ansvar for å videreutvikle Sensios eksisterende kundeforhold. Du får ansvar for en egen portefølje av kommuner og private helseaktører som allerede har rammeavtale med Sensio. Din oppgave blir å identifisere uutnyttet potensial, utvikle nye muligheter og omsette dette til salg og videre vekst.        I denne rollen legger du tiden din der potensialet er størst. For å gjøre de riktige prioriteringene må du kjenne kundene dine godt, forstå virksomheten deres og se hvor Sensios løsninger kan skape mer verdi. Målene dine tar utgangspunkt i potensialet hos den enkelte kunde. Du avdekker nye behov og bygger forretningscase som gjør det tydelig for kunden hvorfor de skal utvide samarbeidet med Sensio. Du får dermed stor frihet til å styre egen portefølje og drive salgsarbeidet fremover.     Rollen er i utvikling, og du får være med på å forme hvordan Sensio jobber med vekst i eksisterende kundeporteføljer. Du samarbeider tett med Account Executive, som henter inn nye kunder til porteføljen din, og med Customer Success, som sikrer at kundene får reell verdi av løsningene i praksis. Sammen dekker dere hele kundereisen, fra nye kunder til videre utvikling av kundeforholdet. Rollen innebærer en del reisevirksomhet, for å møte kundene dine ansikt til ansikt. Som en del av salgsteamet rapporterer du til salgsdirektør.      Ansvarsområder    Utvikle og følge opp en portefølje av eksisterende kunder, med mål om økt bruk og kommersiell vekst  Avdekke nye behov hos kunden, og bygge forretningscase for å realisere disse  Forhandle avtaler, priser og vilkår innenfor eksisterende rammeavtaler og følge opp over tid  Samarbeide tett med Account Executive og Customer Success for å sikre gode overganger og helhetlig oppfølging av kunden  Holde oversikt over bruk og potensial i porteføljen gjennom data og innsikt, og rapportere på fremdrift  Representere Sensio på messer og konferanser, og bidra til å styrke selskape

title: Key Account Manager
description: Own Waikato's Key Client Portfolio. Build Relationships. Drive Long-Term Growth.   We're looking for an experienced relationship-focused professional to take ownership of our Waikato key client portfolio while supporting a select number of strategic clients across New Zealand.  Based in Hamilton, you'll be responsible for some of our most important client relationships, ensuring commitments are delivered, communication is proactive, and opportunities for long-term partnerships are identified. Working closely with clients and operational teams, you'll help ensure Argus continues to deliver the service, quality and responsiveness our clients have come to expect.   What You'll Be Doing     Take ownership of the Waikato Key Client portfolio and act as the primary account management contact.   Manage and support a select portfolio of strategic clients operating across multiple regions.   Develop and maintain Account Management Plans and Service Delivery Plans.   Build strong relationships with key decision makers and client stakeholders.   Lead client review meetings, reporting and account planning activities.   Work alongside branch and operational teams to ensure client expectations are understood and delivered.   Monitor contract performance, service delivery and client satisfaction.   Identify and pursue organic growth opportunities across the portfolio.   Ensure client information, reporting and account records are maintained accurately.      Why this role is different   You'll take ownership of a significant Waikato key client portfolio while also supporting a select number of strategic clients across New Zealand. This creates a unique opportunity to combine strong local relationships with broader business influence.  Working closely with clients, branch teams and senior stakeholders, you'll play a key role in ensuring client expectations are understood, service commitments are delivered, and long-term partnerships continue to grow.  This is a role for someone who enjoys building trusted relationships, creating alignment between clients and operational teams, and making a genuine impact on client outcomes.  You'll have the autonomy to manage your portfolio, the support of experienced operational teams, and the opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of both the Waikato business and the wider organisation.   About You   You're an experienced relationship manager who enjoys working with people, building trust and creating long-term partnerships.   You'll Bring     Experience in Key Account Management, Account Management or Client Relationship Management.  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  Commercial awareness and a customer-focused mindset.  The ability to coordinate multiple priorities and build alignment across teams.  Experience working with service contracts, compliance environments or operational service businesses.  Strong planning, organisation and follow-through.  A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

title: Key Account Manager - KSA Nationals
description: Job Summary   The Key Accounts Manager is responsible for managing assigned modern trade key accounts, achieving sales targets, developing account plans, negotiating agreements, and ensuring strong coordination across sales, marketing, finance, and distribution functions. title: Key Account Manager
description: Aurora Innovation är ett av Sveriges mest snabbväxande bolag inom digital hälsa – med en tydlig ambition: att förändra hur vården möter sina patienter.    Vi tror på en vård där patienten har en tydlig och tillgänglig ingång, oavsett kanal. Genom lösningar inom telefoni, callback, AI, video och digital patientkontakt skapar vi bättre tillgänglighet för patienter samtidigt som vi avlastar vårdpersonalen. Genom att samla all patientkommunikation i en sammanhållen digital plattform hjälper vi vårdgivare att effektivisera arbetsflöden, minska administrationen och skapa en mer hållbar arbetsmiljö. Idag används våra lösningar av majoriteten av Sveriges regioner och privata vårdgivare.  Våra system utgör en central del av vårdens digitala infrastruktur där miljontals patientmöten passerar genom plattformen varje dag runt om i Europa.  Vi är redan en viktig del av framtidens vård – men vi är långt ifrån klara.  Aurora Innovation befinner sig i en stark tillväxtfas med höga ambitioner och söker nu en Key Account Manager som vill vara med och utveckla både affären och vården. Här får du en central roll i ett bolag där innovation, samhällsnytta och kommersiell utveckling går hand i hand. Du ansvarar för att utveckla befintliga kundrelationer, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och driva komplexa affärer genom hela säljprocessen.  Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare inom både offentlig och privat sektor och bygger långsiktiga partnerskap med fokus på att skapa verkligt affärs- och verksamhetsvärde.  Försäljningen sker både direkt mot slutkund och via partners och återförsäljare, vilket innebär ett nära samarbete genom hela affärsprocessen.  Du arbetar även nära marknadsfunktionen för att säkerställa en sömlös och konsekvent kundupplevelse genom hela kundresan – från första kontakt till ett långsiktigt partnerskap.  Internt samarbetar du tätt med Customer Success, produktteam och övriga kommersiella funktioner för att skapa bästa möjliga kundvärde. I rollen rapporterar du direkt till Sales Director Northern Europe.  Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med hög kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och en kultur som präglas av samarbete, utveckling och ett gemensamt driv att ständigt förbättra både affären och vården. title: Key Account Manager - Frequent Travel Required (30-50%)

Trusted by Alaska Airlines, Airbus Helicopters, the Los Angeles Police Department, and more, we serve the full aviation ecosystem – spanning commercial airlines, eVTOLs, and diverse helicopter operators, as well as schools, OEMs, governments, and regulators. Classify relevant customer requirements and provide them to the Head of KAM as input to the consolidated customer and market evidence base and to commercial and product-related decisions. title: Senior Account Manager
description: About the Role   We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to join the Launch Agency operations team.  This role owns a portfolio of retainer and ad hoc clients end to end. You'll run the relationships, hold the delivery accountable, and make sure every client gets what they're paying for, on time and to scope. It sits at the point where client expectations meet internal execution, and it's the role that keeps those two things aligned.  You'll report into the Operations Manager and work across strategy, media buying, content, web development, and SEO.      About Launch Agency   Launch Agency is a creative-first performance agency operating across Australia and New Zealand. We've driven over $1 billion in directly attributed revenue for our clients.  Creative-first means what it says. We don't treat creative as the thing that gets made after the media plan is signed. Creative is the variable that moves performance, so it leads the work and everything else is built around it.  We combine:   Paid media (Meta + Google)  Creative production (content, video, design)  Web development (Webflow + Shopify)  Strategic advisory (fractional C-suite)   We work directly with business owners to help them grow through better acquisition, positioning, and execution.      What You'll Be Doing    Owning a portfolio of retainer and ad hoc clients end to end, from onboarding through to ongoing delivery and growth  Running weekly and fortnightly WIPs and client check-ins, with clear agendas, documented outcomes, and follow-ups that actually get closed  Making sure every project lands to scope, on time, and within budget, and escalating early when any of those three are at risk  Spotting account risk before it becomes churn, and activating and running recovery plans on at-risk accounts  Leading client onboarding against our onboarding plan so new accounts start properly rather than drifting  Owning Monday.com accuracy across your portfolio, including task definition, scoping, assignment, and workflow status  Reviewing Harvest time tracking and cost allocation so we know what each account actually costs to service  Coordinating with strategy, media buyers, content, web, and SEO to align priorities and keep delivery moving  Directing the Operations Coordinator on administrative execution and workflow tracking  Working with sales and strategy to identify and initiate upsell opportunities across your accounts  Partnering with the Operations Manager to build and embed better processes across the agency       What We're Looking For    5+ years in client services, account management, or project management, ideally in an agency or fast-paced client-facing environment  Proven ability to run multiple accounts and retainers at once without dropping quality or deadlines  Strong project management skills with hands-on experience in Monday.com, Harvest, or similar  A working understanding of performance marketing, including lead generation, conversion, CPL, and ROAS  Commercial

title: Account manager
description: Egloo è una società tecnologica indipendente di Milano. Lavoriamo con brand di alto profilo su progetti web e digital experience, e con aziende industriali e PMI strutturate su software su misura, integrazioni ERP/MES e soluzioni AI. Progettiamo e realizziamo internamente le soluzioni che proponiamo, mantenendo un rapporto diretto tra cliente e team lungo tutto il progetto.  Lavoriamo con team piccoli, guidati da persone senior, con un approccio diretto e una forte attenzione alla qualità del lavoro e all'apprendimento continuo.      La posizione:   L’Account Manager che cerchiamo ha un mandato doppio: far crescere la relazione con i clienti che già lavorano con noi e trasformarla in nuove opportunità di business. Sarai la persona che, progetto dopo progetto, diventerà il punto di riferimento del cliente: ne segui le aspettative durante la delivery, ne intercetti i bisogni e costruisci le condizioni per far crescere il rapporto nel tempo. description: Frontline & Backline Supervisor   Vil du være med til at skabe Danmarks bedste kundeoplevelser?  Hos DHL Express ved vi, at engagerede medarbejdere skaber loyale kunder. title: Konevuokraamon esihenkilö
description: Haemme Rovaniemen toimipisteellemme    Vuokraamon esihenkilöä    vastaamaan vuokraamon toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti.    Ramirent Finland Oy on Suomen suurin palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa konevuokrauksen rinnalla laaja-alaisesti palveluita rakennusalan ja teollisuuden asiakkailleen. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme maanlaajuisesti yli 500 luotettavasta ammattilaisesta koostuvan henkilöstön voimin. Ramirent kuuluu Loxam-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista konevuokraamoista. Haluamme panostaa toimintamme ensiluokkaiseen asiakaskokemukseen sekä pitkiin asiakassuhteisiin, mikä onnistuu osaavien ja innostuneiden työntekijöiden avulla. Ramirent on arvostettu ja pidetty työpaikka, mistä tunnustuksena meille on myönnetty kansainvälisesti arvostettu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Toimimme työnantajana vastuullisesti, teemme töitä turvallisessa työympäristössä ja huolehdimme henkilöstön ammatillisesta kehityksestä, terveydestä sekä hyvinvoinnista. Lisätietoa yrityksestä:   https://rakennatyopaikkasi.ramirent.fi/    Ramirent vuokraa työkoneita ja -laitteita asiakkaiden työmaille ympäri Suomen. Ramirentin toimintaperiaatteisiin kuuluu niin laadukkaan palvelun kuin tuotteiden tarjoaminen, mikä tarkoittaa hyvin huollettua kalustoa ja asiantuntevaa henkilöstöä.    Etsimme hyvillä esihenkilötaidoilla ja asiakaspalveluasenteella varustettua jämäkkää ja energistä tekijää. Esihenkilönä vastaat mm. toimipisteen asiakaspalvelusta, kalustosta, tuloksesta, työturvallisuudesta sekä tavoitteiden asettamisesta henkilökunnalle. Isona osana työstäsi osallistut tiimisi rinnalla päivittäiseen työhön. Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen ja mielekkään työporukan. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisia urapolkumahdollisuuksia kansainvälisessä org
