Finance Manager

Hybrid (UK-based) | Full-Time

Flexibility on how often you come into the office, as long as you're able to travel to the London office when required.

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Manager to own the operational management of our finance function — accurate, timely management accounts, statutory accounts oversight, and the processes and controls that keep our finances reliable as we scale. You'll run month-end close, own balance sheet reconciliation and cash flow, lead the team responsible for AR/AP, payroll, VAT, and HMRC processes, and bring the analytical rigour that helps us make good financial decisions as we grow.

You'll also manage external relationships (auditors, solicitors, bankers), support external investment and funding activity, and run accounts across multiple business entities, including regulated entities in different geographies.

  • Month-end close and reporting

Am Standort werden Produkte und Komponenten von der ersten Idee über die Konstruktion und Erprobung bis hin zur Serienreife entwickelt. In dieser zentralen Rolle verantworten Sie die konstruktive Entwicklung und technische Betreuung von elektrischen Kontaktteilen und Terminals von der Konzeptphase bis zur Serienreife.   • Koordinieren und Bewerten von Messungen, Versuchen und Funktionsprüfungen sowie Ableiten notwendiger Optimierungen

Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Our Passive Investing approach follows a systematic four-factor model, combining Growth, Value, Momentum and Size factors to deliver diversified and cost-efficient market exposure.      Why do experienced Relationship Managers join LeoVest?      Every person has their own reasons.  Some are looking for greater entrepreneurial freedom.  Others want to become true partners rather than employees.  Many are looking for a firm with modern infrastructure, an outstanding team and a culture of partnership where decisions are made together. title: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC
description: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC | German-speaking    Remote in Germany | One week per month in Vienna    €60,000–€70,000      What if you could take ownership of CRM across six consumer brands, with the freedom to build the capability as the business grows?     Acquire is the exclusive search partner to a rapidly growing European DTC business. Its ecommerce operation currently generates approximately €9 million, with plans to reach €20 million over the next two to three years.     CRM will play a central role in that growth. The foundations are in place, including Klaviyo and a migration from Magento to commercetools, but there is significant scope to improve how the business acquires, retains and develops its customers.      The role   This is a hands-on position combining strategic ownership with practical execution. You will:   Build and optimise automated customer journeys  Develop customer segmentation and personalisation  Improve first-to-second purchase conversion  Increase retention, repeat purchase and reactivation  Manage email campaign planning and delivery  Use customer and commercial data to identify opportunities  Support the introduction of a new loyalty programme  Measure CRM revenue and commercial performance  Work across multiple brands, markets and ecommerce teams      You will have the freedom to shape the CRM roadmap while remaining close enough to the detail to build campaigns, automations and segments yourself.      About you   You will ideally bring:   Native or near-native German and professional English  Three to five years of meaningful CRM experience  Experience within ecommerce, DTC or a consumer-led digital business  Hands-on experience building lifecycle campaigns, automations and segments  A strong understanding of retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value  The ability to connect CRM activity with revenue and wider commercial performance  Confidence working directly within a CRM platform      Klaviyo experience would be particularly useful, although comparable platform experience will be considered. Subscription, loyalty or pet-sector experience would be helpful but is not essential.     This will suit someone who wants more than responsibility for campaign delivery. As the business grows, the intention is to build a broader CRM function around this role, creating a genuine opportunity to progress into team leadership.     You can be based remotely in Germany, provided you can spend one working week per month at the company’s Vienna office

title: Service- og personalechef - Kalundborg
description: Service- og personalechef  Har du en stærk lederprofil, interesse i personalepleje og -administration, og kan du løfte ansvaret for alle HR-relaterede opgaver i varehuset?  Som service- og personalechef i føtex indgår du i varehusets ledelse og refererer til varehuschefen.  Du har overblik og er en dygtig leder, der kan tænke bredt og strategisk, og som gennem udvikling af og uddelegering til dine medarbejdere kan skabe resultater og gode indkøbsoplevelser for vores kunder. Du har et stort overblik, der gør, at du kan sikre, at procedurer og retningslinjer bliver overholdt.   Bliv en del af sammenholdet i føtex    Hos føtex deler vi en vinderånd og en stolthed over at gøre det hele lidt mere lækkert. Vi er sammen om at give kunderne en ekstra god service og tilbyde de bedste varer i en indbydende butik med højt til loftet. Vi er dog ikke større end, at alle kender alle, så du kan se frem til at blive en del af et stort sammenhold og få en masse nye kolleger.   Dine opgaver og ansvarsområder      du skal sikre, at der bliver udfærdiget ansættelseskontrakter til alle medarbejdere  du har overordnet ansvar for elever og praktikanter i varehuset  du er overordnet lønansvarlig  du supporterer de øvrige ledere huset i anvendelsen af vores rekrutteringssystem  du er bemandingsansvarlig for serviceenheden  du er personaleansvarlig for medarbejdere i serviceenheden, så du skal fastholde og udvikle enhedens medarbejdere, rekruttere nye medarbejdere og afholde afdelingsmøder    Nøglen til denne stilling er stærk ledelse og godt overblik. For det er gennem god planlægning, strategisk tankegang og fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling, du leverer de gode resultater.   Skab en karriere i en af Danmarks største varehuskæder    Vi ved, at når vores medarbejdere bliver dygtigere, så bliver føtex det også. Derfor bidrager vi hellere end gerne til din faglige udvikling, og hvis du mangler enkelte kompetencer eller har specifikke udviklingsønsker, tilbyder vi en lang række interne kurser som supplement til den daglige sparring.  Kan du løfte opgaven som service- og personalechef i føtex, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden.   Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.    I 1960 åbnede Herman Salling den første føtex i Guldsmedgade i Aarhus og startede med det samme en indkøbsrevolution, der stadig er i gang. I dag er vi godt 15.000 kolleger, der brænder for at levere service; hurtigt, høfligt, trygt og troværdigt. Du kan komme med på holdet i et af vores over 90 varehuse eller 11 føtex food convenience-butikker. Vores historie er din vækst.

title: Servicechef
description: Är du redo för nästa utmaning?    Får du energi av omväxling och snabbt tempo i en föränderlig miljö?  Nu söker vi en Servicechef till vår avdelning i Visby, som kan vara med och utveckla vår serviceverksamhet inom ventilation, VS, el, fastighetsdrift, säkerhet och automation.   Välkommen med din ansökan!    Ditt nya jobb   Som servicechef på Bravida har du ett helhetsansvar över vår serviceverksamhet, vilket innebär både ekonomi- och personalansvar. I dina arbetsgifter ingår:    Att utveckla och bevara kundrelationer  Att ansvara för avtal och ekonomiska resultat, teknisk kvalitet och dokumentation i uppdrag  Att organisera, leda och engagera medarbetare  Att arbeta med kalkyl och prognosarbete  Arbete med bland annat inköp, resursplanering och kvalitets- och arbetsmiljöarbete  Att vara delaktig i Bravidas förbättringsarbeten och utveckla serviceverksamheten     Som servicechef på Bravida får du frihet under ansvar. Vi tror på din förmåga att överträffa kundernas förväntningar genom din kunskap, ditt driv och ditt intresse.   Ditt nya team   På Bravida Visby är vi cirka 80 medarbetare inom entreprenad och service. Avdelningen leds av avdelningschefen, tillsammans med servicechefen som ansvarar för sitt team inom service, som består av cirka 40 medarbetare. Avdelningens uppdrag sträcker sig från entreprenader till mindre serviceuppdrag. Vår styrka är vår bredd av kompetens och vårt breda utbud av tjänster, helhetslösningar och ett nära samarbete mellan service och entreprenad. Vi är ett gott gäng som jobbar tätt tillsammans och som värdesätter att ha roligt på jobbet!   Vi söker dig som   Vi söker dig som sätter människan i centrum! Du är genuint intresserad av att utveckla både individer och team och du skapar en miljö där alla känner sig sedda, hörda och viktiga. Med tydlighet, omtanke och höga förväntningar inspirerar du medarbetarna att ta ansvar, samarbeta och prestera på sin högsta nivå. Du vet att de bästa resultaten skapas när människor trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans.  Du har erfarenhet av servicearbete inom installationsbranschen samt har erfarenhet och intresse av säljarbete och att skapa goda kundrelationer. Vi ser gärna att du har teknisk examen eller motsvarande med flerårig erfarenhet inom ventilation och VS. Arbetet som servicechef kräver ofta snabba beslut och ageranden, vilket ställer krav på en stor problemlösningsförmåga och förmåga att kunna hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt. Du har också ett intresse och kunskaper inom ekonomi och uppföljning. Du behärskar Office-paketet och andra IT-verktyg väl. Det är viktigt att du har lokal förankring i Visby med omnejd. B-körkort är ett krav.   Bravida som arbetsgivare   På Bravida är vi stolta över att leverera känslan när allt bara fungerar. title: Kunnossapidonn työnjohtaja
description: Haluatko esihenkilörooliin, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen?  Salmen Metallilla työnjohtajana toimit kunnossapidon arjen keskiössä ja vaikutat suoraan asiakkaiden tuotannon sujuvuuteen, turvallisuuteen ja tehokkuuteen.      Tässä tehtävässä  yhdistyvät ihmisten johtaminen, kunnossapitotöiden koordinointi, projektien läpivienti sekä toiminnan jatkuva kehittäminen. Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten kunnossapito- ja projektitehtävien parissa eri teollisuusympäristöissä ja näet konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutukset asiakkaiden arjessa.  Salmen Metallilla kunnossapito on paljon enemmän kuin vikojen korjaamista. Olet mukana suunnittelemassa, priorisoimassa ja kehittämässä toimintaa yhdessä asiakkaiden, oman tiimin ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Saat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, miten työt tehdään nyt ja tulevaisuudessa.      Työnjohtajana johdat  noin 8–10 hengen osaavaa tiimiä, johon kuuluu kunnossapitoasentajia ja levyseppähitsaajia. Vastaat kunnossapitotöiden, asennusten ja projektien sujuvasta toteutuksesta sekä siitä, että työ etenee turvallisesti, laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa. Päivät koostuvat henkilöstön johtamisesta, resurssien suunnittelusta, asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä, käytännön ongelmanratkaisusta sekä erilaisten projektien koordinoinnista. Satunnaiset työmatkat Kuopion ulkopuolelle tuovat tehtävään mukavaa vaihtelua.      Tarjoamme sinulle  vastuullisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän vakavaraisessa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Saat tueksesi osaavan ja sitoutuneen tiimin sekä työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan käytännönläheistä tekemistä, yhteistyötä ja halua kehittää toimintaa jatkuvasti. Työsuhde solmitaan joko Eilakaislan kautta tai suoraan Salmen Metallin palvelukseen.      Odotamme sinulta  kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidon työnjohdosta sekä kykyä suunnitella, aikatauluttaa ja priorisoida töitä järjestelmällisesti. Menestyt tehtävässä, jos johdat tiimiäsi rauhallisella ja ratkaisukeskeisellä otteella, viihdyt vaihtelevissa tilanteissa ja nautit siitä, että pääset työskentelemään sekä ihmisten että teknisten kokonaisuuksien parissa. Soveltuva tekninen koulutus, kuten insinöörin tai teknikon tutkinto, tukee tehtävässä onnistumista. Työskentely tapahtuu pääosin suomeksi, ja englannin kielen perustaidot riittävät kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa toimimiseen.      Jos etsit tehtävää, jossa pääset yhdistämään esihenkilötyön, projektit, kunnossapidon asiantuntemuksen ja toiminnan kehittämisen, tämä voi olla juuri sinulle oikea seuraava askel urallasi. title: ICT Operations Manager con tedesco
description: L’ ICT Operations Manager  è la figura professionale che  progetta, gestisce e controlla l'intera infrastruttura ICT  di una specifica azienda.   Tra le sue responsabilità si possono citare:      L’ identificazione di eventuali inefficienze  dei sistemi in uso, fornendo puntuali proposte risolutive;     La  definizione dei tempi e dei costi dei progetti ;     Il  coordinamento dei team  che sviluppano e gestiscono le componenti dell’infrastruttura ICT.          Inoltre, egli garantisce che l’azienda sia in possesso delle strutture e dei servizi ICT di cui necessita e che le migliorie e le nuove implementazioni siano conformi agli standard aziendali.   Tra i  principali compiti  che l’ ICT Operations Manager  si trova a svolgere vi sono:       Supervisionare i sistemi e le infrastrutture  di sua competenza, sottoponendoli a test periodici;      Stabilire il work-flow complessivo e le deadline  dei vari team che coordina;      Monitorare lo stato di avanzamento dei progetti ;      Definire i KPI  (Key Performance Indicator) che ogni team dovrebbe portare a termine;      Verificare l’efficienza operativa dei processi ICT  dell’intera azienda;      Gestire eventuali problemi tecnici  legati all’infrastruttura ICT;      Assicurarsi che tutti i servizi ICT siano correttamente sottoposti alle misure di sicurezza ;       Stabilire quali miglioramenti  si possono apportare ai sistemi;      Valutare eventuali investimenti ;      Gestire il budget stanziato  per le infrastrutture di sua competenza;      Controllare che i sistemi e le infrastrutture ICT rispondano alle regole e agli standard imposti  dagli stakeholder.         ICT OPERATIONS MANAGER: LE PRINCIPALI CARATTERISTICHE:      Fra le principali  hard skill  proprie di un  ICT Operations Manager  ritroviamo:     Conoscenza del  funzionamento delle principali infrastrutture ICT  e dei  sistemi di networking      Conoscenza dei principali  sistemi operativi ;     Conoscenza del funzionamento dei database r elazionali e non relazionali .     Tra le  principali soft skill  che un  ICT Operations Manager  possiede vi sono:     Capacità  organizzative e di gestione del tempo ;     Capacità di  interpretare le richieste  altrui;     Capacità di  identificare l’ordine delle priorità ;     Capacità di  gestione del cambiamento ;     Capacità di  analisi ;     Spiccate doti  comunicative ;     Doti  relazionali  tramite le quali rendere l’ambiente di lavoro collaborativo;     Predisposizione alla  leadership collaborativa ;       Flessibilità .     ​    L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di pari opportunità e non discriminazione (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006).  Valutiamo con interesse persone motivate, curiose e orientate alla crescita professionale, desiderose di contribuire a progetti innovativi in un contesto tecnologico dinamico e collaborativo.      ​     Experis è la società IT & Technology del Gruppo Manpower. title: [쿠팡이츠서비스] Business Automation Program Manager (Business & Operations)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.      업무내용    쿠팡이츠 배달 서비스 전반의 Customer Experience(CX) 품질을 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 이슈를 조기에 감지·대응할 수 있는 운영 체계를 구축합니다.  주문 퍼널(App 진입 → 검색 → 장바구니 → 결제 → 주문 완료) 전반의 핵심 지표를 관리하며, 이상 징후를 탐지하기 위한 모니터링 프레임워크 및 Detection Logic을 설계합니다.  인시던트 발생 시 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 준수 여부를 모니터링하고, 표준화된 대응 프로세스를 고도화합니다.  SOP가 정의되지 않은 신규 이슈 발생 시 Strategy, Product, Engineering, Operations, Merchant 등 주요 Stakeholder 및 Leadership Team과 협업하여 대응 체계를 수립하고 신속하게 에스컬레이션합니다.  자동 Alert 시스템, 운영 대시보드(Control Panel), 비즈니스 자동화 솔루션을 기획 및 구축하여 운영 효율성과 문제 탐지 정확도를 향상시킵니다.  실시간 데이터 기반으로 서비스 이상 징후를 분석하고, 전사 영향도 및 Root Cause를 파악하여 개선 과제를 도출합니다.  고객 경험 개선, 비용 효율화(Cost Efficiency), 고객 리텐션 향상을 위한 운영 전략 및 서비스 로드맵을 수립합니다.  AI 기반 운영 도구 및 Workflow Automation을 활용하여 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고 확장합니다.  VP 및 Director 레벨을 포함한 전사 리더십과 협업하며 주요 운영 지표, 인시던트, 프로젝트 성과를 공유하고 의사결정을 지원합니다.  한국 및 일본 시장을 포함한 글로벌 운영 환경에서 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 리딩합니다.       자격 요건    총 10년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Process Improvement, Service Operations 분야 중 하나 이상의 경험을 보유하신 분  데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 해결 방안을 도출한 경험이 있는 분  서비스 모니터링 체계, 운영 프로세스 또는 Incident Management 프로세스를 구축하거나 개선한 경험이 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations 등)와 협업하며 프로젝트를 성공적으로 리드한 경험이 있는 분  복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 실행할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분  Senior Leadership(VP, Director급) 대상 커뮤니케이션 및 의사결정 지원 경험이 있는 분  비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분       우대 사항    배달, 커머스, 모빌리티, 플랫폼 서비스 등 대규모 운영 환경에서의 경험을 보유하신 분  Customer Experience(CX) 개선 또는 Customer Journey Optimization 경험이 있는 분  Incident Management, Emergency Response Team(ERT), Site Reliability, Service Operations 관련 경험이 있는 분  KPI 모니터링, 이상 징후 탐지, Alerting System 구축 경험이 있는 분  SQL, Python 등을 활용한 데이터 분석 경험을 보유하신 분  Airflow, Workflow Automation, API 연동, ETL Pipeline 등 비즈니스 자동화 구축 경험이 있는 분  Tableau, Looker, Power BI 등 Dashboard 및 Monitoring System 구축 경험이 있는 분  AI 기반 운영 자동화 또는 AI Tool 활용 경험이 있는 분  일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 수준의 Ownership을 가지고 문제를 해결한 경험이 있는 분       근무지    선릉 HJ 타워       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

title: Operations Manager
description: About The Opportunity     Join a stable and well-established organisation in a hands-on Operations Manager role, taking ownership of day-to-day operations across a large-scale, high-volume environment.  Lead a team of supervisors and operational staff, with responsibility for performance, service delivery, people management and daily operational requirements.  Oversee fleet availability and allocation, working closely with internal maintenance and support teams to ensure resources are available and operational requirements are met.  Monitor operational KPIs and performance data, identifying trends, implementing improvements and ensuring service, safety and compliance targets are consistently achieved.  Manage real-time operational challenges, from staffing and scheduling through to incidents, customer queries and unexpected changes, ensuring issues are resolved quickly and effectively.     What You’ll Bring      Proven experience in operations, logistics, fleet management or another high-volume operational environment, with experience leading people and managing day-to-day service delivery.  Strong leadership skills, with the confidence to manage performance, make decisions and take control in a fast-paced environment.  A highly organised and process-driven approach, with the ability to plan, prioritise competing demands and keep operations running smoothly.  Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with confidence interpreting KPIs, identifying trends and using data to drive improved operational outcomes.  Resilience and composure under pressure, combined with a hands-on approach and the ability to communicate effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.     What’s on Offer     A genuine opportunity to take ownership of a significant operational environment and make a tangible impact on performance.  A broad leadership role combining people management, fleet coordination, KPI management, process improvement and daily operational decision-making.  A stable organisation with long-term operational commitments and a strong focus on service delivery.  Genuine career progression opportunities for a high-performing leader, with a focus on developing internal talent and future leadership capability.     Next Steps? title: Senior IT Project
description: NEVERHACK  ( https://neverhack.com/it ) è un gruppo francese specializzato in cybersecurity.  Fondato nel 2021 e con sedi in 11 paesi, il gruppo conta oggi più di 1200 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.  Siamo alla ricerca di un  Senior IT Project / Service Manager  con esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti IT complessi e servizi continuativi per clienti enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. La figura sarà responsabile del governo operativo di commesse, milestone, budget, rischi, SLA e relazione con il cliente.      Responsabilità principali    Pianificazione, coordinamento e controllo di progetti IT complessi.  Gestione di SAL, milestone, deliverable, budget e avanzamento economico.  Presidio degli SLA contrattuali e della qualità del servizio erogato.  Coordinamento di team tecnici, fornitori e stakeholder di progetto.  Gestione dei rischi, delle criticità e dei piani di mitigazione.  Produzione di reportistica direzionale e comunicazioni verso il cliente.       Competenze tecniche    Project Management, Service Management e governance IT.  Framework ITIL e metodologie Agile/Waterfall.  Gestione contratti, SLA, OLA, budget e consuntivazione.  Strumenti di project tracking, ticketing e reporting.  Conoscenza di infrastrutture, applicazioni e servizi ICT enterprise.       Competenze trasversali    Leadership operativa e capacità di coordinamento.  Forte orientamento al cliente e alla delivery.  Capacità di gestire pressione, priorità e situazioni critiche. title: アルムナイ専門SaaS×コンサル｜カスタマーサクセス／コンサルタント
description: ▍募集背景   アルムナイ専門サービス「オフィシャル・アルムナイ」を通じて、企業とアルムナイを繋ぐネットワークを構築し、そこから生まれる価値創出に伴走するカスタマーサクセス/コンサルタントを、事業拡大に伴い募集いたします。      ▍ハッカズークが創る、新しいHRの未来     「退職で終わらない、企業と個人の新しい関係を実現し、退職による“損失”のない社会をつくる」    私たちは、日本における「企業アルムナイ（退職者）」領域のパイオニアとして、国内No.1の専用SaaS『Official-Alumni.com』とコンサルティングサービスを提供しています。各業界のリーディングカンパニーが私たちのパートナーです。  2026年からは、採用業務支援のレイン社との合併を経て、企業の人的資本経営を包括支援する「BBB（Buy＝採用、Build＝育成、Borrow＝外部人材活用）のプラットフォームになる」という新Visionを掲げ、加速度的な成長を推進しています。      ▍なぜ今「アルムナイ」が最高に面白いのか？     ｜「日本の人事史に名を刻む」歴史の転換点に、当事者として立ち会う    長年、日本の雇用慣行において退職者は「裏切り者」と見なされ、関係が断絶されるのが一般的でした。しかし、深刻な労働人口減少とキャリアの多様化、および人的資本経営の潮流により、退職者は「重要な社外のパートナー（資産）」へと再定義されつつあります。「退職＝損失」というこれまでの当たり前を根本から覆し、「別れを資産に変える」という新たな社会常識を日本中にインストールする——このパラダイムシフトの最前線を走るのが、ハッカズークです。       ｜「採用」の枠を遥かに超える、無限の市場性と本質的な価値    アルムナイネットワークがもたらす価値は、単なる「出戻り採用（Buy）」にとどまりません。業務委託（Borrow）としてのプロフェッショナル協業、新規事業のビジネスアライアンス、人材育成（Build）としてのアルムナイメンターや社外講師、それらの先に自社ブランドのファン・ユーザー化など、その可能性は無限です。  私たちが切り拓いているアルムナイ市場は、従来のHR（人材紹介や求人広告などの単発スポット取引）とは一線を画す、企業と個人が対等に、ライフタイムで価値を創出し続ける「新しいHRインフラ」です。だからこそ、提案の幅に制限はありません。     ｜   正解がないブルーオーシャンで、自ら「勝ち筋」を定義する    アルムナイ市場には、他社を模倣できるような既成の「コンサルティングの型」がありません。日本を代表するエンタープライズ企業の経営層や人事部長と対等に向き合い、「この企業とアルムナイの最適なリレーションとは何か」をゼロベースで共に描き、実行します。  自身がクライアントと創り出した企画がメディアに大きく取り上げられ、そのまま日本の新しい常識になっていく。パイオニアであるハッカズークだからこそ、唯一無二のダイナミックな経験を積むことができます。      ▍具体的な業務内容/ミッション   クライアント（主に大手エンタープライズ企業の人事部門や経営層）と伴走し、アルムナイネットワークを活用した企画立案・プロジェクト推進をお任せします。  すでに決まった制度設計の枠組みを当てはめるのではなく、ゼロベースでお客さまと一緒に「アルムナイと企業の新しい関係」を創り出していくポジションです。     ｜具体的な業務    アルムナイ施策の戦略・戦術設計および実行支援    ミッションは、顧客企業が目指すべき「あるべき姿」を共に描き、その実現に向けて価値を広げていくためのパートナーとして伴走することです。主に、以下を想定しております。  ・アルムナイの取り組みの目的の整理やKPI/KGIの設定  ・現状の課題分析やアルムナイネットワークによる成果創出に向けた施策の提案  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）分析/ヒアリングをもとにした改善案の提案       アルムナイコミュニティの立ち上げ・運用    「すべての人（アルムナイ）にとって、居る理由がある場所をつくる」という想いのもと、アルムナイとの関係性を構築しながらコミュニティ運営をしていくことが、私たちのミッションです。  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）へのインタビュー  ・コンテンツ作成チームと連携したアルムナイ向け配信コンテンツ企画  ・イベント運営チームと連携した交流会やアルムナイ向けイベントの企画     その他、個社の目的別にカスタマイズした施策の提案を行なっています。新しい領域かつ答えがないため、「これをやったら必ず上手く行く」というシンプルなものではありません。そこが難しくもあり、面白いところでもあります。単なる運用コンサルティングに留まらず、ネットワークの新たな価値を創るため顧客最適で提案をカスタマイズしていけることが醍醐味です。  また、このフェーズだからこそ、手を挙げれば誰でも、クライアント支援にとどまらず、プロダクトや事業づくり、サービス開発にも関わることができます。スタートアップならではの環境をご自身のオンリーワンのキャリア形成に活用したい方、大歓迎です。      ▍ポジションの魅力   コンサルタントの介在価値が非常に高く、自らが手掛けた企画が社会的なニュースとして取り上げられるなど、世の中に大きなインパクトを与えることができます。決まった成功体験（勝ち筋）をなぞるのではなく、あなた自身のアイデアで成功事例を創り出せる環境です。     事例1：「アルムナイメンター制度」  アルムナイネットワークにいる人材を活用し、キャリア自律の観点から退職者を巻き込んだメンター制度の構築を支援。日経新聞に大きく取り上げられました。  実際の記事はこちら     事例2：「カムバックイベント」企画  結婚や出産で退職された女性社員の方々に向けた、お子さん連れOKのカムバックイベントを企画・実施。こちらもメディアの密着取材が入るなど、大きな反響を呼んでいます。  実際の記事はこちら      ▍対象となる方   ｜必須要件  以下2つのご経験を”いずれも”お持ちの方  ・法人に対するソリューション型の営業経験（提案営業経験）  ・提案したことを形にするための、課題解決に向けたプロジェクトの推進・ディレクション経験（社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込んだ経験）  ※人事・HR業界の経験や、人事コンサルティングの経験は【不問】です！     ｜歓迎要件  ・大手企業（エンタープライズ領域）に対するアカウントマネジメント経験  ・無形商材を用いた企画提案の経験  ・イベント企画やコンテンツ制作などのディレクション経験     ｜求める人物像  ・既成の枠組み（決まったコンサル手法）を当てはめるだけでなく、ゼロベースで自ら考えることができる方  ・クライアントの成功に向けて、枠に囚われず「なんでもやる」スタンスを持てる方  ・IPOを目指す過渡期のフェーズにおいて、整っていない環境（カオス）を楽しみ、自ら道を作っていける方      ▍諸条件   詳細はこちら

title: Commissioning Manager

description: Company Description  Data-Centric Engineering Sdn Bhd is a Malaysia-based engineering company focused on delivering high-quality, data-driven solutions for industrial and infrastructure projects. The organization emphasizes the integration of engineering expertise with advanced analytics to improve performance, reliability, and safety. Team members collaborate closely with clients and partners to design, implement, and optimize technical systems that meet strict regulatory and operational standards. Role Description  The Commissioning Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing commissioning activities for engineering projects, from pre-commissioning to final handover. Day-to-day tasks include developing commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules; supervising site commissioning teams; conducting functional and performance tests; and ensuring that all systems are installed and operating according to design specifications, safety regulations, and client requirements. Sound knowledge of relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and quality assurance practices applicable to commissioning and start-up.  Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams and external contractors.  Ability to analyze technical issues, troubleshoot system performance, and recommend practical solutions under time and resource constraints.  Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal); proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia is an advantage.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or related discipline) or equivalent professional experience.  Previous experience in a managerial or supervisory role in commissioning or project execution is highly beneficial.  Willingness to work on-site, adhere to safety requirements, and occasionally travel to project locations if required.

Programorganisasjonen etableres med et langsiktig perspektiv og skal danne grunnlaget for gjennomføringen av fremtidige investerings- og utviklingsprogrammer i Nammo. Rollen vil derfor ikke bare bidra til realiseringen av Linje 4, men også bli en del av et miljø som skal videreføres og utvikles i takt med selskapets videre vekst og investeringsagenda.     For å sikre vellykket gjennomføring av IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser søker vi en erfaren Project Manager IT/Digitalisering som kan lede digitalisering som en integrert del av etableringen av fremtidens produksjonskapasitet og industrielle plattform. Rollen skal etablere og lede IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser som en integrert arbeidsstrøm i programmet og sikre at disse gjennomføres i tråd med programmets mål, milepæler og styringsmodell. Das macht deinen Job spannend     Spannende und vielseitige S/4HANA-Projekte (Private Cloud & Public Cloud) bei erfolgreichen Weltmarktführern und Hidden Champions im österreichischen Markt.  Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung internationaler SAP ECC-, SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud- und Public Cloud Transformations- sowie Rollout-Projekte mit nachhaltigem Impact auf die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden   Führung und Inspiration interdisziplinärer Projektteams in einem internationalen Umfeld – mit dem Anspruch, gemeinsam außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen   Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer Strategien und Lösungen zur nachhaltigen Optimierung globaler SAP-Systemlandschaften und digitaler Geschäftsmodelle   Proaktives Erkennen von Herausforderungen und Risiken sowie Erarbeitung pragmatischer und wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Lösungsansätze mit Fokus auf Qualität, Effizienz und Kundenerfolg   Analyse, Design und Transformation von Geschäftsprozessen, um Unternehmen fit für die digitale Zukunft zu machen   Aktive Mitwirkung im Presales sowie Aufbau langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Kundenpartnerschaften auf Executive-Ebene   Mitgestaltung unserer Unternehmensentwicklung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Projektmanage

title: Solutions Consultant, Post Sales, Mid-Market
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

You'll act as the technical and financial subject matter expert across the customer lifecycle — running product demonstrations to expand customers onto new Ramp products, while bringing the depth needed to resolve complex ERP integrations, configuration challenges, and technical blockers.

You'll collaborate closely with Account Managers to assess requirements, design scalable solutions, and ensure fast time-to-value as customers grow with Ramp. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role requires strong technical skills — comfort with APIs, ERP systems, and integration architecture — paired with the communication ability to translate complexity into clear business value for finance and operations stakeholders.

This role is focused on Commercial and Mid-Market customers, supporting high-growth companies with standardized financial workflows and core ERP integrations.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Supplier Network Growth
description:
Product Marketing Manager, Supplier Network Growth

Location: Remote - Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, Thailand

About Worldly

Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story.

About The Role

This role sits at the center of Worldly's supplier side business, in the region where most of the network actually lives. East and Southeast Asia is home to tens of thousands of the manufacturers on the Worldly platform. How well we reach them, how easy we make it to join and get value, and how clearly we tell them what's in it for them, all of that runs through this seat.

You'll own the marketing that helps suppliers find Worldly, buy in, get onboarded, and stay. You'll make the global message land in local markets. And you'll be the person making sure the supplier voice shows up in how we position, build, and sell. The supplier purchase experience is a direct revenue driver, so the words, the flow, and the in-product messaging all move the numbers.

You'll report to the Senior Director, Product Marketing and work shoulder to shoulder with the Regional Supplier Engagement and Lifecycle teams in Hong Kong.

What You'll Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for the global supplier audience: the factories, manufacturers, vendors, and others who buy and complete assessments on Worldly.

  • Drive the supplier purchase and onboarding experience. Suppliers buy through Worldly directly, so you'll help reduce friction and lift the rate at which they find us, buy, and finish their first assessment.

  • Make the value obvious and specific. One assessment that satisfies many brand customers. Less time lost to repeat audits. A path to win new business with the 350+ buyers already on the network. Your job is to make that real, not abstract.

  • Adapt the global message for local markets. Translate, localize, and reshape so it's culturally relevant and lands the way it should across the region's biggest supplier markets.

title: Customer Success Manager (H/F)
description: Nos convictions sur l'évolution de la GRC La GRC d'aujourd'hui fonctionne comme il y a vingt ans : captures d'écran en guise de preuves, revues annuelles, contrôles vérifiés a posteriori. Pendant ce temps, les SI se déploient plusieurs fois par jour, l'IA générative redessine les surfaces d'attaque chaque trimestre, et NIS2, DORA, AI Act, CRA empilent des exigences que personne ne peut tenir manuellement.  Nous pensons que le métier doit basculer vers ce que la communauté appelle  GRC Engineering , une discipline formalisée dans le manifeste collectif grc.engineering : appliquer à la gouvernance, au risque et à la conformité la même rigueur d'ingénierie que celle qui a transformé le développement logiciel (Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD). Concrètement : inverser le flux (partir des systèmes réels, pas des référentiels descendants),  automatiser tôt et souvent  plutôt que de subir le travail manuel répétitif,  raisonner par la preuve et la donnée  plutôt que par la peur et l'à-peu-près,  viser des résultats mesurables sur le risque  plutôt qu'une conformité de façade, et passer d'un contrôle périodique en surface à une  assurance continue en profondeur.   Mindlapse construit la plateforme qui rend ce changement opérationnel pour les grands comptes français et européens : un produit AI-native où l'IA, les agents et l'automatisation sont des primitives de conception, et où la conformité devient une propriété mesurée en continu sur les systèmes réels du client. Pourquoi ce poste, et pourquoi maintenant Nos premiers grands comptes sont déployés. Un produit AI-native ne se vend pas une fois : il se prouve chaque trimestre, dans l'usage réel des équipes Cyber, conformité et métiers. La valeur qu'un client perçoit à 12 mois dépend autant de la qualité du delivery et de l'adoption que du produit lui-même.  Jusqu'ici, ce rôle est tenu par les trois fondateurs (Hervé, Julien, Christophe, anciens Openminded et Accenture). Nous cherchons la personne à qui le confier.  On ne cherche pas un CSM au sens classique, qui suit des tickets et déroule un script, ni un account manager qui pousse de l'upsell, ni un chef de projet qui déroule un planning. On cherche les trois à la fois, dans un seul cerveau : quelqu'un qui porte la relation avec nos clients, qui répond de la qualité de ce qu'on leur livre, et qui fait que le produit soit réellement utilisé. Un profil de confiance, au plus proche des clients, avec une vraie expérience de la GRC, et qui partage la conviction ci-dessus.  À 3 ans, tu auras piloté la relation avec des RSSI et des directions conformité du CAC 40 / SBF 120 sur un sujet que peu de gens maîtrisent, et tu auras posé les bases du customer success d'un éditeur qui a l'ambition de redéfinir la GRC en Europe. Ce que tu feras au quotidienRelation client (~30%)   Être l'interlocuteur de référence de nos clients grands comptes après la signature : RSSI, équipes GRC, conformité, DSI, achats.    Piloter la gouvernance de la relation : comités

title: Fältserviceledare
description: Vill du vara med och säkra samhällskritisk infrastruktur och ha en samordnande och koordinerande roll där avtalsuppföljning är en stor och viktig del? Då kan det här vara tjänsten för dig! Vi söker nu en fältserviceledare.      LFV ansvarar för flygtrafikledning och utveckling av framtidens flygtrafiktjänster. Inom CNS (Communication, Navigation & Surveillance) säkerställer vi att den tekniska infrastrukturen som möjliggör säkra flygoperationer fungerar dygnet runt, året om.      Som fältserviceledare kommer du ha en betydande roll att tillsammans med MCF (Myndigheten för civilt försvar) säkerställa att fältleveransen levereras enligt samverkansöverenskommelsen med MCF. Ansvara för operativ utveckling av samverkansöverenskommelsen, dagliga arbetssätt, samt uppföljning av det operativa arbetet i både de interna och externa fältteamen. Deltaga i möten Fält UE och mot MCF där Fält krävs.  Sammanställa behov för Inköp/Investeringar för Fält internt.  Access management: Tillträde Fält både internt och för underentreprenörer.  Stötta i leveranskontorets arbete med planering av kommande beställningar kopplat till fältleveransen.       Dina kvalifikationer    Du har erfarenhet av drift i fält 5-10 år.  Du har erfarenhet avtalsuppföljning.  Du har erfarenhet av radioteknik, transmission och IT-infrastruktur.  B-körkort  Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.       Meriterande om du har:    Erfarenhet av drift i TETRA-miljö och / eller Telekom-miljö.  Entreprenadjuridik  Kunskap om eller har utbildning i ITIL.      Som person behöver du vara en positiv och engagerad person som trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till ett gott arbetsklimat. Du behöver uppskatta att arbeta mot gemensamma mål och att stötta dina kollegor. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och kommunicerar på ett tydligt, respektfullt och professionellt sätt och anpassar dig efter olika människor och situationer. Du är strukturerad och noggrann och tycker om att analysera situationer för att hitta genomtänkta och effektiva lösningar. Du tar gärna initiativ och ser möjligheter till förbättring. Du erbjuds ett hybridupplägg om cirka tre till fyra dagar på kontoret per vecka. Rollen har inget beredskapsansvar men kräver flexibilitet under arbetstid. title: ICT Service Manager
description: Dein Netz    Deine fachliche Basis ist eine Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine IT-Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Prozesstechnik oder Projektmanagement.  Anforderungen zu verstehen, zu hinterfragen und in tragfähige Lösungen zu übersetzen, gehört für dich zum beruflichen Alltag.  Mit IT-Service-Management-Plattformen kennst du dich bestens aus; Erfahrung im IT-Support, Kundenservice oder in bereichsübergreifenden Funktionen ist ein zusätzliches Plus.  Prozesse betrachtest du nicht als gegeben: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, setzt Optimierungen um und kannst zeigen, welchen Mehrwert du damit bereits geschaffen hast. Kenntnisse in der Prozessmodellierung sind von Vorteil.  Im Austausch mit Kunden und Fachabteilungen überzeugst du mit Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie und dem nötigen Fingerspitzengefühl.  Dank deiner schnellen Auffassungsgabe erkennst du technische, organisatorische und menschliche Zusammenhänge und behältst dabei auch Prozesskosten und betriebswirtschaftliche Auswirkungen im Blick.  Was hinter einer Anfrage wirklich steckt, interessiert dich mehr als der erste Wunsch: Du erkennst den tatsächlichen Bedarf und das Ziel dahinter.  Auf dein Wort ist Verlass. Zusagen hältst du ein und schaffst damit Vertrauen, Verbindlichkeit und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit.       Deine Energie    Bei Problemen behältst du den Überblick, koordinierst die nächsten Schritte und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Stellen ankommen.  Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und Fachabteilungen nimmst du Anliegen auf, fragst gezielt nach und bringst die tatsächlichen Bedürfnisse auf den Punkt.  Laufende Vorhaben hast du im Blick, verfolgst Fortschritte konsequent und intervenierst oder eskalierst, wenn es nötig ist.  Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst du früh und entwickelst Prozesse innerhalb der ICT sowie gemeinsam mit Fachabteilungen und Kunden kontinuierlich weiter.  Gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen analysierst du den Bedarf an IT-Services und gestaltest deren Auf- und Ausbau sowie die Bereinigung bestehender Services und Software aktiv mit.  Auch im operativen Management übernimmst du Verantwortung, insbesondere bei Lizenzen, Serviceverträgen und Budgetthemen.  Als ITSM Key-User unterstützt du die Weiterentwicklung der Plattform und übernimmst bei Bedarf die Stellvertretung im Change-Management-Prozess.       Bist du bereit für die Zukunft bei uns? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!   Bei uns triffst du auf ein engagiertes Team mit viel Know-how, das offen zusammenarbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. In unserer Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen übernimmst du eine vielseitige Aufgabe mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Du bewegst dich in spannenden Kundenumgebungen, arbeitest an abwechslungsreichen Themen und gestaltest unsere Services aktiv mit. The opportunity is to create a digital workplace that is reliable and secure, but also intuitive, modern and genuinely useful to our people. Own IT Service Management practices across incident, problem, change, request and asset management.  Lead our Microsoft 365, Teams, email and collaboration environment.  Shape the strategy and lifecycle for end-user devices and technology.  Lead the enablement, adoption and governance of GenAI user tools, including Microsoft Copilot.  Improve onboarding, training and adoption of new technology and ways of working.  Use service data, employee feedback and experience measures to continuously improve the digital workplace.  Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Data and other technology leaders to ensure services are secure, scalable and fit for purpose.  Lead strategic workplace technology vendors and service providers.  Build a strong customer service culture and develop the capability of the digital workplace team. You'll bring significant leadership experience across Service Desk, end-user support or digital workplace environments, with a strong understanding of IT Service Management and Microsoft 365.  You'll be comfortable balancing operational excellence with longer-term transformation and will know how to improve service quality without losing sight of the experience of the person using the technology. Vertalen van de Heijmans-strategie – verbeteren, verslimmen en verduurzamen – naar concrete acties binnen jouw contracten.  Samenwerken met servicemanagers, werkvoorbereiders en operationele teams om optimale dienstverlening te realiseren.  Sturen op continu verbeteren van processen, kwaliteit, veiligheid en klantbeleving.  Verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor een portefeuille van één of meerdere grote contracten of een combinatie van grotere en kleinere contracten.  Loopt een contract niet volgens afspraak of ontstaat er een nieuwe klantvraag? Dan ben jij degene die overzicht houdt, de juiste mensen verbindt en zorgt voor een passende oplossing. Den Wald sehen, nicht nur die Bäume.

Du liebst es, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen, die andere übersehen. Komplexe Datenlagen schrecken dich nicht ab – du machst sie navigierbar und verständlich. Gleichzeitig weißt du, welche strategisch relevant sind und welche nicht.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Why is this role special

We are Backend Engineer at GlassFlow, you’ll be shaping the core technology, culture, and trajectory of the company. The code you write will power AI agents for billions of data events around the world.

You’ll be working in a fast, high-ownership environment where speed matters, curiosity is rewarded, and ambition is the norm.

What you’ll do

  • Build and scale high-performance, low-latency systems in Python.
  • Take complete ownership of projects from idea to production.
  • Ship fast, break things, learn, and ship again.
  • Help define the technical culture of GlassFlow.
  • Work directly with the founders to solve problems in a way that no one has solved before.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Deep expertise in Python.
  • Hungry, competitive, and resilient.
  • Someone with impressive achievements that prove you’re a 10x builder.
  • A fast learner who thrives in chaos.
  • Hands-on, pragmatic, and deeply technical.
  • Actively looking for startup culture.

Previous experience that could be helpful:

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with K8s, Docker, Docker

title: Pulverbeschichter, Oberfächenbeschichter, Lakierer
description:
Unser Kunden ein privat geführtes Unternehmen der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanisch Verzinken, Feuerverzinken, Nasslack) Hat ein neues Werk für die Pulverbeschichtung errichtet. Das Besondere: hier werden 3-dimensionale Teile bis zu 9 Metern Pulverbeschichtet! Das Werk liegt an der Deutschen Grenze in Österreich. Passau, München und der Kurort Bad Füssing sind in erreichbarer Nähe.

Aufgaben

• Selbstständiges Pulverbeschichten von Metallbauteilen nach Qualitätsvorgaben

• Einstellen und Bedienen der Pulverpistolen bzw. Beschichtungsanlagen

• Vorbereitung, Sichtkontrolle und Beurteilung der zu beschichtenden Bauteile

• Kontrolle der Beschichtungsqualität und Erkennen typischer Beschichtungsfehler

• Durchführung von Farb- und Pulverwechseln sowie sorgfältiger Umgang mit Material und Anlagen

• Einhaltung der internen Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Arbeitsvorgaben

Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung ist ideal

• Alternativ: Ausbildung oder fundierte Berufserfahrung als Industrie-, Fahrzeug- oder Lackiertechniker

• Gutes handwerkliches Geschick, saubere und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Technisches Verständnis und selbstständiges Arbeiten

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse für die sichere Kommunikation im Produktionsumfeld

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2-Schicht-Betrieb

Benefits

Auch sehr gute Industrie- oder Fahrzeuglackierer ohne bisherige Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung sind für uns interessant. Bei passender praktischer Erfahrung und handwerklichem Geschick übernehmen wir die gezielte Einschulung in die Pulverbeschichtung.

Mein Unternehmen vermittelt seit 25 Jahren Fach- und Führungskräfte speziell aus dem Bereich der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanik, Lack-, Pulver-, KTL Beschichtungen, Feuerverzinkung). Wir sind im D-A-CH Gebiet tätig.

title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint
description:
About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.

The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end. You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role. The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology. AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability. Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.

What You Will Own

  • The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
  • The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control. Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local model

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). title: Senior Software Engineer

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description:
SMARTVÉLO ist ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen für nachhaltige E-Mobilitäts-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln E-Lastenräder, die den urbanen Alltag revolutionieren, und betreiben den Service für unsere Flotten über mehr als 50 Hubs in Deutschland und den Niederlanden. Damit wir bei diesem Tempo die Servicequalität halten, brauchen die operativen Prozesse dahinter eine feste Hand – genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Operations und verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft: Du hältst den Überblick über laufende Projekte, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unser über 10-köpfiges Mechaniker-Team im Außendienst und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zwischen Feld, Lager und Büro sauber fließen.

Wir suchen keine lange Liste an Berufsjahren. Wenn Du strukturiert denkst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Lust auf Operations hast, ist auch der Berufseinstieg bei uns möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Das operative Tagesgeschäft – Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen, entscheidest im Alltag eigenständig und eskalierst nur, was wirklich eskaliert werden muss
  • Koordination und Kommunikation mit unserem Außendienst-Team – Einsatzabstimmung, Rückfragen, Informationsfluss
  • Tracking kleiner operativer Projekte – Du behältst Fristen, Zuständigkeiten und Status im Blick und treibst diese voran
  • Reporting an den Head of Operations – regelmäßiger, klarer Überblick über Status, Engpässe und Handlungsbedarf
  • Pflege unseres Flottensystems (Papaya) – Fahrzeug-Uploads und Umzüge zwischen den Hubs
  • Vorbereitende KPI-Analysen für Reporting und Entscheidungen
  • Bestand und Verfügbarkeit – Du koordinierst Inventuren und Ersatzteilbestellungen und planst Material und Werkzeug so, dass unsere Mechaniker im Feld nie ohne dastehen
  • Internes Qualitätsmanagement unserer Service-Tickets inkl. Analyse und Datenaufbereitung
  • Reklamationsprozesse von der Aufnahme bis zum Abschluss
  • Flotten

title: Working Student, Website & Organic (m/f/d)
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Working Student, Website and Organic contributes to the implementation of Chaos's digital marketing strategy, supporting the Team Lead, Website & Organic in developing the e-commerce platform. The role carries direct ownership of projects related to user research, user experience, and conversion rate optimisation across global web pages, and contributes to building AI-enabled workflows that allow the Website & Organic team to scale its processes. This position is designed for a student looking to develop practical skills within a professional digital environment.

We take it off them. Because none of it is optional, what we are building is infrastructure rather than software, and the purpose is simple: make it cheaper to run a company in Germany.

100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. So these roles are broad by design. You own an area, not a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people, and the scope grows as fast as you do. We work in English internally, as the team is international, but the market is German.

Tasks

You own our sales engine: the team, the numbers and the motions we sell through.

What you inherit on day one. Two sales people, one freelance closer, and everything our COO and CFO has been carrying alongside his actual job. So you are a playing coach for the first months: you carry your own book, you coach two people, and you hire the next ones yourself rather than being handed a team.

Our pipeline today is almost entirely inbound. Outbound is a motion we expect to build, and we do not yet know how large a part of the mix it becomes. We need somebody who has run both, because the answer depends on what you find.

We have deliberately not decided what the sales team should look like. There are too many sensible ways to build one, and the right shape depends on which motions prove out. You design that structure with us and then you hire it, which is why hiring experience is not negotiable in this role.

what you will do

title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

title: Onboarding & Technical Support Manager | Legal AI Startup
description: Kleine und mittelständische Kanzleien machen über 90 % des deutschen Rechtsmarkts aus – doch beim Thema KI sind sie auf sich allein gestellt: keine Innovation-Teams, keine Legal Engineers, keine Zeit für monatelange Tool-Evaluierungen. Für sie bauen wir Silvernova: den KI-Associate, der in der Akte des Anwalts denkt und Anwälten täglich bis zu 4 Stunden Arbeitszeit spart. So sind wir in 15 Monaten  von 0 auf 400+ Anwaltskanzleien  und  über 1 Mio. € ARR  gewachsen – nahe Break-even, mit einem Team von 13 Leuten. Hinter uns stehen hochkarätige VCs und Business Angels, darunter Partner renommierter Kanzleien wie YPOG, CMS und Neon. Unser nächster Schritt:  Kanzleienzahl und ARR verzehnfachen.     Und hier kommst du ins Spiel.  Du übernimmst unseren Support und das technische Onboarding in eigener Verantwortung – von der Einrichtung neuer Kanzleien über jede Supportanfrage bis zum System dahinter. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden bei allen technischen und produktbezogenen Fragen – und die Person im Team, die am besten weiß, was unsere Kunden bewegt.   Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur Anfragen ab, sondern machst den Support Woche für Woche besser: Hilfe-Center, Playbooks, KI-gestützte Antworten. Dein Ziel ist, dass dieselbe Frage kein zweites Mal gestellt werden muss – so wächst deine Rolle mit uns, statt in Tickets unterzugehen. Und wenn das Kundenwachstum irgendwann eine zweite Support-Kraft braucht, kommt sie in dein System – und du übernimmst die Verantwortung dafür.   Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und verlässlich, hast Freude am direkten Draht zu Menschen und willst einen Bereich wirklich zu deinem machen? Dann lass uns sprechen.  Aufgaben     Support in deiner Verantwortung:  Du beantwortest die Supportanfragen unserer Kunden – per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall. Schnell, freundlich, verbindlich. Du priorisierst selbst, behältst den Überblick und bleibst dran, bis jedes Anliegen gelöst ist. Deine Stärke: verstehen, was passiert ist, und es dem Kunden verständlich erklären.    Technisches Onboarding & Integrationen:  Du richtest neue Kanzleien ein und bringst sie live – inklusive der Anbindung an ihre Kanzleisoftware. Die ersten Einrichtungen pro System machst du hands-on, dokumentierst dabei ein Playbook – und ab dann läuft es nach Checkliste, immer schneller und reibungsloser.    Support-System ausbauen:  Du erkennst Muster in den Anfragen, baust unser Hilfe-Center aus und entwickelst mit uns KI-gestützte Antworten und Automatisierungen. Dein Erfolgsmaßstab: Der Aufwand pro Kunde sinkt, während die Kundenzahl wächst.    Wissen weitergeben:  Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen direkt in unsere Academy, unser Agentensystem und die Produktentwicklung – du arbeitest eng mit unseren Legal Engineers zusammen und siehst deine Vorschläge im nächsten Release wieder.    Qualifikation  Wichtiger als dein bisheriger Werdegang ist uns, wie du arbeitest: strukturiert, verlässlich, mit echter Freude am Kundenkontakt.      Abg

title: Support Manager
description: At TOPdesk we help our customers to deliver better services. How? With great software and expert knowledge. Our ever-expanding team has over 700 colleagues in 8 countries, dedicated to making service management more fun and easy. Would you like the freedom to develop your skills in a flexible working environment? A TOPdesk career is the answer.      Vacatureomschrijving     Intro      Onze B2B supportafdeling bestaat uit 25 supporters die klanten dagelijks helpen om zo veel mogelijk uit onze software te halen en storingen snel op te lossen. Al jaren scoren we daarmee gemiddeld een 9,4 op klanttevredenheid, iets waar we trots op zijn. Als Support Manager geef jij leiding aan een team van ongeveer 10 supportmedewerkers en werk je samen met de andere support managers aan de vraag die iedereen nu bezighoudt: hoe zetten we AI zo waardevol mogelijk in om onze processen en dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau te tillen? En minstens zo belangrijk: hoe coach je je team door die verandering heen?      Wat ga je doen als Support Manager?      Samen met de Regional Support Manager NL/BE en de andere support managers werk je aan het doorontwikkelen van de afdeling en onze dienstverlening naar klanten. Jij focust op de supportmedewerkers in Nederland en België, en werkt daarnaast met support managers uit andere landen aan het uniformeren van processen en dienstverlening in alle 7 landen waar TOPdesk supportteams heeft.     Je geeft leiding via individuele coaching en teamoverleg. Je monitort de SLA's en andere KPI's, analyseert trends en identificeert waar nodig verbeterpunten. Loopt de dienstverlening bij een klant niet zoals verwacht? Dan ga jij samen met de accountmanager het gesprek aan. En je geeft mede vorm aan de brede doorontwikkeling van de afdeling: van cultuur en sfeer tot het klaarstomen van je team voor een wereld met AI, en het opzetten van een partnerstrategie waarin support als tweede of derde lijn voor onze partners fungeert.      Waar kom je terecht?      Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Delft, met af en toe een bezoek aan Antwerpen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Customer domein en rapporteert aan de Regional Support Manager NL/BE. Samen met 2 andere support managers stuur je in totaal 25 ervaren supportmedewerkers aan, in Nederland en een aantal in België.     Inhoudelijk is het team heel sterk en de klant staat er al volop centraal, daar hoef je dus niets aan te veranderen. Bij onze support afdeling werkt een ervaren en inhoudelijk heel sterk team. In alles wat wij doen, staat de klant centraal. Maar tegelijkertijd staat onze afdeling voor een grote uitdaging. Want wat betekent AI voor de baan van onze support medewerkers? Wij geloven dat de banen niet weg gaan, maar inhoudeiljk zullen veranderen. Als manager help jij mee in het vormgeven van deze verandering. Dit doe je samen met support managers in Nederland, en andere landen. Daarnaast werk je samen met 3 support managers uit andere landen aan een gezamenlijke aanpak.           Functi

title: Service Delivery Manager Infra Lokale Overheid
description: Voor PQR in Utrecht en klantlocaties in heel Nederland zoeken wij een Service Delivery Manager Infra - 32–40 uur | Utrecht | hybride       Functie   Als Service Delivery Manager bij PQR ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten binnen de lokale overheid en de technische organisatie van PQR. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze Managed Services niet alleen voldoen aan de gemaakte afspraken, maar daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan een stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving.     Je werkt met gemeenten die midden in hun digitale transformatie zitten. Cloud, security, moderne werkplekken, continuïteit en steeds strengere wet- en regelgeving maken hun IT-landschap complex. Jij brengt daarin overzicht, regie en vooral: rust.       De regisseur van onze dienstverlening    Als Service Delivery Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van onze dienstverlening bij meerdere klanten binnen de lokale overheid.     Je kent je klanten, begrijpt wat er binnen hun organisatie speelt en weet dit te vertalen naar de dienstverlening van PQR. Daarbij kijk je verder dan SLA's, incidenten en rapportages. Je bespreekt ontwikkelingen, signaleert risico's en verbeterkansen en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening blijft aansluiten bij de doelen van de klant.     Je schakelt dagelijks tussen klant, engineers, consultants, servicedesk, Managed Services, projectteams en andere specialisten binnen PQR.  Je hoeft daarbij niet zelf de techniek in te duiken, maar je begrijpt IT goed genoeg om de juiste vragen te stellen, prioriteiten te bepalen en technische onderwerpen naar de klant te vertalen.       Werken voor de lokale overheid    Gemeenten worden steeds afhankelijker van IT. Digitale dienstverlening moet beschikbaar zijn, medewerkers moeten veilig en flexibel kunnen werken en tegelijkertijd moeten gemeenten voldoen aan hoge eisen rondom informatiebeveiliging, privacy en continuïteit.  PQR ondersteunt gemeenten onder andere met moderne werkplekken, cloud- en datacenteroplossingen, networking, security en Managed Services.     Als Service Delivery Manager begrijp je deze omgeving. Je weet dat dienstverlening binnen een gemeente andere belangen en dynamiek kent dan binnen een puur commerciële organisatie. Stakeholdermanagement, bestuurlijke gevoeligheid, security, voorspelbaarheid en het nakomen van afspraken zijn hier essentieel.      Wat ga je doen?    Je bent het primaire aanspreekpunt voor een aantal klanten binnen de lokale overheid.  Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en performance van de afgesproken IT-dienstverlening.  Je stuurt op SLA's, KPI's, klanttevredenheid en gemaakte afspraken.  Je organiseert en leidt periodieke service- en voortgangsoverleggen.  Je analyseert rapportages, incidenten, changes en structurele verbeterpunten.  Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen en behoeften bij klanten naar acties binnen PQR.  Je coördineert escalaties en zorgt dat de juiste mensen binnen PQR worden aangehaakt.  Je werkt nauw samen met technische team

title: Service & Onderhoud Manager
description: Voor deze functie zijn wij op zoek naar een Service & Onderhoud Manager die techniek, organisatie en klantgerichtheid moeiteloos samenbrengt. Je stuurt op kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en efficiency, terwijl je tegelijkertijd oog hebt voor klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen.  Concreet:    Aansturen en coördineren van service- en onderhoudsactiviteiten;  Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt voor klanten en interne stakeholders;  Opstellen en opvolgen van offertes en onderhoudscontracten;  Adviseren van klanten over optimalisaties en uitbreidingen;  Signaleren van commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en deze vertalen naar concrete acties;  Aansturen en coachen van buitendienstcollega’s;  Bewaken en verbeteren van serviceprocessen;  Monitoren van prestaties en rapporteren richting management.    Wat breng jij mee?  In deze rol breng jij mee:    Technische opleiding (mbo) richting installatietechniek;  Ervaring in service, onderhoud en een coördinerende rol;  Kennis van HVAC, GBS en DDC-systemen;  Leiderschapskwaliteiten en organisatorisch sterk;  Klantgericht en commercieel bewust;  Besluitvaardig en communicatief sterk.  Proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling.    Waar ga je het doen?  BUILDING technology is een gespecialiseerd technisch bedrijf dat gebouwen slimmer, energiezuiniger en gebruiksvriendelijker maakt. Binnen onze organisatie staat een cultuur van vakmanschap, betrouwbaarheid en samenwerking centraal. Korte lijnen, duidelijke communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid nemen: dát kenmerkt ons als organisatie. Wij maken deel uit van de VDK Installatiegroep, waardoor de voordelen van een grote organisatie worden gecombineerd met de flexibiliteit en dynamiek van een zelfstandig opererend bedrijf.  VDK Installatiegroep – de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland  BUILDING technology is onderdeel van de VDK

title: Client Lead
description: Har du solid erfaring fra consulting og et genuint ønske om å bygge sterke, langsiktige kunderelasjoner?    Axaz er et AI-first-selskap som ligger i front når det gjelder å realisere store forretningsmessige gevinster fra moderne teknologi. Vi løser komplekse behov med denne tilnærmingen, og skaper konkret verdi for ledende selskaper. For å ta en tydelig posisjon i markedet, har vi samtidig et sterkt fokus på å bygge en solid kultur, et godt samhold og gode muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling. Vi søker nå en erfaren person som vil ta eierskap til et utvalg kunderelasjoner     Client Lead – Helhetlig eierskap til våre største kunder   Som Client Lead jobber du tett på både de som jobber med leveranser og de som jobber med salg. Din hovedoppgave er å sørge for at store og viktige kunder får reell verdi av løsningene og tjenestene våre, samtidig som du skaper vekst for Axaz. Du får det fulle eierskapet til disse kunderelasjonene og har ansvaret for at vi lykkes på tvers av alle tjenestene vi leverer.  Du inngår i en tydelig rolle- og ansvarsfordeling rundt kunden: Du eier den strategiske relasjonen og har det overordnede ansvaret for kunden, mens det er andre roller som har ansvaret for tjenesteleveransene og den tekniske retningen. Dette er ikke en tradisjonell salgsrolle – her er du en rådgiver og en entreprenør som identifiserer muligheter ut fra kundens reelle behov og bygger verdi for kunden over tid.   Hverdagen din vil typisk fordele seg på disse områdene:     Kunderelasjoner: Bygge langsiktige og tillitsbaserte relasjoner med sentrale personer hos kundene våre og være en “go to” person når det er viktige saker som skjer  Strategisk rådgivning: Være en proaktiv sparringspartner for kundens ledelse, og dele innsikt, råd og kompetanse som gjør at kunden utvikler seg i riktig retning  Leveransestyring: Ha overordnet ansvar for flere pågående leveranser, og sikre at våre tjenester treffer kundenes faktiske behov og forventning om verdiskaping  Kvalitet og trygghet: Være en trygghet for både kunde og våre leveranseteam – gå handson inn i leveransene når kritiske situasjoner krever det, og på se at vi bruker og videreutvikler våre standarder og beste praksiser  Strategisk salg: Identifisere muligheter for mersalg gjennom strategiske dialoger og roadmapsesjoner, og lede større salgsprosesser  Eskalering og problemløsning: Fungere som hovedkontaktpunkt for kunden og håndtere utfordringer som oppstår, samtidig som du skjermer leveranseteamene fra støy     Hvem er du?   Vi ser etter en erfaren, profesjonell og trygg rådgiver som forstår kundenes forretningsbehov. Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom salg, leveranse og strategisk rådgivning, og du evner å bygge tillit hos beslutningstakere på C-nivå.   Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:     Ca.

title: Kundservicechef
description: Vill du leda och utveckla kundservice i toppklass? Som kundservicechef ingår du i Kundcenters ledningsgrupp där du tillsammans med dina chefskollegor ansvarar för att vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för en skalbar och bättre kundupplevelse. Målet för LF Finans är att kunna leverera snabb, professionell och lösningsorienterad service till alla kunder vi möter i första linjen.  Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:    Coacha, leda och utveckla kundserviceteamet om cirka 20 medarbetare.  Styra, optimera och utveckla gruppens kommunikationsverktyg med stort fokus på Telia Ace, säkra meddelanden och e-post.  Vara delaktig i kundcenters ledningsgrupp där du tillsammans med kollegor utvecklar kundcenter.  Vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för en skalbar, modern och kundorienterad upplevelse.  Följa upp, analysera och utveckla gruppens nyckeltal (mål och KPI:er) för höjd kvalitet, tillgänglighet och effektivitet.    Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:    Erfarenhet av personalansvar, gärna inom kundservice eller liknande verksamhet.  Du är en trygg och inspirerande ledare med god kommunikativ förmåga.  Stark kundfokus och ett affärsmässigt tänk.  Erfarenhet av att arbeta med KPI:er och förändringsarbete.  Intresse för AI och dess möjligheter inom kundservice.  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.    Som person är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som motiveras av att se dina medarbetare växa. Du är en lagspelare och tar med dig en positiv inställning till utmaningar, vilket tillsammans med din förmåga att engagera ditt team och din omgivning skapar en trivsam och utvecklande arbetsmiljö. Du har ett starkt affärsfokus och trivs med att arbeta datadrivet för att nå uppsatta mål.  Du är strukturerad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad, van att arbeta med nyckeltal och förändringsarbete, och ser potentialen i hur nya arbetssätt, teknik och AI kan bidra till en ännu bättre kundserviceupplevelse.  Vi erbjuder:    En nyckelroll i ett växande och affärsorienterat finansbolag.  Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla kundservicefunktionen och kundcenter.  En dynamisk arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor.
