title: Team Lead
description: Haemme Porin Motonet-tavaratalon   Team Leadia   Lähde osaksi osaavaa ja aktiivista tiimiä monipuolisiin kaupan alan työtehtäviin. Haemme tiimiin myynnillistä ja esihenkilötyöstä innostuvaa  Team Leadia.  Tässä roolissa pääset johtamaan ja valmentamaan tiimiäsi arjen työssä sekä varmistamaan, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta, sujuvaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä palvelua jokaisella asiointikerralla.  Team Leadina toimit osana tavaratalon arkea ja vastaat omalta osaltasi myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja päivittäisten toimintojen sujuvuudesta. Rooli voi painottua esimerkiksi myymälän, kassan, asiakaspalvelun tai varaosamyynnin ja autoilun tuoteryhmien pariin valittavan henkilön osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vahvuuksien mukaan. Tärkeintä on, että sinulta löytyy aikaisempaa esihenkilökokemusta, kaupallista ajattelua ja halua saada tiimi onnistumaan.  🤝 Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen  👍 Työn luonteen vuoksi hakijoilta edellytetään 18 vuoden ikää  💰 Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan. Palkka määräytyy tehtävään valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.  Työssäsi johdat tiimiäsi valmentavalla otteella, tuet tiimiläisten osaamisen kehittymistä ja varmistat, että ketjuohjeistusten mukainen toiminta toteutuu arjessa. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua muun muassa myymälän yleiskunnosta ja esillepanoista huolehtimista, kampanjoiden, hinta- ja hyllymuutosten sekä sesonkivaihtojen toteutuksen varmistamista, kassatoimintojen ja rahaliikenteen sujuvuuden tukemista sekä varaosa- ja autoilumyynnin päivittäisten toimintojen edistämistä.  Team Lead osallistuu myös tavaratalon työhön kaikissa vuoroissa, ja tehtävään kuuluu joustavasti myös muita tavaratalon tehtäviä. Arjessa olet mukana asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityössä, toimit esimerkkinä tiimillesi ja huolehdit siitä, että tekemisessä näkyvät hyvä palveluasenne, aktiivinen myynti ja halu tehdä kauppaa.  Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sytyt myynnistä, asiakaskohtaamisista ja tiimin valmentamisesta. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy kaupallista nälkää, myynnillistä pilkettä silmäkulmassa ja aitoa halua kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi tekemistä. title: Store Manager - Tahuna (Queenstown)
description: Patagonia is an outdoor apparel business like no other,  "We're in business to save our home planet."  As a certified B Corporation, the company is recognised internationally for its commitment to product quality and environmental activism - and now our one and only shareholder is our home planet with 100% of profits going to fight the environmental crisis. Founded by Yvon Chouinard in 1973, Patagonia is based in Ventura, California with offices around the world including in Tāhuna Queenstown, New Zealand.     Our values stay true to a business that was started by a band of climbers and surfers, and the minimalist style they promoted. The approach we take demonstrates a bias for simplicity and utility -  build the best product and provide the best service; examine our practices openly and honestly; protect our home planet; be just, equitable and antiracist; do it our way.      We look for candidates with proven experience who thrive in a team-based atmosphere, individuals who are passionate about their communities, the environment and caring for others. We seek core Patagonia product users, people who love to spend as much time as possible in the mountains, ocean, and wild nature. Folks who deal well with ambiguity, learn on the fly, demonstrate sound judgment, and solve problems creatively are most successful with us. We're looking for someone who builds and maintains relationships with ease and desires to put the customer at the centre of everything they do. We don't want someone who can just do a job - we want the best person for the job. Yet we don't look for "stars" seeking special treatment and perks. Our best efforts are collaborative, and Patagonia culture rewards the ensemble player, while it barely tolerates those who need the  limelight.      The Role:      Our retail stores are where our brand comes to life, as the Store Manager, you’re the embodiment of the brand for our customers and our team. Based in our flagship Tāhuna Queenstown store and reporting to the Retail Area Manager, you will welcome, assist, and engage customers by providing a positive experience for everyone who visits – your store is a hub for environmental activism, community, sport, and positive vibes.     You will focus on building relationships and act as a role model to your team. You will share your knowledge of core sports and products, your passion for the community, and your efforts to protect the local environment. By developing your retail team, you will ensure that our customer service experience is consistent, authentic, aligned with Patagonia’s core values, and best-in-class. You act as an ambassador for Patagonia in your store and community and have goals to expand your leadership. All employees are encouraged and empowered to creatively solve problems and put customers’ needs at the centre of everything we do. description: Weezevent  bietet massgeschneiderte Lösungen für Veranstalter, um Besuchern ein einzigartiges Erlebnis zu garantieren. Wir suchen eine leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung. Als einer der führenden Akteure in der Eventbranche ermöglicht Weezevent Ihnen den Kontakt mit vielfältigen und hochkarätigen Ansprechpartnern. In unserem Arbeitsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Eventbranche wirken Sie an innovativen, ehrgeizigen und anregenden Projekten mit.   Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Mass an Autonomie, insbesondere bei Entscheidungsfindungen. Verantwortung schreckt Sie nicht ab!   Mehr als nur eine Stelle: Dieses herausfordernde Umfeld bietet exzellente Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Sie lernen viel über sich selbst, insbesondere über Ihre Fähigkeit, sich neu zu erfinden und über sich hinauszuwachsen. Wenn Sie Lust haben zu lernen und Teil eines Teams zu werden, für das der Austausch von Ideen grundlegend ist.    Alle unsere Stellen sind auch für Menschen mit Behinderungen offen.

description: 【企業名】 株式会社 本田技術研究所  【職種名】 【虎ノ門】ITサービスマネージャー（グローバルコネクテッド・デジタルサービス領域）  【仕事内容(概要)】 【虎ノ門】ITサービスマネージャー（グローバルコネクテッド・デジタルサービス領域）  【具体的な仕事内容】 ■業務概要 HondaのコネクテッドサービスおよびデジタルサービスにおけるITサービスマネージャーとして、サービスの安定提供および継続的な改善をリードしていただきます。  ■具体的な想定業務 ・コネクテッドサービスの運用設計およびITサービスマネジメント（ITSM）の推進 ・インシデント管理、問題管理、変更管理のプロセス設計および運用改善 ・サービスレベル（SLA／SLO）の定義・管理および品質向上施策の推進 ・サービス運用における課題の可視化および継続的改善（CI：Continual Improvement）の実行 ・グローバル展開における運用体制の構築および標準化・最適化  ■期待する役割 単なる運用対応にとどまらず、インシデント管理や問題管理、変更管理などのITサービスマネジメントを通じて、サービス品質・顧客満足度の向上を実現し、事業価値の最大化に貢献していただきます。 また、開発・SRE・QAなどの各チームと連携しながら、サービス提供の全体最適を担う中核的な役割を期待しています。  ■本ポジションの魅力 ・数百万台規模のコネクテッドサービスを支える、グローバルかつ大規模なサービス運営に携わることができます。 ・単なる運用ではなく、サービス品質や顧客体験を向上させるための改善活動を主体的に推進できます。 ・開発（バックエンド／モバイル）、SRE、QAと密に連携し、サービス提供全体を俯瞰して最適化に関われます。 ・インシデント管理やサービスレベル管理を通じて、事業に直結する重要な意思決定に関与できます。 ・グローバル展開されるサービスの運用設計・標準化に携わることで、スケールの大きい課題解決に挑戦できます。 ・DevOpsや自動化、最新技術を活用した運用高度化など、新しい取り組みにも関わることができます。  ■キャリアパス ITサービスマネージャーとして、コネクテッドサービスの運用設計・サービスマネジメント・継続的改善の経験を積んでいただきます。 その後は、複数サービスを横断して運用戦略やサービス品質向上を担うサービスマネジメントリードや、グローバル全体の運用体制を統括するサービスオーナーとしてのキャリアアップが可能です。  変更の範囲：専門性や適性、会社ニーズなどを踏まえ、会社が定める業務への配置転換を命じる場合があります。  【対象となる方(概要)】 学歴不問  【対象となる方(詳細)】 ＜応募資格/応募条件＞ ■必須条件： At Kiilto, Customer Service plays an important role in creating a smooth and reliable customer experience. Set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support agreed service levels.  Improve and harmonize Customer Service processes and ways of working across the Scandinavian markets.  Support organizational and cultural change initiatives to enable effective cross-border collaboration.  Analyze Customer Service performance and implement corrective actions and improvements where needed.  Collaborate closely with Logistics, Warehousing, other parts of the supply chain function, Finance and Business Area teams to strengthen the overall order-to-cash process.  Contribute to regional and selected global improvement projects. title: Onboarding Specialist
location: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: 💼  Who we are   Do you have good business sense, enjoy working with people and like taking ownership? Would you thrive in a dynamic, multicultural environment where things move quickly and no two customer projects are quite the same? Then the Boarding Specialist role at Market Pay Online could be your next adventure.  Our core product is a technical payment platform. We handle the technical integrations that connect our customers to online payments and banking services: Card payments, iDEAL, PayPal and more.  🌟  The Role    Context   As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a Boarding Specialist to join our onboarding team, working from our office on Gothersgade in Copenhagen  🎯  Your Key Responsibilities   As a Boarding Specialist, you will own the customer journey from the moment Sales hands over a new customer and continue supporting them beyond go-live — ensuring their setup runs smoothly, evolves with their needs, and that they feel confident throughout their time with Market Pay Online.  Reporting to the Onboarding Leads, you'll be the coordinator and driving force throughout the process, working closely with the customer, our acquiring partners and colleagues across Market Pay Online.   That Means     Setting up and managing acquiring applications, while also handling ongoing merchant maintenance and keeping oversight of periodic KYC reviews to ensure compliance throughout the customer’s lifecycle.  Guiding customers through requirements and helping them reach a solid setup and continuing to support them throughout their time with Market Pay Online, building strong, trusting relationships.  Explaining complex processes, technical requirements and compliance needs clearly and simply, and translating “payments” into language customers can actually understand.  Coordinating closely with internal teams and managing external stakeholders and partners, keeping everyone aligned and making sure nothing falls between two chairs.  Keeping the whole process moving; managing deadlines, priorities and dependencies, even when systems misbehave, partners introduce new requirements, or customers need extra reassurance.  Being the calm, trusted point of contact who makes both onboarding and ongoing merchant life feel easy.    Success in the role means that customers know exactly where they stand, colleagues know what they need to do, and new merchants get through the boarding process efficiently and without unnecessary friction.  🔍  Who we’re looking for   This is a customer-facing role, so you genuinely enjoy working with people. You are approachable, service-minded and good at building trust, while also being comfortable taking the lead and pushing things forward when needed.  You are thorough and detail-oriented. You thrive in creating your own structure in day-to-day processes. Our onboarding flows evolve constantly, and you are comfortable working in an environment where priorities shift, requirements change and not everything

title: Chef.fe de Projet Senior
description: Rattachement hiérarchique   Directement rattaché au CEO.  Travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes  Sales ,  Produit ,  Tech  et  R&D .   Mission principale   Garantir la réussite client et la bonne exécution des projets de Craft.AI, depuis le hand-over commercial jusqu’à la phase d’exploitation et de renouvellement.  Le Chef.fe de Projet Senior est à la fois :    un  chef d’orchestre  opérationnel de l’exécution client    un  CSM stratégique  responsable du succès et du renouvellement des comptes,    un  manager  des équipes IA (3 DataScientist), projets (1 chef de projet) et support (Care & Success),    et un  ambassadeur  de la valeur Craft.ai auprès des clients.       Responsabilités clés    1. Pilotage de la relation client :     Assurer la continuité client après la signature (hand-over Sales → Delivery)    Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients stratégiques (C-level, sponsors techniques et métier).    Définir la stratégie de compte : objectifs, roadmap IA, alignement roadmap produit, adoption, upsell.    Piloter les  revues trimestrielles de performance (QBR)  et garantir la satisfaction client.       2. Gestion et exécution des projets     Participer avec l’équipe commerciale à la construction des propositions en Avant-Vente, dès la phase de diagnostic.    Superviser et/ou assurer en direct la  chefferie de projets IA  (cadrage, planning, ressources, risques, budget).    Piloter l’équipe IA (3 Data Scientists) pour garantir la qualité et le respect des engagements Craft.AI sur chaque déploiement (plateforme MLOps/LLMOps, CraftGPT, développement fonctionnels, intégrations…).    Travailler main dans la main avec les équipes Produit, Tech & R&D pour l’opérationnalisation rapide des cas d’usage IA.    Participer à l’amélioration continue de la vélocité et l’industrialisation des cas d’usages développés pour les clients.    Assurer la documentation, la traçabilité et le transfert de connaissance auprès des clients.       3. Customer Success Management     Définir et suivre les KPIs de  Success  (adoption, usage, valeur créée, renouvellement).    Garantir la qualité du delivery et la performance des cas d’usages, y compris en phase de montée en puissance.    Mettre en place des actions proactives pour améliorer l’usage et favoriser les renouvellements.    Identifier les opportunités d’ upsell / cross-sell  sur les produits    Gérer les plans de compte en coordination avec les Sales pour maximiser le  Net Retention Revenue (NRR).        4. Pilotage du Care / Support utilisateur     Superviser le support utilisateur (Care) et garantir une qualité de service irréprochable.    Structurer les processus d’escalade et le suivi des incidents en lien avec les équipes Tech.    Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance : SLA, satisfaction, réactivité.    Mettre en place des ressources self-service (knowledge base, FAQ, tutoriels, onboarding  utilisateurs).       5. Management & leadership     Encadrer la chef

title: VP, Consumer & Commercial
description: Join us!   We’re always happy to hear from people who are eager to learn and grow, and share our values. Read more about the role and apply. As VP, Consumer & Commercial, you will combine strong commercial leadership with deep client focus, working across the organization to turn our capabilities into meaningful business outcomes for our clients.  You will hold full P&L responsibility for the domain and play an active role in Nordic leadership, helping shape our regional strategy, strengthen collaboration across teams, and drive our continued transformation.   What You Will Be Responsible For    Strategic leadership and business growth     Define and execute the Nordic Consumer & Commercial strategy in line with our overall business priorities.  Drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability by identifying, developing, and converting new market opportunities across all Nordic markets.  Strengthen our go-to-market approach and lead sales and business development initiatives within the domain.  Develop and grow our client portfolio, both through existing accounts and new client acquisition.  Maintain a strong understanding of market developments, client needs, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities. Tehtävä tarjoaa laajan vastuun suomalaisen ohjelmistoyhtiön kasvusta. Oscar Software lyhyesti      Oscar Software on vuonna 2005 perustettu suomalainen ohjelmisto- ja palveluyhtiö, joka tarjoaa ERP-toiminnanohjauksen, talouden, verkkokaupan ja digitaalisen liiketoiminnan ratkaisuja erityisesti valmistavan teollisuuden ja tukkukaupan yrityksille. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihto oli noin 14,1 miljoonaa euroa, liikevoitto noin 887 000 euroa ja omavaraisuusaste noin 50 %. Oscarilla on toimipisteet Tampereella, Espoossa ja Raisiossa. Osallistut itse keskeisten asiakkuuksien, kumppanuuksien ja kaupallisesti tärkeiden kokonaisuuksien kehittämiseen.      Odotamme kasvujohtajan olevan lähellä myyjien ja asiakkaiden arkea sekä muuttavan suunnitelmat konkreettiseksi tekemiseksi ja mitattaviksi tuloksiksi. カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス、業界、および製品の知識を活用して顧客とパートナーシップを結び、ビジネス価値を加速させ、Salesforceへの投資対効果を最大化できるよう導きます。この役割において、CSMは特定のクラウドの専門性や業界知見をもとに、社内リソースをオーケストレーションし、お客様と同じ目線で語り合い、顧客価値の実現を中長期的に図ります。  ■業務内容： プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。 ・テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。 title: Franchise Support Manager
description: Position Responsibilities   As ZUS continues to expand internationally via Franchise model, we need to ensure that our partners have world-class support delivered to them, while optimizing required resources of the ZUS HQ teams. This is a newly established and highly visible role in the growing International Franchise department. The role’s objective is to enhance existing workflows, find efficiencies as well as grow the team’s capabilities to support a large and growing number for Franchisee partners. The role reports directly into the IF Director. The role will have 3 team members reporting into it.      Budget ownership of the Business Unit; correlated with Franchisees’ business plans;  Channel management of a franchisee as a customer: supporting the rest of the Department in establishing a smooth lifecycle for ZUS Franchisees, from onboarding to day-to-day operations;  Close coordination with Franchise Business Development and Franchise Operations teams to deliver on Department’s objectives and key results;  Own, manage, improve and create required tools, processes and frameworks for smooth Franchising operations;  Improve internal coordination with the rest of the HQ departments, ensuring close collaboration and constant exchange of information and best practices – act as a bridge between the Department and other central functions;  Enhance existing and create missing R.A.C.I. alignments with internal and external stakeholders;  Support in development of central functions cost allocation principles;  Develop long-term motivation program for ZUS Franchisees;  Establish the culture and frameworks for Continuous improvement of the IF Department;  Represent the department in regular internal engagements with senior stakeholders.       Qualification and Experience    Over 10 years of relevant working experience in F&B and/or Retail environment; with focus on internal processes, Operational Excellence, Channel management and Strategic projects.  Operational experience in the past, but since then worked on strategic initiatives and have an ability to view “the big picture”, without forgetting about operational details  Superior stakeholder management and “delivery through others” skills is a must  Self-starter mindset: you see where things can be improved and act on it without waiting for formal processes;  Change management skills, Team leadership skills  Six sigma or Continuous improvement certification is a big advantage  Experience of working in a big corporate environment, comfortable working in a matrix structure  Financial planning and financial literacy  Fluency in English is a must; additional languages is an advantage.       a Necessity, not a Luxury

À un moment où chaque déploiement compte, votre empreinte sur l'entreprise sera immédiatement visible, au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine où chaque personne compte.      LE POSTE    Véritable pivot entre nos équipes internes (R&D et commercial) et nos clients, vous pilotez la gestion de projet de bout en bout — de la phase avant-vente jusqu'au suivi post-déploiement. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. title: Responsable Développement du Personnel & Formation Professionnelle
description: Notre client, une société industrielle basée à 15 minutes de Bienne recherche un/e:   Responsable Développement du Personnel & Formation Professionnelle   Dans cette fonction clé, vous serez responsable du développement du personnel et contribuerez de manière significative à l'accompagnement des collaborateurs, apprentis et stagiaires.   Vos responsabilités     Assurer et développer stratégiquement l'ensemble des offres et outils de formation initiale et continue au niveau du groupe.  Assumer la responsabilité globale de la formation professionnelle au sein des sociétés du groupe, en étroite collaboration avec les formateurs professionnels et les maîtres d'apprentissage.  Coordonner et accompagner les stagiaires durant leurs missions de formation au sein de l'entreprise.  Gérer et faire évoluer les systèmes RH existants en tant que super utilisateur (Learning Management System, inventaire des formations, outil de certificats de travail, etc.).  Piloter et accompagner des projets ainsi que des démarches de conduite du changement visant à introduire et optimiser des outils RH modernes.  Identifier les besoins en formation et développement, puis concevoir, planifier et mettre en œuvre les programmes correspondants.  Analyser et garantir l'efficacité ainsi que la durabilité des mesures de formation et de développement.  Conseiller et soutenir les cadres ainsi que les HR Business Partners sur toutes les questions liées au développement du personnel et à la formation professionnelle.  Mettre en place et développer une planification systématique de la relève en collaboration avec les responsables opérationnels et l'équipe RH. description: Répondre aux défis de la  transition énergétique  et renforcer notre  souveraineté  sont des priorités du XXIᵉ siècle. Vous intervenez au sein d'environnements complexes, fortement réglementés, sur des projets stratégiques liés au  Chantier Numérique , à la digitalisation des processus métiers, à l'intégration des systèmes d'information industriels et au pilotage de solutions digitales à forte visibilité.  En lien avec les directions métiers, les équipes d'ingénierie, les architectes de solutions, les éditeurs et les partenaires, vous assurez le pilotage de projets de transformation depuis le cadrage jusqu'au déploiement opérationnel.   Vos principales missions     Piloter des projets stratégiques de transformation digitale dans des environnements industriels complexes.   Définir et piloter la feuille de route projet en garantissant les coûts, délais, qualité et risques.   Comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions concrètes et partagées.   Construire et maintenir une planification réaliste des activités de réalisation.   Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes (métiers, ingénierie, DSI, architectes, éditeurs, intégrateurs et fournisseurs). title: Product Operations Manager - 중고거래
description: 중고거래실을 소개해요   중고거래실은 한국에서 가장 많은 사람들이 쓰는 중고거래 서비스를 만들고 있어요. 매일 수많은 이웃이 물건을 사고팔고, 신뢰를 쌓고, 때로는 예상치 못한 문제를 경험해요. Product Operations Manager는 이 거대한 생활 플랫폼의 현장에서 발생하는 문제를 가장 먼저 발견하고, 그 문제를 단순 대응이 아니라  제품과 비즈니스 레벨의 해결 과제 로 끌어올리는 사람이에요.  사용자의 불편, 거래 리스크, 운영 비효율, 정책의 빈틈을 발견했을 때, 왜 이 문제가 반복되는지, 제품 구조를 어떻게 바꾸면 예방할 수 있는지, 정책과 운영 기준을 어떻게 재설계하면 더 나은 거래 경험과 비즈니스 기회로 이어질 수 있는지 고민하고 실행해요. 이 역할은 운영을 관리하는 일이 아니라,  운영에서 발견한 신호를 바탕으로 제품과 사업을 성장시키는 일 이에요. 제품팀과 원 팀으로 일하며 문제를 정의하고, 실험하고, 개선하고, AI와 자동화를 활용해 더 확장 가능한 해결 구조를 만들어가요.  우리는 앞으로의 운영이 사람이 반복 업무를 더 많이 처리하는 방식이 아니라,  AI와 데이터로 문제를 더 빨리 발견하고, 더 정교하게 판단하며, 더 높은 밀도로 서비스를 개선하는 방식 으로 진화해야 한다고 믿어요. 이 포지션은 그 변화를 중고거래실 안에서 직접 설계하고 실행하는 역할이에요.  자율적으로 문제를 발견하고, 근본 원인을 파고들고, 제품·정책·비즈니스·AI를 연결해 실제 변화를 만들어내는 데 에너지를 느끼는 분이라면 이 역할에서 큰 임팩트를 만들 수 있어요. 반복되는 운영 문제를 더 잘 처리하는 사람이 아니라,  그 문제가 더 이상 반복되지 않도록 제품과 비즈니스의 구조를 바꾸는 사람 을 찾고 있어요.   이런 일을 해요    중고거래 제품에서 발생하는 운영·정책·사용자 경험 문제를 스스로 발견하고 정의해요. 단순히 접수된 이슈에 대응하는 것이 아니라, 문제의 반복 구조와 근본 원인을 파악해 제품과 비즈니스 레벨의 해결 과제로 전환해요  ‘더 잘 처리하는 방법’이 아니라 ‘문제가 덜 발생하는 구조’를 고민해요. 프로세스 개선에 그치지 않고, 제품 플로우·정책 기준·운영 시스템·AI 자동화 구조를 함께 재설계해요  AI와 데이터를 활용해 확장 가능한 문제 해결 방식을 만들어요. 반복 업무를 자동화하는 것을 넘어, 문제 탐지·분류·판단·모니터링 체계를 설계하고, 운영 밀도와 의사결정 품질을 높여요  변화하는 시장과 플랫폼 환경에 맞춰 오래된 운영 기준을 다시 정의해요. 기존 정책이나 프로세스를 그대로 유지하는 것이 아니라, 지금의 사용자 행동과 사업 방향에 맞게 재해석하고 개선해요  신규 기능과 사업 변화에 맞는 운영 대응 체계를 준비해요. 제품 출시 전후의 리스크를 예측하고, 필요한 정책·가이드·프로세스·모니터링 구조를 설계해요  외부 파트너사와의 관계를 쌓고, 사용자 가치를 전달하는 문제를 함께 풀어가요  중고거래의 신뢰와 안전, 거래 활성화, 사용자 경험, 운영 효율을 함께 바라보며 우선순위를 판단해요. 운영 관점만이 아니라 제품 임팩트와 비즈니스 임팩트를 함께 고려해 핵심 이슈를 선제적으로 다뤄요    이런 분을 찾고 있어요    누가 시키지 않아도 문제를 발견하면 근본 원인을 파고들고, 문제를 스스로 정의하고, 해결까지 주도적으로 끌고 가는 분  운영을 ‘처리하는 일’이 아니라 ‘제품과 서비스를 성장시키는 일’로 바라보고, 제품 구조와 비즈니스 모델 개선의 기회로 해석하는 분  운영 매니저로서 5년 이상의 경험을 바탕으로, 프로덕트팀과 원 팀으로 서비스를 운영·관리하며 성장시켜보신 분  반복적이고 비효율적인 과정을 발견했을 때, AI·자동화·프로세스 개선을 통해 더 나은 구조를 만들고 확장 가능한 방식으로 해결하는 데 즐거움을 느끼고 실행력을 가지신 분  다양한 조직(CS·프로덕트·정책·PR·GR 등)과 원활히 협업하며 복잡한 문제를 정렬하고 실행까지 이끌 수 있는 분  정해진 답을 따르기보다, 더 나은 기준과 방식을 새롭게 만들어가는 데 동기부여를 느끼는 분    이 역할에서 얻을 수 있는 것    한국에서 가장 큰 중고거래 플랫폼의 핵심 문제를 직접 다룰 수 있어요. 수많은 사용자가 매일 경험하는 거래의 불편, 신뢰, 안전, 리스크 문제를 실제 제품과 운영 구조의 변화로 해결할 수 있어요  운영과 제품, 사업의 경계를 넘나드는 경험을 할 수 있어요. 현장의 문제를 단순히 전달하는 것이 아니라, 제품팀과 함께 문제를 정의하고 해결책을 만들며, 실제 서비스 변화까지 이끌게 돼요  운영 문제를 비즈니스 레벨의 기회로 바꾸는 경험을 할 수 있어요. 정책, 신뢰, 리스크, 운영 효율, 사용자 경험을 함께 바라보며 서비스의 성장과 지속 가능성에 영향을 주는 의사결정을 하게 돼요  AI Native Operations를 직접 만들어볼 수 있어요. 운영 업무에 AI를 ‘도구’로 쓰는 수준을 넘어, 문제 탐지·분류·처리·모니터링의 구조 자체를 새롭게 설계하는 경험을 할 수 있어요  자율성과 주도성을 크게 발휘할 수 있어요. 정해진 업무만 수행하기보다, 중요한 문제를 직접 찾아내고 우선순위를 정하며, 여러 조직을 움직여 해결까지 이끌어야 하는 역할이에요  복잡하고 의미 있는 문제를 풀 수 있어요. 중고거래는 단순한 거래 서비스가 아니라 사람, 신뢰, 지역, 물건, 돈, 안전이 얽힌 복잡한 플랫폼이에요. 이 복잡성을 이해하고 더 나은 시스템으로 바꾸는 과정에서 큰 성장과 성취감을 느낄 수 있어요    참고해 주세요    정규직 채용의 경우 3개월의 수습기간이 있어요  ‘장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법’, ‘국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률’에 따라 장애인 및 보훈대상자는 채용 전형 시 우대하고 있어요  직무 인터뷰에서 수행하신 사전 과제에 대해 질의응답하는 시간이 있어요    이렇게 합류해요   1. 서류 전형 → 2. 화상 인터뷰 → 3. 직무 인터뷰 → 4. 컬처핏 인터뷰 및 레퍼런스 체크 → 5. 처우협의 → 6. 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Project Manager Cruise
description: About MXP    MXP (MarineXchange) builds the software that runs cruise operations. Around 100 people develop and support a modular platform used by leading cruise lines — from property management and point of sale to itinerary planning, supply chain and port operations. Our customers run 24/7 operations at sea, which makes reliable delivery not a nice-to-have but the product itself.     We are building a professional management function, and this is one of its founding roles. You will help set the bar for how implementation projects are run in this industry.      Purpose of the role    You own our customer implementation projects end to end: cruise lines going live with our modules across their fleets, under real operational pressure and without the luxury of a hutdown window. Several such projects run in parallel at any time.     You are the extended arm of the Senior Project Manager / Transformation Lead. You apply the MXP project standard in daily practice, prove it under real conditions, and feed back what needs to change. You bring the cruise domain understanding that software project managers without it consistently underestimate — a fleet rollout is not a phased office deployment, and a release window on a vessel at sea is not a maintenance slot.      Key responsibilities     Implementation delivery    • Run customer implementation projects end to end: scope, plan, dependencies, risks, milestones, go-live and handover to service.  • Manage several projects in parallel without losing grip on any of them.  • Coordinate across module owners, development, quality assurance, release management and our external development partners.  • Own the project plan and keep it truthful. Surface slippage early, with options and a recommendation.      Customer    • Act as project counterpart to the customer's project organisation: planning, status, escalation and expectation management.  • Prepare and run customer steering meetings; document decisions with owner, criterion and date.  • Protect scope. Changes go through the enhancement process, not through corridor conversations.  • Build the kind of working relationship where a customer hears bad news from you early rather than discovering it late.      Standards in practice    • Apply the MXP project standard consistently and be its most visible working example.  • Support the Senior Project Manager in training and coaching module owners and project leads with regards to these standards  • Feed practical improvements back into the standard — you are the reality check on whether it works.  • Keep project data current so that reporting reflects reality without anyone chasing you.      Internal projects    • Take internal core projects and improvement initiatives alongside customer work, so the function contributes to MXP's own transformation as well as to customer delivery.      What success looks like after twelve months    • Your implementations meet agreed go-live dates — or the risk was visible early

title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

You’ll help define Growth Design at Vercel and shape the complete self-serve journey: signup, onboarding, first project and deployment, adoption, conversion, expansion, and retention. The work spans people, agents, and the handoffs between them.

You’ll report into Product Design and work closely with Growth Product, Engineering and Data. You’ll have the authority and support to move from an observed problem to a working prototype, shipped experience, and measured result.

Vercel gives you unlimited access to leading LLMs and in-house tools that make product data easier to explore. If a tool limits the work, you can partner directly with its builders or improve it yourself.

This role does not come with a mature Growth Design playbook, stable briefs, or one bounded product surface. Priorities change as evidence arrives. Some experiments will not ship. Our data and tools allow us to validate hypotheses. You should enjoy finding the right problem, making something real, working through implementation, and staying accountable after launch.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the self-serve experience across onboarding, activation, adoption, monetization, and retention for people and agents.
  • Find high-impact opportunities through customer research, product data, and direct use of Vercel.
  • Co-own Growth strategy, priorities, hypotheses, and success measures with Growth Product, Engineering, and Data.
  • Build and test working prototypes using the right tools for the question, including Figma, v0, Cursor, and Claude Code.
  • Design and ship experiments, stay involved through implementation, and interpret results without losing sight of trust, accessibility, or the broader funnel.
  • Turn what works into durab

title: Manager, Customer Success - Commercial Markets
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Manager for Customer Success - Commercial Markets leads a global team of high-touch Customer Success Managers (CSMs) dedicated to accelerating adoption, retention, and expansion across Planet’s key commercial accounts (including agriculture, energy, insurance, finance and enterprise technologies). Reporting to the Global Director of Customer Success, this position oversees daily operations for the commercial portfolio and ensures the team has the strategy and resources needed to deliver measurable business value and ROI.

This role serves as a leader and advocate for strategic enterprise customers, acting as a key escalation point for critical account health and commercial growth. You will work in lockstep with Regional Sales Directors, Account Executives, Pre-Sales, and Product leadership to execute a unified commercial strategy. By empowering global commercial enterprises to seamlessly integrate satellite imagery and geospatial analytics into their core business workflows, this role directly drives Planet’s commercial growth and mission.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Washington D.C. office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

  • Commercial Accountability: You are responsible for regional/segment performance metrics, including Gross Retention, Net Retention (NRR), Net Promoter Score (NPS), account expansion, and team hiring/retention targets.
  • Team Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of CSMs (US and Europe based), establishing best practices for high-touch customer engagement and value delivery

Wir wurden als eines der Top-10 innovativsten Tech-Startups Deutschlands ausgezeichnet (Weconomy Award 2025) und arbeitenam Institut für Kunststofftechnik der Universität Stuttgart an unseren Prototypen und Testanlagen.

Wir sind ein kleines eingespieltes Team aus derzeit 4 Personen. Wir wachsen und legen Wert auf ein diverses und hochmotiviertes Team. Unser Anspruch ist es auch bisherige Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsprozesse neu zu denken und KI-Tools sukzessive in die Arbeitsabläufe zu integrieren und sie zu unserem primären Arbeitswerkzeug zu entwickeln.

Startdatum: Ab November 2026.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst einen Teil der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeit, die aktuell unser CTO allein trägt, und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Systemarchitektur und Werkstatt. Der CTO definiert die technische Richtung, du legst die Komponenten aus und bringst sie zur Baureife, unser Prototypenbau-Ingenieur baut sie.

Dein Fokus: Physikalische Probleme oder Bedürfnisse in funktionierende Entwürfe überführen. Systematisch, KI-gestützt und auf hohem Qualitätsniveau.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Komponenten auslegen & dimensionieren: Du berechnest Scroll-Geometrien, Dichtungen, Druckbehälter, Wellen und Lager und stellst sicher, dass alles funktioniert.
  • Designvarianten

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) - EnerGuide
description:
Dein Einstieg in die Zukunft der Immobilienwirtschaft – direkt an der Seite der Gründer und des Head of Growth & Revenue

Enerithm ist die digitale Antwort auf die drängendsten Fragen der modernen Immobilienwirtschaft. Mit unserer KI-gestützten SaaS-Plattform transformieren wir die klassische Energieberatung in einen hochgradig skalierbaren, normgerechten Prozess. Während der Markt unter dem Druck nationaler und europäischer Richtlinien (GModG, EPBD, etc.) steht, liefern wir die technologische Infrastruktur für die Dekarbonisierung einzelner Gebäude und ganzer Portfolios.

Unsere Bilanz spricht für sich: Mit einer jährlichen Wachstumsrate von über 100 % und einem Kundenstamm, der namhafte Branchenführer umfasst, haben wir den Proof-of-Concept eindrucksvoll erbracht. Hinter Enerithm stehen Gründer der TU Dresden, die fachliche Exzellenz und wissenschaftliche Fundierung in ein marktführendes Produkt übersetzt haben.

Wir stehen am Beginn einer massiven Skalierungsphase – und unsere Kundenbasis auf EnerGuide wächst schneller, als wir sie bisher betreuen konnten. Um dieses Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur produktiven Nutzung begleitet – und aus einem Neukunden einen Kunden macht, der bleibt, ausbaut und uns weiterempfiehlt.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission: Customer Success aufbauen – und parallel liefern

Unser Customer Success ist im Aufbau. Erste Prozesse und Routinen stehen, sie sind aber noch nicht so weit, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum mithalten. Genau da setzt du an: Du entwickelst das Bestehende weiter und machst es skalierbar – und zwar während das operative Tagesgeschäft läuft. In den ersten Monaten betreust du deine Accounts selbst und baust parallel die Strukturen aus, nach denen später ein Team arbeitet. Das sollte dich reizen und nicht abschrecken.

title: Technischer Kundenservice - Zweirad (m/w/d)
description:
Du bist technisch versiert und brennst für Fahrräder? Du willst Dich beruflich neu erfinden und suchst dafür ein lockeres, modernes Unternehmensumfeld?

We are UT! Als Vertriebspartner für Gates Carbon Drive und Bosch eBike Systems sind wir DIE Experten für Fahrrad-Antriebstechnik in Europa und darüber hinaus. Unsere 39 Mitarbeiter beliefern und betreuen täglich über 1.000 Fahrradhersteller, -Händler und -Marken weltweit. Dieses Jahr wollen wir noch weiter wachsen und unser Team in Mühlhausen vergrößern. Werde auch Du ein Teil davon!

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Kunden (Fachhändler & Hersteller) telefonisch bei Fragen und Problemen rund um Fahrradantriebe.
  • Du unterstützt uns bei Kundenschulungen, nimmst an großen Events und Messen der Fahrrad-Branche teil (z.B. Eurobike) und kannst Dich auf Wunsch auch im Außendienst entwickeln.
  • Du bearbeitest Garantie-Rücksendungen, prüfst Komponenten und entscheidest über Ersatzlieferungen, Gutschriften oder Rücksendungen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast eine technische Ausbildung oder Studium gemacht (z.B. Mechatroniker, Zweiradmechatroniker, Kfz-Mechatroniker, Maschinenbau – auch Studienabbrecher willkommen!).
  • Du liebst Bikes so sehr wie wir!
  • Du hast gute Office-Kenntnisse.
  • Du besitzt sichere Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

  • Unser dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld: Spannende, hochmoderne Produkte rund um Bikes, wachsendes Unternehmen & renommierte Kunden
  • Unsere Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Gemeinsam wachsen, Entscheidungen selbständig treffen, Dein Wissen stetig ausbauen
  • Unser familiäres Team: Echtes Teamplay auf Augenhöhe, Du-Kultur, Cap statt Anzug & regelmäßige Firmenfeste & Wandertage
  • Unsere attraktive Bezahlung mit Leistu

title: Customer Support (f/m/d) / 20h pro Woche
description:
Wir bei Future Demand entwickeln eine innovative SaaS-Plattform für datengetriebenes Marketing und Demand-Forecasting. Unsere Lösung unterstützt vor allem kleine und mittlere Unternehmen dabei, ihre Vertriebs- und Marketingprozesse intelligenter zu planen und ihr Wachstum zu beschleunigen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Customer Success Teams suchen wir ab sofort Unterstützung im Customer Support in Teilzeit mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. Die Position ist offen für Bewerber:innen mit unterschiedlichen beruflichen und akademischen Hintergründen. Entscheidend sind für uns deine Serviceorientierung, deine klare Kommunikation und dein Interesse an digitalen Produkten.

Aufgaben

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund:innen: Du bearbeitest Anfragen per E-Mail und telefonisch.

  • Feedback weitergeben: Du sammelst kontinuierlich Nutzerfeedback und arbeitest eng mit Product Management und Development zusammen, um unsere Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du möchtest dauerhaft 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.
  • Sprachgewandt: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Kundenorientiert: Du hast Freude daran, Nutzer:innen weiterzuhelfen, und reagierst empathisch sowie lösungsorie

title: DMS Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - Full Remote aus Bayern

title: Senior Manager, Digital Marketing & Channel

As a key member of Spire's Growth Marketing and Go-To-Market leadership team, the Senior Director, Digital Marketing & Channels will play a critical role in strengthening and expanding Spire's market position across global Commercial and Government segments.

You will ensure digital programs are aligned to company strategy, pipeline goals, and regional go-to-market priorities.

title: Projekttechniker/in Blasformen (m/w/d)
description:
Mauser Packaging Solutions ist ein globaler Marktführer von hochwertigen und wegweisenden Verpackungen für industrielle Zwecke. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst ein vielfältiges Produktportfolio, zu dem Kunststoffverpackungen, Fibertrommeln, Stahlfässer, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in verschiedenen Größen sowie die Rücknahme gebrauchter Verpackungen gehören (Rekonditionierung). Damit bietet Mauser Packaging Solutions einen Komplettservice, der von der Produktion bis zur Wiederverwendung der Verpackungen auf Nachhaltigkeit ausgerichtet ist ("ECO-CYCLE®"). Nach dem Zusammenschluss von BWAY, MAUSER Group, NCG und ICS im Jahr 2018 beliefert Mauser Packaging Solutions mit mehr als 11.000 Beschäftigten an über 180 Standorten namhafte Kunden aus der Chemie, Petrochemie, Landwirtschaft, Pharmaindustrie und der Lebensmittelindustrie.Die Aufgaben und Herausforderungen für MAUSER wachsen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Produktionsstandorte bei der Optimierung und Instandhaltung der Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere der Extrusionsblasformmaschinen
  • Durchführung von Maßnahmen zur Vermeidung oder Reduktion von Stillstandszeiten
  • Leitung von Projekten zur Durchführung von Reparaturen, Überholungen und Verlagerung von Produktionsanlagen; Erstellen von Termin- und Kostenplänen
  • Handwerkliche Arbeit bei Montage / Demontage / Reparatur von Maschinenkomponenten
  • Reinigung / Begutachtung von Bauteilen und bei Bedarf Einholen und Abstimmen von Angeboten
  • Koordination von internen und externen Lieferanten im Hinblick auf eine sachgemäße Durchführung der Arbeiten und die Minimierung der Stillstandszeiten in Koordination mit der Produktionsplanung bzw. der Leitung des betroffenen Standortes
  • Bewertung und Dokumentation von Maschinenzuständen sowie der daraus abzuleitenden Maßnahmen und Verwaltung eines entsprechenden Datenbestandes
  • Erstellung von Lastenheften
  • Erstellung von systematischen Wartungsplänen
